tei:div.tei:p: hā::ni 'gu/ / /shā chi/hā /pus/ me~X ga 63079060'ab 'a ga50gaga'abya ga7 bci 76770(50 (57sto
don gsal rtsa 'grel gyi dgos don stsol ba rin chen bsam rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄7/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang 'grel pa don gsal rtsa 'grel gyi dgos don stsol ba rin chen bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ lhag pa'i lha mchog bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ /tshogs gnyis chu gter las zhakhrungs sku bzhi'i bang rim can/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bos rab bskor las bzhi'i 'od zer 'phro/ /sgrib gnyis rlung gis mi g.yo rigs bzhi'i dbus na mdzes/ /thub dbang lhun po'i mkhyen brtses rtag tu skong gyur cig /stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro rab bsgrags pas/ /log rtog ri dwags tshogs

༄༅/ /rnams skrag mdzad de/ /yang dag lta ba'i dpal bzang rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /'dren mchog seng ge bzang po rgyal gyur cig /de ltar mchod par brjod nas las su bya ba'i bstan bcos 'chang pa la/ tha snyad rtogs pa'i don du mtshan smos/ gzhung tshad rtogs pa'i don du bam grangs/ bar chad zhi ba'i don du phyag 'tshal/ gdul bya 'jug pa'i don du da co/sa 'brel/ dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i ngag tshig dgod/ sgyur byed lo paṇa gang yin smos pa'o/ /dang po la/ mtshan bsgyur bshad gnyis / dang po ni / rgya gar ba'i skad du bstan bcos 'di la a bhi sa ma ya a lo ka ra nā ma pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta u pa de sha shālha brin+ti zhes pa ming ngo / /bod kyi skad du bsgyur na pra dz+nyā pa

ra mi ta ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ u pa de sha ni man ngag yasna ni bstan bcos/ a bhi sa ma ya ni mngon par rtogs pa/ a le ka ra ni rgyan/ na ma ni zhes bya ba/ brin+ti ni 'gre' rnga/ rdzo/ /gnyis pa ni/ yum ni brjod bya shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lam dang 'bras bu dang rang bzhin gyi shes phyin/ rjodabyed shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gzhung sher phyin no/ khes par bya ba'i yul myur du khong du chud par byed pas man ngag /'chos dang skyob pa'i yon kha gnyis dang ldan pas bstan bcos/ de mtshan nyid rtsom pa po ro dang ldan bas bka'i dgongs 'grel du brtsams pa'i tshig gang zhig /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa/ mngon par rtogs pa ni mngon du phyogs pas mngon rtogs dang / mngon sum du rtogs pas mngon rtogs te mkhyen pa gsum dang sbyor ba bzhi dang chos sku'o/ /rgyan ni bstan bcos 'dis yum gyi don gsal bar byed pas na gsal byed kyi rgyan no/ /zhes bya ba ni bstan bcos 'di la ming 'di skad ces zer ces pa'o/ /'grel pa ni don tsam 'grel pa'o/ /'o na ming gnyis la khyad par yod na bstan bcos gcig gi ming du 'gal la/ med na zlos skyon yod ce na/ yum gyi don myur du khong du chud par byed pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag /mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag gsal bar byed

༄༅/ /pas rgyan nya/ dan gtsag la byed las tha dad pa gnyes kyi cha nas btags pas skyon gnyis ka med do/ /skad gnyis thog mar smos pa'i dgos pa gang zhe na/ bstan bcos khungs btsan la sgra sgyur phra mo shes shing / bstan bcos btsal sla zhing skad gnyis rnam grangs shes pa'o/ /bam po ni gzhung tshad mang nyung bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir lo tsā bas byas la/ tshad ni rgya dpe las bstan bcos 'di la sho lo ka stong lnga brgya zhes gsungs pas/ bam po re la sho lo ka sum brgya re yod do/ /dang po ni lnga yod pa'i thog ma 'di yin zhes 'chad 'gyur la snyegs pa ste/ bam po kha mar blta dang le'u kha yar blta'o/ /'og ma rnams kyang 'di bzhin no/ /gsum pa la/ sgyur byed lo tsā ba'i mchod brjod/ 'chad byed 'grel pa mkhan pa'i mchod brjod/ rtsom byed bstan bcos mkhan po'i mchod brjod do/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa don gsal sgyur mkhan gyi lo tsā ba chos can/ 'grel pa sgyur ba'i thog mar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba la dgos pa yod de/ de'i thog mar de la phyag 'tshal bas rang nyid dpa pa' gas shing 'gyur mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dang ne 'byed pa'o/ /gnyes pa la dngos dang 'grel pa rtsom pa'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ 'grel chung rtsom

pa'i thog mar yum la phyag 'tshal ba la dgos pa yod de/ de'i thog mar de la phyag 'tshal bas yum de'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams rnam par dbye ba mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / yum la thos rngo6ltog kyi sgo nas 'jug pa gegs med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / rang nyid dam par rtogs shing gdul bya yum la dwang ba skye ba'i phyir/ dbye ba la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ chos can/ nyid kyi yum de'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams rnam par dbye ba la dgos pa yod de/ nyid kyis de dbye bas yum de'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams yum kun gyi rgyan du gyur pa gsal bar shes pa'i phyir/ des na 'grel chung 'dis mngon rtogs rgyan la 'grel byed gzhan gyi dbang gis ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma yod pa rnams sel bar byed pas mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rgyan yin te/ dper na rgyan gyi dri ma sel ba rgyan gyi rgyan yin pa bzhin no/ /phyag gi yum ni gang / 'grel pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi ci zhig ce na/ yum ni chos bshes ltar na ngo bo nyid kyi sher phyin chos rnams kyi chos nyid dang / der brten pa gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum/gser gling pa ltar na dngos dang btags pa'i dbye bas gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin rnam pa gsum mo/ /mdor na gzhung dang lam dang 'bras bu dang rang bzhin gyi sher phyin thams cad 'di'i yum yin no/ /

༄༅/ /'grel chung 'di'i dgos sogs chos bzhi ni rgyan gyi tshig don rnams 'di'i brjod bya/ 'di la brten nas rgyan 'di yum kun gyi rgyan du gyur par gsal bar shes pa dngos kyi dgos pa/ der zhes pa la brten nas rgyan la zhugs te rgyan gyi tshig don rtogs pa nas mthar phyin pa'i ye shes kyi bar ni brgyud pa'i dgos pa'am nying dgos/ nying dgos dngos kyi dgos pa las byung / dngos kyi dgos pa 'brel pa las byung ba ni 'brel pa'o/ /gnyis pa la shes rab dang snying rje gnyis/ dang po la shes rab kyi rgyu dang shes rab dngos/ dang po la bzhi las/ thogs med kyis rnam bshad mdzad tshul ni/ 'phags pa thogs med skyobs pa chos can/ 'chos stobs gnyis dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen po yum gyi rnam bshad mdzad de/ nyid kyis 'gro la kun tu brtse ba'i snying rje dang / mi pham mgon las mdo dang chos lnga dngos su gsan pa la brten nas byung ba'i shes rab la brten nas de nyid rnam nges brtsams pa'i phyir/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje la chags par btags pa yin te/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yul sems can mi 'dor bar 'dra/dgos pa sems can mi 'dor bar shes/ dngos la gnod byed theg chen 'phags pas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgya yin pas so/ /dbyig gnyen gyis bkrol tshul ni/ 'gro ba'i don phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i

slob dpon dbyig gnyen chos can/ thogs med kyis rnam bshad mdzad pa de'i 'og tu yum rnam par bkrol ba yin te/ shes bya gzung 'dzin du snang ba nang sems tsam yin pa'i grub mtha' la brten nas gzhung 'grel brtsams pa'i phyir/ chos can/ yum don sems tsam du 'thad pas sems tsam du bkrol ba min te/ rang gi mos pa gtso bor byed pa tsam du zad pas so/ /grol sdes phye tshul ni/ 'phags pa grol sde chos can/ dbyig gnyen gyis bkrol ba de'i 'og tu bstan bcos chen po mngon rtogs rgyan phye ba yin te/ nyid kyis yum don dbu mar gnas pa rtogs pa'i blo la brten nas nyi khri snang ba brtsams pa'i phyir/ sngon chad rnam par phye zin pas 'di ni rigs pa ma yin no zhe na/ chos can/ yum don sngar phye zin pas khyod kyis yum don phye ba mi rigs mi dgos te/ thogs med dang dbyig gnyen des byas pa'i 'grel pas yum don ji lta ba bzhin byas pa min par mthong nas khyod kyis yum don dbu mar phye ba'i phyir/ btsun pas rnam bshad byas tshul ni/ dad pa'i sa tshogs lam la gnas pa'i btsun pa rnam grol sde chos can/ 'phags pa grol sdes phye ba de'i 'og tu mngon rtogs rgyan la rnam bshad byas pa yin te/ blos yum gyi tshig don mtha' dag ma rnyed par rang gi rtogs pa dang mthun par nyi khri rnam 'grel brtsams pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la don la

༄7/ /mkhas pa'i shes rab ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ yum don la mkhas pa'i shes rab yod de/ nyid kyis gong du bshad pa de lta bu'i mkhas pa bzhi'i legs bshad kyis blo gros gsal bar byas pa dang / byams pas rjes su bzung ba la brten nas bstan bcos yum dang rgyan gyi tshig don mtha' dag yum dang rgyan gyi dgongs pa ji lta ba de ltar rnyed pa'i phyir zhes pa ni slob dpon rang gi blo'i che ba brjod pa tsam yin no/ /'o na gong ma bzhi dang zlos skyon yod do zhe na/ slob dpon gyis rnyed pa'i 'grel chung don gsal de chos can/ 'grel pa gong ma bzhi las ma mtshan che ste/ dbyig gnyen dang btsun pa grol sdes ma rnyed pa'i bstan bcos kyi don rnyed nas brtsams pa'i phyir dang / de nyid rnam nges dang nyi khri snang ba la ltos te tshig nyung zhing yum don dbu mar 'grel byed yin pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir zlos skyon med do/ /gnyis pa tshig la mkhas pa'i shes rab ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ yum gyi tshig la mkhas pa'i shes rab yod de/ yum gyi tshig don phyin ci ma log par dbye ba'i phyir/ yum gyi don chos can/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ba yin te/ shes rab can dbyig gnyen dang / dad pa can btsun pa grol sdes kyang ma rnyed pa'i don yin pa de lta bas so/ /slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ yum don dbye bar rigs te/

sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i dbang gis dus ring mo zhig nas zab mo'i lam gzhung lam sher phyin rnyed pa'i mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chos can/ yum gyi tshig don ma lus khyod kyi thos pa la sogs pa — —rnam pa kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul min te/ khyod so skye yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na yum don ston pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa mi 'thad do ce na/ yang gi khongs nas so/ /yum don ma lus pa mngon sum gyi yul ma yin na yang chos can/ yum don ston pa'i bstan bcos rtsom par rigs te/ rang gzhan la mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi phan gdags par 'dod pa'i sgo nas yum don 'byed pa la spro ba skyes te yum don 'byed pa'i bstan bcos brtsams pa'i phyir/ yum don dbye bas rang gzhan la phan nam zhe na/ chos can/ yum don dbye bas rang gzhan la phan te/ khyod kyi yum don 'byed pa'i bstan bcos de me tog la sogs pas sangs rgyas mchod pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams sog pa dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir 'khrid mdzad gang yin dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa la/ lnga las mtshams sbyar ba ni/ 'phags pa byams pa chos can/ rgyan rtsom pa'i dang por spangs rtogs mdzad pa'i yon tan ji ltar yod pa bzhin brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas yum la

༄༅/ /phyag 'tshal ba la dargas pa yod de/ rang nyed dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par bstan pa dang gdul bya gzhan bcom ldan 'das ma la dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du de lhu bu'i sgo nas yum la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir/ dang ba nyid gang gi ched du yin zhe na/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi don gyi ched du bcom ldan 'das ma la 'jug pa'i phyir du'o/ /de la zhugs pas de lta bu'i don thob bam zhe na/ shes bya chos can/de la zhugs pas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi don thob ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma ni phul du dbyung du med cing dpag tu med pa'i yon tan gyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir/ yang na don gyis te/ brgyud nas 'jug par bya ba'i don du'o/ /de la zhugs pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ chos can/ de la zhugs pa la dgos pa yod de/ rtags sngar bzhin no/ /dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du phyag 'tshal ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/'phags pa byams pa chos can/ gdul bya yum la dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du yum la phyag 'tshal ba la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yul can gyi rab tu dwad ba ni ranga'abrasalegs pa byang sdob thams cad thob pa'i thog ma'i byed rgyu yin par rtogs nas gdul bya yum la dwang ba skyed pa'i ched du yum la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir/ dgos don la dngos dang brgyud pa'i

dgos pa gnyis/ dang po la dbang rtul dang ba dang / dbang rnon dang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad 'di chos can/ khyod la dge //khyadalo pas rkyen byas nas khyod kyi gdul bya dad pa'i rjes 'brang rnams khyod kyi brjod bya yum 'di la the tshom med par myur du rab tu dang ba skye ba'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod thos pas rkyen byas nas khyod kyi gdul bya dad pa'i rjes 'brang rnams/ yum 'di la dang ba skye ste/ khyod kyis de'i ngor yum 'di'i che ba'i bdag nyid gzhan las phul du byung ba dang ldan par brjod pa'i ngag rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dang ba skyed par byed do/ /ji ltar na 'gal rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pas na rab tu'o/ /gang la na mchod brjod yul gyi yum de la'o/ /dbang rtul la 'di zhes nye tshig smos/ dbang rnon la de zhes ring tshig smos pa mi 'thad de/dbang rnon yum la nye ba'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ yum nye ring gi dbang gis ma yin gyi/ gdul bya dbang rtul tshigs bcad 'di thos ma thag dang ba skye bas nye tshig smos la/ gdul bya dbang rnon tshigs bcad 'di thos ma thag dang ba mi skye bas ring tshig smos pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag gang na/ dbang rtul du ma zad gdul bya chos kyi rjes 'brang rnams kyang ngo / /rgyu gang la brten nas na/ mchod brjod kyi tshigs

༄7/ /bcad 'di thos nas de'i brjod bya yum la lung rigs kyis brtag dpyad byas pa na yum yon tan can yin pa la gnod byed ma mthong zhing sgrub byed nges par rtogs pa la brten nas so/ /dang po ni gnod byedam mthong ngo / /gang la na/ mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don gyi ngo bo gzhi lam rnam gsum rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par shes pa'i yum gyis sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po skyed cing bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub pa la'o/ /gang gis na/ gdul bya chos kyi rjes 'brang rnams kyis so/ /ji lta bu na/ yul rtogs tshul dang 'bras bu sgrub tshul don dang mi mthun no zhes pa'i rigasapa yang dag gi'o/ /'o na gzhi lam rnam gsum skye med du gang gis 'grub ce na/ gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi tshad mas 'grub bo/ /tshad ma ni gang / ji ltar 'grub ce na/gzhi lam rnam gsum chos can/ rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa yin te/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir dang / sogs pa chos can/ chos 'dra/ khyod yod pa yang mi skye med pa yang mi skye ba'i phyir dang / rang dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang rgyu med las mi skye ba'i phyir dang / rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir dang / don dam par rgyu gcig gis 'bras bu gcig dang du ma mi bskyed/ rgyu du mas 'bras bu

du ma dang gcig mi bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'di rnams ni dbu ma thal 'gyur bas gzhan ngor gzhan gyi log rtog sel ba'i phyir 'god la/ rang rgyud pas don dam par rang gzhan sogs las mi skye zhes sogs rang rgyud du dam bca' 'o/ /zhib par dbu ma'i bstan bcos las shes par mdzod/ mdor na/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya chos kyi rjes 'brang rnams chos can/ mchod brjod ngag gi brjod bya yum mkhyen pa gsum gyis gzhi lam rnam gsum rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par shes pa dang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub pa la gnod byed yang dag ma mthong ste/ des de ltar shes shing de ltar sgrub pa de kun rdzob pa'i rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mchod brjod yul gyi yum dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / mkhyen pa gsum mo/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gnas skabs theg pa'i tshul gsum pa can/ byed las sangs rgyas dang /sogs pa byang sems chen po dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'phags pa gdon mi za bar bskrun par mdzad pa'i phyir/ ngag don ni chos can/ mchod brjod yul gyi yum mkhyen pa gsum yon tan can yin pa la sgrab byed rtogs te/ des rang gi sras 'phags pa bskrun par mdzad pa ni gdon mi za ba srid par rtogs pa'i phyir/ mchod brjod yul gyi yum mkhyen pa gsum chos can/ sras 'phags pa gdon mi za bar

༄7/ /bskrun te/ de bskrun pa'i rgyu tshang zheng gegs med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya yum la dang ba'i dad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas yum gya yon to mngon par 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang po rno rtul gnyis ka yang brjod bya yum de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab rjod byed sher phyin la rnam pa thams cad du tshig bzung ba dang don kun chub par bya ba la sogs pa'i don du yum la shin tu gus par byed pa'i phyir/ kyang ni/ thos pa las dwang ba ma zad ces pa'o/ /gus pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya yum la gus pa de chos can/ dgos pa yod de / khyod la brten nas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab skye ba'i rim gyis yum la 'jug pa'i phyir/ shes rab gsum ni/ gtso bor bdag rkyen thos pa la brten nas byung ba'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed ni thos byung gi shes rab/ gtso bor bdag rkyen bsam pa la brten nas byung ba'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed ni bsam byung gi shes rab/ gtso por bdag rkyen bsgoms pa labarten nas byung ba'i chos raste 'byed ni bsgoms byung gi shes rab bo/ /zhugs pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang po rno rtul gnyis chos can/ yum la zhugs pa la dgos pa yod de/ yum la

zhugs pas legs pa'i mchog byang chub 'thob pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ mchod brjod yul gyi bcom ldan 'das ma la rab tu dwang ba'i dad pa chos can/ rang 'bras legs pa thams cade 'thob pa'ithog ma'i byad 3/ yin te/ khyod las yum la gus/ gus pa las zhugs/ zhugs pa las rang 'bras thams cad 'thob pa'i phyir/ bsdus don ni/ phyag 'tshal ba ste bstod do/ /gang la na/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang sangs rgyas dang bcas pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'o/ /gang gis na/ byams pas so/ /dus ni rgyan rtsom pa'i dang por ro/ /tshul sgo gsum gus pas so/ /gang gi sgo nas na/gzhi shes kyi yon tan gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa'i nyan thos slob pa dman pa'i myang 'das su khrid par mdzad pa dang / lam shes kyi yon tan byang sems chen pos 'jig rten 'gro ba'i don sgrub par mdzad pa dang / rnam mkhyen gyi yon tan thub pa'i dbang pos chos 'khor gsungs pa ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi thun mong min pa'i yon tan brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/mchod brjod de la mkhyen gsum gyis don mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus la/ brgyad du ma zad mkhyen gsum de dag kyang dngos btags ma phye ba'i yum yin zhing / brgyad du ma zad mkhyen gsum des kyang tshig don rgyas

༄7/ /bshad nas 'chad par 'gyur ba bzhen du 'phags bzha' bzhed don thams cad phun sum tshogs par sgrub nus par thugs kyis dgongs nas mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas yum la bstod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum gyis brgyad ji ltar bsdus na/ mkhyen gsum gyis mkhyen gsum rang bzhin gyi sgo nas/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sbyor ba'i sgo nas/ rtse sbyor rab kyi sgo nas/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba go rim gyi sgo nas / skad cig ma'i sbyor ba mtha'i sgo nas/ chos sku rnam smin gyi sgo nas bsdus so/ /ngag don byams mgon chos can/ nyid kyis mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas yum la bstod pa la rgyu mtshan yo da de/ mkhyen gsum gyis don brgyad bsdus shing / mkhyen gsum des kyang rang gi sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don thams cad sgrub nus par dgongs nas de'i sgo nas yum la bstod pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'dir bstan mchod brjod yul gyi yum gyi ngo bo gang / dbye na du zhig ce na/ 'dir bstan mchod brjod yul gyi yum gyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub nus/ dbye na gzhung / lam/ 'bras bu/ rang bzhin po / tshig don la gang zag gsum gyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang / sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi yum du sgrub pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba rnam pa gnyis/ dang po la gsum las gzhi shes

la nyan rang gi /zhed don ljeb pa'i sgo shes bstodage pa ni/ dzakhrid paso te thob par mdzad rdo/—/—gang na/ gerangalugasasidz+nyānamongasapa'i kun 'byung nye bar zhi zhing / sdug bsngal gyi phung po cung zad lus pa'i dman pa'i 'gog pa ni/ dman pa'i lhag ma dang bcas pa'i myang 'das dang / rang lugs kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po yang nye bar zhi ba'i dman pa'i 'gog pa ni/ dman pa'i lhag ma med pa'i myang 'das te/ de lta bu'i myang 'das gnyis so/ /thabs gang gis na/ gzhi thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par shes pa kun shes nyid de kho nas so/ /gang zag gang na/ gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa nyan thos slob pa dang / de rigs nges pa nyan thos zhes pa'i tshig gis rim pa gcig gis bstan pa rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can te/ mdor na/ gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa zhi ba dman pa'i myang 'das tshol ba ste don du gnyer ba rnams so/ /ngag don/ byams mgon chos can/ yum gzhi shes la bstod pa yin te/ gzhi shes kyis gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa'i nyan rang gi rigs can rnams dman pa'i myang 'das su 'khrid par mdzad pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i phyir/ gzhi shes chos can/ gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa'i nyan rang gi rigs can rnams kyi yum yin

༄༅/ /te / de rnams dman pa'i myang 'das su 'khrid par mdzad pa'i mkhyen pa can yin pa'i phyir/ rang sangs rgyas chos can/ nyan thos de'i phyogs su bslan nas bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod dang nyan thos 'phags pa gnyis theg pa dman par mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod de'i phyogs su bslan nas bstan pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyan thos dang khyad par gtan med pa min te/ nyan thos bas rnam par thar pa cung zad gcig gis lhag pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyan thos bas lhag ste/ phyi rol gyi don bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa'i phyir/ kyang ni nyan thos su ma zad ces pa'o/ /lam shes la byang sems kyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ bsgrub par mdzad do/ /gang na/ bcud kyi 'jig rten 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don mngon mtho dang nges legs byang chub gsum mo/ /ji ltar na dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas ji ltar 'os pa bzhin du'o/ /dus/ gdul bya'i 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du'o/ /thabs gang la brten nas na/ theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par rtogs pa'i ngo bor lam shes nyid de kho nas so/ /gang gis na/ 'gro ba sems can la phan pa'i don sgrub par byed pa byang sems chen po rnams kyis so/ /ngag don/ byams mgon chos can/ yum lam shes la bstod pa yin

te / lam shes kyis byang sems chen po'i bzhed don sgrub par mdzad pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i phyir/ lam shes chos can/ byang sems chen po'i yum yin te/ de'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub pare mdzad pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen la sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ gsungs pa ste skor ba mdzad do/ /thabs gang la brten nas na ji lta ji snyed pa'i rnam pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par thugs su chud pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gang dang gang ldan pa la brten nas so/ /gang gis na dbang phyug sogs phyi rol pa las rnal 'byor lhag pas na/ nyan rang dang byang sems rnams ni rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug /ye shes la sogs pa che ba'i bdag nyid kyis de rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu yin pas na gtso bo/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par spangs pa'i sku can thub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis so/ /gang na/ sde snod gsum dang theg pa gsum gyi rnam pa kun dang ldan pa sna tshogs pa chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / chos kyi 'bor lo rim pa gsum po ma lus pa 'di'o/ /dgos pa dang tshul ji ltar na/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / nyan thos kyi rigs can 'dul ba'i don du

༄7/ /bden pa bzhe' ches kye 'khor lo/ sems tsam pa'i rigs can 'dul ba'i don du mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ dbu ma pa'i rigs can 'dul ba'i don du don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ rnam pa thams cad du rgyun mi 'chad par ro/ /chos kyi phung tsho ngo bo ni gang / dbye na du zhig ce na/ ngo bo ni rtogs pa'i chos rgya chen po ston pa'i chos du ma khrus pa/ dbye na brgyad khri bzhi stong /tshad ni 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ de gsum cha mnyam pa ste bzhi po re re la nyi khri chig stong ste/ brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyer/ por/ de dang mthun par chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bskor bas na/nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong po re re rtsa ba nas spong bar nus pa'i gnyen po re rdzogs par ston pa'i gto gyi tshogs re'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo ni gang / dbye na du zhig ce na/ngo bo ni ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos gang zhig mi mthun phyogs 'joms par nus pa/ dbye na gsum las bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo ni/ bden bzhi rtogs pa'i rtogs pa 'khor bcas/ de ston pa'i chos kyi phung po ni 'du4 go sa pa'o/ /mas nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor tsho ngo bo ni/ ngo bo nyid med pa gsum rtogs pa'i rtogs pa lor bcas/ de ston pa'i chos kyi phung po ni/ chos rnams kun btags/

rgezhan dbang / yongs grub gsum du phye nas dngos su gsal bar ston pa chos mngon pa'i mdo rnams so/ /don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo ni/ spros bral rtogs pa'i rtogs pa 'khor bcas/de ston pa'i chos kyi phung po ni yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnams so/ /ngag don/ byams mgon chos can/ rnam mkhyen la bstod pa yin te/ rnam mkhyen gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyisapa ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la na/ sangasargyasadang nyan thos dang rang sangasargyas dang byang chub semasadapa'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i yum de la'o/ /gang gisan byams pasaso/ /dgos pa snga 'grel bzhin no/ /dus rgyan rtsom pa'i thog mar ro/ /tshul sgo gsum gus pas so/ /de 'phags bzhi'i yum yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ mngon rtogs brgyad kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i sher phyin chos can/ sras 'phags bzhi'i yum yin te/ sangs rgyas nyan thos dang / sogs pa rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa ste tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpon slob rnams kyi bzhed don phun tshogs de sgrab par byed pa nyid kyis so/ /lnga pa brgal lan la rgol ba ni/ gong du bstan pa de ltar phyag bstod sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom na/ ci chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi

༄༅/ /shes rab bskyed par bya ba'i phyar du yul can gzhi shes dang yul gzhi tsam brjod byar bsdus pas rgyan du rtsom mam/ 'on te mi mthun pa'i phyogs ma lus pa spang ba'i phyir du yul can lam shes dang /yul lam tsam brjod byar bsdus pas sam/ de ste shes bya ma lus pa shes par bya ba'i phyir du yul can rnam mkhyen dang yul rnam pa tsam brjod byar bsdus pas sam/ 'on te mkhyen pa gsum ka brjod byar bsdus pas rgyan du rtsom/ phyogs dang po gzhi tsam brjod byar bsdus pa ltar na mngon pa'i bstan bcos nas ma bshad pa'am/ de nas bshad pa'i gzhi tsam brjod byar bsdus pa'i sgo nas rgyan du rtsom/ dang po mi 'thad de / yum mngon rtogs rgyan 'di las ni mtshan nyid mngon pa'i bstan bcos las mi smos pa'i gzhi gang yin pa de brjod byar 'byung ba med pa'i phyir te/ de lta bu'i gzhi mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ltar na/mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ khyod rtsom pa'i 'bad pa byas pa don med pa yin par thal/ khyod kyis mngon pa'i ba na bcos nas bshad pa'i gzhi tsam brjod byas bsdus pa gang zhig /de mngon pa'i bstan bcos kyis bshad zin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyogs gnyis pa lam tsam brjod byar bsdus pa ltar na spang bya dang 'brel ba'i lam 6ma mam/ spang bya dang ma 'brel ba'i lam tsam bsdus/ dang po ltar na spang bya sred pa lta bu

gcig la de'i bdag rkyen dmigs rkyen mtshungs ldan sogs dgos pas gzhi la brjod pa'i nyes pas reg go /gnyis pa ltar na/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ kun nas nyon mongs pas mtshon pa'i sgrib pa gsum ma bsdus par thal/ gnyen po lam tsam brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i phyir khyod la brten nas lam gsum po de sgrib pa gsum po gang gi gnyen po gang yin khong du chud par mi 'gyur ro/ /dper na nad ngo ma shes par de'i gnyen po sman ngo ma shes pa bzhin no/ /phyogs gsum pa rnam pa tsam bsdus pa ltar na gzhi dang 'brel ba'am ma 'brel ba'i rnam pa tsam bsdus/ dang po ltar na gzhi la brjod pa'i nyes pas reg go /gnyis pa ltar na/ chos can/ khyod la brten nas don rtogs pa med par thal/ rnam pa gzhi med pa tsam brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i phyir skyes bu la mkho ba'i don cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal lo/ /'dod na/ de'i phyir khyod brtsams pa don med par thal lo/ /phyogs bzhi pa ltar na/ chos can/ bstan bcos rdzas tha dad pa gsum du thal/ mkhyen pa gsum ka brjod byar bsngas pa'i phyir/ des na brjod bya med pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa mi 'thad do snyam du blo dman gzhan dag sems par 'gyur ba ma yin nam zhe na/ lan la de lta bu'i skyon med pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgyu mtshan de'i

༄༅/ khes byed dgod/ shes byed de'i don bshad/ mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa gang rung re re kho nar brjod byar bsdus pa'i skyon de ni yod pa ma yin te/ mkhyen pa gsum ka brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gang gi phyir na nyan rang gi mngon rtogs mtha' dag gzhi shes kyis bsdus/ byang sems chen po'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag lam shes kyis bsdus/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs mtha' dag rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus pas na/ mkhyen gsum gyi yul gsum char bsdus la/ der ma zad yul phyogs gsum char gyis kyang mkhyen gsum dang 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /chos can/ mkhyen gsum brjod byar bsdus na bstan bcos rdzas tha dad pa gsum du 'gyur mi dgos par thal/ khyod mkhyen gsum brjod byar bsdus na gang zag gcig gis sangs rgyas 'thob par byed pa'i thabs rdzogs par ston pa'i bstan bcos gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na / de'i sgrub byed du yum bar ma'i lung dang / bsdus pa dang / rgyas pa'i lung drang ba gsum/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus te/ rgyu

mtshan 'di ltar bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i yum bar ma stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa las/ rab 'byor chos thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no/ /lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no zhes pa'i lung de brjod bya don mthun yin pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du thams cad shes pa nyid ni theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs lags zhe na/ nyan thos nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi nang nas mdzes shing mchog tu gyur pas na rab/sems kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yod pas na rab 'byor zhes pos nas/ thams cad ni phyi dang nang gi phung khams skye mched kyi chos rnams ji snyed pa 'di tsam kho na yin la/ de dag kyang nyan thos 'phags pa dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni rang bzhin ma dmigs par shes kyis theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad kyi yon tan skyed rdzogs dngos su byed pa yang ma yin/ rnam pa'i rdzas rigs ma lus pang thamos cad du shes pa yang ma yin pa de'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ nyan thos 'phags pa dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni thams cad shes pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du lam shes pa nyid ni byeng sems chen po rnams

༄༅/ /kye marngan rtags lags zhe na/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po rnams kyis ni nyan thos kyi theg pa gang yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi lam ste theg pa chen po gang yin pa'i theg pa thams cad yon tan yar ldan du skyed par byed cing rang bzhin ma dmigs par shes par byed la/ theg chen du ma zad theg pa chung 'bring gi spang rtogs de dag kyang yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / byang sems chen po de dag gi lam gyi bya ba mnyam bzhag tu sgrib pa spong ba dang / rjes thob tu sems can gyi don byed pa yang byed la/ de ltar byed kyang byang sems chen po de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' de kho na nyid rang bzhin gyi yum de mngon du mi bya'o zhes spyir btang nas/ dmigs kyis bsal ba ni/ dus nam gyi tshe mngon du mi bya'o zhe na/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas sems can yongs su smin par ma byas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs bar du'o zhes pa ni dngos bstan dgag pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /dus gtan du mi bya'am zhe na/ ma yin te/ byang sems de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du bya'o zhes spyir btang nas/ dus nam gyi tshe bya zhe na/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byas sems can yongs su smin par byas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su spyangs par byas pa de'i tshe bya'o zhes pa ni shugs bstan

bsgrub pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyis ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya'o/ /theg pa gsum gyi spangs rtogs sa gang du rdzogs/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa sogs gang zhe na/ nyan rang gi spangs rtogs sa dang por rdzogs te/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems chen pos bskal pa grangs med pa gcig tu chos dbyings bsgoms pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab ste/ rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bus bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags pas rang byang chub mngon du byas pa'i phyir dang / nyan thos myur na srid pa gsum gyi mtha' grol ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam grub pa ni smon lam gyi gtso bo rdzogs pa'i phyir/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de na rang gi skus dngos su gdul ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams sgrib pa dngos su spong rung dang gnyen po dngos su skye rung du byas pa'i sems can yongs su smin par byas pa'o/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de gser gyi sa gzhi la sogs par snang ba ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su srungs pa'o/ /ngag don bsdus na/ byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa yin te/ theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad yon tan yar ldan du bskyed rdzogs byed cing / rdzogs smin

༄tsho/ /ma sbyangs par yang dag pa' mtha' mngon du me byed par lam gyi bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ chos can/ 'khor ba'i mthar lhung ba ma yin te/ theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad yon tan yar ldan du shes bskyed rdzogs par byed cing lam gyi bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ chos can/ myang 'das kyi mthar lhung ba min te/ rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed par gzhan don byed pa'i phyir/'phags pa'i dgongs pa kho bos shes/ /gzhan las lhag pa'i bsdus don yin/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs lags zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yin te/ chos rnams rab tu mtshon pa'i rnam rtags mtshan ma de dag ma lus par khyod kyis thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ rnam pa ni ngo bo/ rtags ni 'bras bu/ mtshan ma ni rgyu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yum bar ma las gsungs pa de bzhin du mdor bsdus pa brgyad stong pa las kyang gsungs so/ /gang na mkhyen rnya 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa'i tshul lo/rī/ji ltar na nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa ste theg

pa chen po'i spangs rtogs bsgrub par 'dod pas yum rnam par mi rtog nyams su blang bar bya'o zhes so/ /ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag bsdus pa yin te/ theg pa gsum gyi spangs rtogs bsgrub par 'dod pas yum rnam par mi rtog pa nyams su blang dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bar ma dang bsdus pa las gsungs pa de bzhin rgyas pa 'bum las kyang rgya cher gsungs so/ /ngag don sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi ngo bo ston pa'i mdo bkod pa de la gzhi shes ston pa'i mde'i don ni/ gzhi shes chos can/ gzugs sogs la bdag tu rmongs pa ci rigs pa spangs pa'i 'bras bu can yin te/ gzugs sogs mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med la sogs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ lam shes ston pa'i mde'i don ni/ lam shes chos can/ sems can sngar 'khor du ma bsdus pa rnams sdud/ bsdus zin smin/ smin zin grol bar byed pa'i 'bras bu can yin te/ theg pa gsum po thams cad kyi spangs rtogs yon tan yar ldan du bskyed rdzogs byed pa'i sgo nasanges par 'byung ba dang / rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' de kho na nyid mngon du mi byed par gzhan don byed pa'i rten can yin pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen ston pa'i mde'i

༄0/ /don ne/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa chos can/ don gnyis kyi 'bras bu can yin te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mngon du gyur pa'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ don gnyis ni/gzhan don rgya che ba nam mkha' khams kyi mthas gtugs par ngo bo gang la gang phan tshun 'bad med lhun grub/ dus rgyun mi 'chad par sems can gyi don byed pa'i phrin las so/ /rang don ni/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du gyur pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang / yang srid par mtshams sbyor ba'i rgyu sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par spangs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyu mtshan de lta bas na mngon rtogs rgyan chos can / 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs ril po rdzogs par bstan pa yin te/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa mtha' dag brjod byar bsdus pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam zhes sogs kyis 'chad pa la / ngag gi dgos 'brel gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ zhes pa nas/ bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad gnyis chos can/ byams mgon rang gi bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi brjod bya dang dgos pa dang dgos pa'i dgos pa dang dgos pa gnyis ston pa'i tshig gi khongs na yod pa'i 'brel ba rnams gsungs te/ de rnams khyod kyi brjod bya yin

pa'i phyir/ chos can/ rgyan gyi dgos sogs chos bzhi bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ de rnams gsungs par brten nas khyod kyi gdul bya blo gros dman pa 'ga' zhig rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la dad pa'i sems can la phan 'dogs par bzhed pa'i thugs rje can sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum de dang de las yum gyi mdo'i don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi rim pa mtha' dag gsal bar mdzad zin pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma rgyal ba spang bya las rgyal ba byams pas yang yum don de bstan pa la don med dam snyam du dogs pa bsal nas byams pas yum don bstan pa la dgos pa yod dam snyam pa'i the tshom bskyed pa'i sgo nas rgyan la 'jug pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mdor na/ de rnams gsung ba la brten nas khyod kyi gdul bya 'ga' zhig mngon rtogs rgyan la don med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal nas de la don yod snyam pa'i the tshom bskyed pa'i sgo nas rgyan la 'jug pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i phyir/ des na bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi brjod bya dang / dgos pa dang nying dgos dang 'brel pa bzhi bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya/ dgos 'brel ngag 'di la brten nas mngon rtogs rgyan la dgos sogs med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal nas dgos sogs yod dam snyam pa'i the tshom dang / nges pa dang gzhung

༄༅// /mdzes pa bskyed pa de dngos kyi dgos pa/ de la brten nas rgyan la zhugs pa ngag gi brgyud pa'i dgos pa nying dgos/ de dngos kyi dgos pa las byung / de ngag las byung ba n-i 'brel ba'o/ /bsdus don ni/ rgyan gyi dgos sogs chos bzhi gang zhe na/ rgyan la brten nas blo ldan byang chub sems dpas chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi mdo don bde blag tu rtogs pa de bya ba bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom pa'i dngos kyi dgos pa yin no/ /rgyan gyi gdul bya blo ldan byang chub sems dpas rgyan las chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas gzhan gyis ma myangs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang yin pa de mngon sum du byas pa de rgyan rtsom pa'i brgyud pa'i dgos pa nying dgos yin no/ /nying dgos dngos kyi dgos pa las/ dngos kyi dgos pa rgyan las byung ba ni 'brel pa'o/ /chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi mdo don rnams brjod bya yin no/ /tshig don la slob dpon ltar na bzhi las/ brjod bya ni/ spyod pa ste bstan to/ /gang na brjod byar bya ba nyid du'o/ /gang las na rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum po 'di las so/ /gang gis na cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas 'gro ba mtha' dag la yum don rjes su bstan par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyis so/ /gad na rnamago

cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud kyi lam yin la/ de dang gzhan mngon rtogs bdun 'khor dang bcas pa rnams so/ /mngon rtogs gzhan rnams brjod bya yin na rnam mkhyenagacig pusprosapa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ rnam mkhyen brjod byar bstan pas mngon rtogs gzhan thams cad brjod byar nye bar mtshon cing lhur len pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /cho 'phrul gsum gang zhe na/ sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pas dad par byed/ thugs kun rjod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis bsam gtan dang bag la nyal mkhyen nas smin par mdzad/ gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis rjes su mthun pa'i chos bstan nas grol bar mdzad pa'o/ /mdor na/ yum gsum dang 'di las bstan pa'i don thams cad chos can/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi brjod bya yin te/ de'i bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'brel pa ni/ rjod byed mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ brjod bya mngon rtogs brgyad dang 'brel ba yod de/ khyod de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs dang / de khyod kyis bsgrub par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ des na rjod byed rgyan dang / brjod bya mngon rtogs brgyad thabs dang thabs kyis bsgrub par bya ba'i tshul gyis 'brel pa ni 'brel ba'o/ /nying dgos ni/ mthong bas te mngon sum byed par 'gyur ro/ /gang na/ gzhan phyi rol pa

༄༅/ /dang da las tsag shes chags bral nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang / sogs pa nyan thos dang theg 'bring slob pa rnams kyis ma myangs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de'o/ /ngag dor/ phyi rol pa dang nyan rang rnams chos can/ khyod kyis thos bsam sgom gsum las byung ba'i shes rab skye ba'i rim gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de ma myongs pa yin te/ rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan pas chos thams cad bdag med pa la goms par ma byas pa'i phyir/ gang gis na/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa gzhan ci la yang rag ma las par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu chas pa'i blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' kho nas dngos su'o/ /gang la brten nas na/ rgyan las yum gyi mdo'i don ma lus pa mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'jug pa'i spyod pa byang chub kyi sems dang / de dang ldan pa'i sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos bcu sgrub pa'i spyod pa nyams su myong ba shin tu gsal bas bzhag pa'i bag chags las byung ba'i dran pa'i shes pa la legs par bzhag pa la brten nas so/ /ji ltar na chos dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid sa rab dga' dang / sogs pa chos dbyings mchog gi don du rtogs pa sa dri ma med pa/ chos dbyings rgyu mthun pa'i don du mchog tu rtogs pa sa 'od byed pa/ chos dbyings yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i

don du rtogs pa sa 'od 'phro ba/ chos dbyings rgyud tha dad med pa'i don du rtogs pa sa sbyangs dka' ba/ chos dbyings nyon mongs pa dang rnam dag med pa'i don du rtogs pa sa mngon du gyur pa chos dbyingasatha dad med pa'i don du rtogs pa sa ring du song ba/ chos dbyings 'phel 'grib med pa dang rnam par mi rtog pa dang zhing yongs su dag pa la dbang ba'i don du rtogs pa sa mi g.yo ba/ chos dbyings ye shes la dbang ba'i rten du rtogs pa sa legs pa'i blo gros/ chos dbyings las la dbang ba'i rten du rtogs pa sa chos kyi sprin te/ sa bcu rim gyis rtogs pa la brten nas spangs rtogs kyi rigs rnam pa thams cad do/ /mdor na / gzhan phyi rol pa dang nyan rang rnams kyis ma myongs pa'i rnam mkhyen te/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa gzhan ci la yang rag ma las pa'i byang chub sems dpas rgyan las yum don rtogs pa dran pa la bzhag nas sa bcu rim gyis rtogs nas mngon sum du byas pa de bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dgos pa'i yang dgos pa nying dgos yin no/ /ngag don/ rgyan las mdo don rtogs pa dran pa la bzhag nas sa bcu rim gyis rtogs nas rnam mkhyen mngon du byas pa de chos can/ rgyan gyi dgos pa'i yang dgos pa yin te/ rang rgyu rgyan gyi dngos kyi dgos pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ dgos pa ni/ mthong

༄༅/ /bas te rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi ched du na/ nying dgos de'i phyir te ched du'o/ /gang na/ mngon par 'dod par bya ba'i yum gyi mdo'i don 'jug pa'i spyod pa byang chub kyi sems sgrub pa'i spyod pa phar phyon drug /grub pa'i spyod pa chos sku phrin las dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid rnams so/ /gang gis na/ rgyan gyi gdul bya blo ldan rnams kyis so/ /ji ltar na 'bad rtsol med par bde blag tu'o/ /des na rgyan la brten nas rgyan gyi gdul byas mdo don bde blag tu rtogs pa'i rtogs pa de bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan rtsom pa'i dngos kyi dgos pa yin no/ /ngag don/ bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/khyod rtsom pa la dgos pa yod pa yin te/ khyod thos pa la brten nas khyod kyi gdul bya blo ldan rnams kyis mdo don bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos la/ rgyas pa la dad pa'i don du yum brgyad du phye nas bstan/ bar pa la dad pa'i don du yum drug tu bsdus nas bstan/ bsdus pa la dad pa'i don du yum gsum du bsdus nas bstan pa'o/ /dang po la/ bsdus don lus rnam gzhag tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po la dgos pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ dgos ldan lus bshad/ bshad pa'i bsdus don/ lus rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/

byams pa mgon po nyid kyis brjod bya dgos 'brel bzhi bsnyad nas de'i rjes su tshog le'ur byas pa bco lngas mdo dang rgyas par bstan pa'i sgo nas yum gyi lus rnam gzhag gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan dang dgos rnga/ yod de/yum gyi lus rnam gzhag la brten nas gdul bya nyan pa po rnams kyis yan lag rgyasabashad rnams bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'chad pa po rnams kyis bstan bcos kyi don lus rnam gzhag rnam par dbye ba byas pa yang bshad pa bya sla bar gzigs nas de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyan gyi lus rnam gzhag chos can/ khyod la brten nas 'chad pos yan lag rgyas bshad bshad sla ba yin te/ khyod la brten nas 'chad pa pos yan lag rgyas bshad ma 'dzings par shes pa nyid kyis so/ /gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ bshad do/ /gang na/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i yum na'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ dngos po brgyad du phye ba'i sgo nas so/ /ji ltar na/ yang dag par phyin ci ma log par ro/ /gang gis na/ byams pa mgon pos so/ /gang gi don du na/ rgyas pa la dad pa'i gdul bya'i don du'o / /ngag don/ byams mgon chos can/ yum dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas yang dag par bshad de/ yum skabs brgyad kyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i phyir/ dngos po brgyad gang zhe na/ dang

༄༅/ /por rnam mkhyen/ de nas lam shes/ de nas thams cad shes pa/ de nas rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ de nas rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba/ de nas mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ de nas skad tsag ma gcig la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rgyu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ de nas chos kyi sku bstan te/ de ltar rnam pa brgyad do/ /brgyad po ji ltar bshad ce na/ gnyis pa la brgyad las/ rnam mkhyen ni/bshad do/ /gang na/ yum thub pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /gang gis na/ byams pas so/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ dang por sems bskyed dang / de nas gdams ngag dang / de nas nges 'byed cha mthun dang / de nas sgrub pa'i rten dang / de nas sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang / de nas sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba dang / de nas go cha'i sgrub pa/ de nas 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ de nas tshogs kyi sgrub pa/de nas nges khrung sgrub pa ste rnam pa r+sā'i sgo nas yang dag par ro/ /ngag don/ byams mgon chos can/ yum rnam mkhyen de dngos po kho'i sgo nas yang dag par bshad de/ de gdul bya dbang rtul la sems bskyed dang nges yang sgrub pa'i bar rgyas par gad pa'i sgo nas phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i phyir/ lam shes ni/ stod do/ /gang na/ byang chub sems dpa' lam gsum gyi gnas lugs 'a kho

rnams kyi lam shes nyid ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ mog mog por byed pa la sogs pa yan lag dang / slob ma nyan thos dang / bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / 'di phyi'i yon tan gyi sgo nas phan yon che mthong lam dang / byed pa dang mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang / mos pa'i phan yon bstod bkur bsngags pa dang / bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang / rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang / sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam ste dngos po bcu gcig po de 'dra'i sgo nas so/ /ji ltar na yang dag par ro/ /ngag don sngar gyi rigs 'gre'o/ /gzhi shes ni/ bshad do/ /gang na yum kun shes nyid ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ dang por srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang / de nas ring ba dang nye ba'i gzhi shes dang / de nas mi mthun phyogs dang /de nas gnyen po'i phyogs dang / de nas sbyor ba dang / de nas mnyam nyid dang / de nas nyan thos dang / sogs pa rang sangs rgyas dang / byang sems kyi mthong lam bstan pa ste dngos po dgu po de 'dra ba'i sgo nas yang dag par ro/ /rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni/ bshad do/ /gang na/ rnam pa kun mngon par rtogs pa 'thob pa'i rgyu yum rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ dang po rnam pa dang / de nas

༄༅/ /sbyor ba dang / de nas bcas pa sbyor ba po dang / de nas yon to dang / de nas skyon dang / de nas mtshan nyid dang / de nas thar pa cha mthun dang / de nas nges 'byed cha mthun dang / de nas slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs dang / de nas srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/ de nas zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ de nas thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa ste dngos po bcu gcig gi sgo nas yang dag par ro/ /rtse sbyor ni/ bshad do/ /gang na yum rtse ma'i sbyor ba ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ dang por drod kyi rtse sbyor rtags dang bcas pa dang / de nas rtse mo'i rtse spyor rnam 'phel dang bcas pa/ de nas bzod pa'i rtse sbyor brtan pa dang bcas pa/ de nas chos mchog rtse sbyor sems kun tu gnas pa dang bcas pa/ de nas mthong lam rtse sbyor rnam par rtog pa bzhi'i gnyen po dang bcas pa/ de nas sgom lam rtse sbyor rnam par rtog pa bzhi'i gnyen po dang bcas pa/ de nas bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor log sgrub dang bcas pa bstan pa ste dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas yang dag par ro/ /mthar gyis pa ni/ bshad do/ /gang na yum mthar gyis pa) spyo༄ / /gang gi sgo nas na/ gsum dang bcu ste dngos po bcu gsum gyi sgo nas yang dag par ro/ /skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni/ bshad do/ /gang na/ yum skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni'o/ /gang gi

sgo nas na/ ngo bo gcig la mtshan nyid de ldog pa mi 'dra ba nyid kyi sgo nas rnam pa bzhi ste dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas yang dag par ro/ /chos sku ni/ brjod do/ /gang na yum chos sku ni'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ wadang por ngo bo nyid kyi sku yon tan dang bcas pa dang / de nas longs sbyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dpe dang bcas pa dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dpe dang bcas pa de bzhin du de las gzhan sprul sku mtshan dpe dang bcas pa dang / de nas mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas yang dag par ro/ /gsum pa ni/ lus rnam gzhag la tshigs bcad bco lnga yod pa de la de'i nang nas shes nas brgyad kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis chos can/ khyod kyis yum gyi lus mdor bstan pa yin te/ khyod kyis yum gyi lus dngos po brgyad du bsdus nas don bdun cu'i dang por bstan pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed nas brjod kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa bcu gsum chos can/ khyod kyis yum gyi lus rgyas par bshad de/ khyod kyis dngos po brgyad kyi don don bdun cur bsdus nas dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ shes nas brjod kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa bco lnga chos can/ khyod kyis yum gyi lus legs par bshad pa yin te/ khyod kyis yum gyi lus bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis kyi sgo nas yang dag par bshad pa'i phyir/ 'grel chung don

༄༅/ /gsal rtsom mkhan gyi slob dpon seng ge bzang po chos can/ nyid kyis 'grel chung 'dir yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gong du bsdus don lus rnam gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams rnam par ma bkrol ba la rgyu mtshan yod de/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi tshig le'ur byas pa de dag rnam par bshad pas lus rnam gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa bshad par bsams shing yan lag rgyas bshad kyi 'grel pa dang zlos pa'i nyes pa 'gyur du dogs nas 'grel chung 'dir yan lag rgyas bshad kyi gong du lus rnam gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i phyir/ bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan mdzad pa po byams pa nyid kyis/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i yan lag rgyas bshad kyi bstan bcos mtha' dag chos can/ khyod rgyas par bshad na rgyan gyi lus rnam gzhag bshad pa yin te/ khyod kyis rgyan gyi lus rnam gzhag de rgyas par 'chad pas so/ /slob dpon gyi 'di ni dpyad na shin tu rigs par snang ngo / /gnyis pa la/ yul mkhyen pa gsum/ rgyu sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku dang gsum/dang po la/ 'bras bu thun mong ma yin pa rnam mkhyen/ rgyu thun mong ma yin pa lam shes/ blang dor thun mong ma yin pa gzhi shes so/ /dang po la/ rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi sgo nas

rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'di nas skabs dag gi mgo bzung ba yin la/ de la mtshams sbyor gyi tshig dngos shugs la thob pa so lnga yod la/ 'di rnam mkhyen dang por ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas spyi'i mtshams sbyor yin pas/ bshad par bzhed do/ /gang na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /gang gi sgo nas na rnam mkhyen brjod byar bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang nas/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ ces pa'i bar rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /dus nam gyi tshe na gong du bshad pa de ltar bsdus pa'i don lus rnam gzhag kun bstan nas de'i rjes su'o/ /skabs gang du na/ skabs brgyad kyi nang nas dang por ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/ 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ched du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ des thob par bya dgos pas so/ /ngag don ni/ 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa chos can/ khyod skabs brgyad kyi nang nas dang por bshad pa rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod byang sems chen pos thob par bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis skabs brgyad kyi nang nas dang por bshad pa'i phyir/ byang sems chen pos thob par bya dgos te/ de'i ched du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu

༄༅/ /yin pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam pa thams cad rang bzhin ma dmigs par mngon sum rtogs pa'i don gnyis mthar phyin/ sa mtshams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na yod/ de mtshon byed kyi chos bcu po gang zhe na/ gnyis pa la/ lam gyi rten sems bskyed/ dag byed gdams ngag /sbyor ba nges 'byed cha mthun/ rgyu rigs/ yul dmigs pa/ 'bras bu ched du bya ba/ lam rang gi ngo bo sgrub pa dang bdun/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul/ rab dbye/ sa mtshams sbyar ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ ces gsungs pa la gsum las/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos de yang sems bskyed pa la sogs pa bcu las dang po'i sems bskyed pa rang gi ngo bo gang la dmigs pa'i yul dang bcas pa 'chad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sems bskyed pa ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i lo thog dang por skye ba la sa bon/ bar du spel ba la chu/ mthar longs spyod pa la smin pa lta bur gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /don dngos ni/ rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su grub nas gzhan don gyi ched du gdul bya'i skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du 'bad

par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi dkar po yid shes mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed du mtshon/ gzhan don gyi phyir te ched du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi gtso bo rnam rig yin la/ dbye na/ gzhan don gyi ched du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa mtshungs ldan gang zhig /bsam pa gtso bor gyur pa theg chen gyi smor pa sems bskyed/gzhan don gyi ched du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan nam/ de lta bu'i 'dun pa las byung ba'i gtso bo rnam rig gang zhig /sbyor ba gtso bor gyur pa theg chen gyi 'jug pa sems bskyed yin la/ sa mtshams dang po'i ma mtha' lam ma zhugs kyi rgyud la'ang yod la/ ya mtha' sa bcu rgyun mtha' man chad na yod/ rgyun mtha' na med/ gnyis pa theg chen tshogs lam nas sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ bsam pas smon par byed/ sbyor bas 'jug par byed pas gzhi mthun srid do/ /mtshungs ldan ni/ grogs 'dun pa dang / dmigs pa gzhan don dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs par mtshungs/ rnam pa gzhan don dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rnam pa snang bar mtshungs/ dus gcig grub dus na gcig grub par mtshungs/ rten snying rje tshogs pa gcig las skye bar mtshungs/ ngo bo gtso

༄༅/ /sems gcig las med pa bzhin du grogs 'dun pa yang gcig las med par mtshungs pa'o/ /brgal lan la rgol ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa de chos can/ sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ khyod rdzogs pa'i byang chub de don du gnyer ba dge ba'i chos byang chub la 'dun pa sems las byung ba yin la/ sems bskyed pa ni yul khyad par du 'phags pa gzhan don dang byang chub la dmigs par snang ba can du 'byung ba'i sems yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ lan ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod ces pa'i sgras dngos zin gyi 'dod pa'i ming can de sems byung 'dun pa dngos yin na/ sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa yod pa bden mod/ 'on kyang sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ston pa'i skabs 'dir 'dun pa'i ming gis sems bskyed la btags pa yin pas/ sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa med do/ /de la rgyu 'dun pa'i ming gis 'bras bu sems bskyed la btags pa dang / grogs 'dun pa'i ming gis grogs can sems bskyed la btags pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu 'dun pa'i ming gis 'bras bu sems bskyed la btags pa yin te/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dge ba'i chos byang chub la 'dun pa'i ngo bo byang chub don gnyer yod na 'bras bu byang chub kyi sem sta —bskyedaskyeba'irgyu mtshan

gyis so/ /dgos pa ni/ de ltar bstan pas rgyu byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa las byang chub don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i chos 'bras bu sems bskyed thams cad 'phel bar shes pa'i phyir /wadangos la gnod byed ni de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ngag don ni/ byams mgon chos can/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod ces pa'i sgras dngos zin gyi 'dod pa'i ming can de sems byung 'dun pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sems byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa yod pa ma yin te/ de 'dod pa'i ming gis sems bskyed la btags pa yin pas so/ /byang sems chen po'i sems bskyed chos can/ khyod la rang rgyu rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod pa yin te/ de yod na khyod skye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la de'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa'i phyir/ chos can / khyod la de'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ de ltar bstan pas khyod de las 'phel bar shes pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod de dngos ma yin te/ khyod de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ gzhan ming gis 'dogs tshul rnam grangs gcig tu na grogs smon lam ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i 'dod pa yin la/ de'i sgrar sems bskyed pa bstan pa yin pas sems

༄༅/ /byung sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bkod pa'i nyes pa med do/ /'o na chos gsum po gang zhe na/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan byang sems chen po'i sems bskyed ni grogs rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dod pa de dang yul rdzogs pa'i byang chub la lhan cig dmigs shing snying rje tshogs pa gcig las skye bar mtshungs la/ grogs don gnyer gtso che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /dgos pa de ltar bstan pas grogs smon lam rgyud la yod pa'i byang sems chen po rnams la grogs smon lam de dang ldan pa'i grogs can sems bskyed de skye bar shes pa'i phyir yin no/ /dngos la gnod byed de'i grogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ngag don ni/byang sems chen po'i sems bskyed chos can/ khyod la grogs rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dod pa'i sgrar bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod dang de gnyis lhan cig mtshungs par ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la de'i sgrar bstan pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod la de'i sgrar bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ de ltar bstan pas de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud la khyod skye bar shes pa'i phyir/ chos can/ de dngos ma yin te/de khyod kyi grogs yin pa'i phyir/ des na rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod ces pa'i sgras zin gyi 'dod pa'i ming can de ming 'dod pa'i ming can don sems bskyed dngos yin te/ mi byun po la ba lang du btags pa bzhin

no / /'dir 'dod pa'i ming gis sems bskyed la rgyu dang grogs kyi ming gis btags pa gnyis su nges te/ byang sems chen po'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dod pa ni rang 'bras sems bskyed kyi rgyu dang /grogs can sems bskyed kyi grogs su gyur pa'i 'dun pa gnyis su nges pa'i phyir ro/ /des na theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan nam / rgyu de lta bu'i 'dun pa las byung ba'i gtso bo rnam rig yin pa'o/ /kha cig sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems zer ba ni zhabrul te / nyan rang la yang sems bskyed med par thal zhing / theg chen gyi mnyam gzhag na yang sems bskyed med par thal/ de na gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa med pa'i phyir te/ chos nyid spros bral la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyas par gzhan du spro bar bya'o/ /dmigs yul ni/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod/ /ces pa'i tshigs 'di chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas gang 'dod pa'i bdag nyid gang yin/ gang

༄tsho/ /gi don du sems bskyed pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang / gzhan don de ni gang yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshigs su bcad pa phyed gsungs so/ /don bshad pa ni/ brjod pa ste bstan no / /gang na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub de dang gzhan don de ni'o/ /ji ltar na dkon mchog sna bdun la sogs pa'i mdo bzhin te mde'i don dang mi 'gal ba'o/ /gang las na/ dkon mchog sna bdun sogs las bshad par ma zad bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum char las kyang ngo / /gang gi sgo nas na/ bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas so/ /tshig gang gis na/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'dod pas yum la brtson par bya'o zhes pa'i byang chub shes par byed pa'i don can gyi ngag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsdus nas bstan te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yum du bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chen po mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis yum la gnas te sbyin par bya ba dang sbyin pa po dang len pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir yongs su gtong ba med pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /ltang ba dang mi lhung ba mi dmigs pa'i phyir tshul khrims dang / 'khrugs pa mi

dmigs pa'i phyir bzod pa dang / lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus nyams pa mi dmigs pa'i phyir brtson 'grus/ ro myang ba mi dmigs pa'i phyir bsam gtan/ shes rab dang shes reb 'chalabami dmigs pa'i phyir yum bsgrub par bya'o zhes rdzogs pa'i byang chub shes par byed pa'i don can gyi ngag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyas par bshad de/ phyin drug so sor phye nas bslab tshul dang bcas pa bstan pa'i phyir/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang sems chen pos phyogs bcu re re zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can ji snyed yod pa de thams cad skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pas yum bsgrub par bya'o zhes pa'i gzhan don rab tu ston pa lhur len pa'i ngag gis gzhan don bsdus nas bstan te/ sems can myang 'das la 'god pa'i thabs bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang sems chen pos sems can ser sna can rnams sbyin pa/ tshul khrims 'chal ba rnams tshul khrims/ gnod sems mang ba rnams bzod pa/ le lo can rnams brtson 'grus/ sems rnam par g.yeng ba can rnams bsam gtan/ shes rab 'chal ba rnams shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la 'god par 'dod pas yum bsgrub par bya'o zhes pa'i gzhan don rab tu ston pa

༄༅/ /brjod byar lhur len pa'i ngag chos can/ gzhan don rgyas par bstan te/ sems can myar stsol da pa'i thabs so sor phye nas blang dor dngabacasapabastanapa'iphyir/sermedabakrolarne/ ma shā ri yin pas shā ri'i bu/ yum bstan pa 'di la rang don gyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa yod pas byang chub sems dpa'/ gzhan don gyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa yod pas sems dpa' chen po/ ji lta ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag gis dag par mngon du gyur pas na chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa/ ji lta ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad gnas lugs ji ltar yin pa ltar rdzogs par mngon du gyur pas na chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o/ /de sgrub par 'dod pas yum mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang gzhung lam 'bras bu'i yum dang rang bzhin gyi yum stong nyid la bslab par bya'o zhes pa yin te/ mdo 'dis yum gsum gyi don thams cad bsdus nas gdul bya dbang rnon la rdzogs par bstan pa'i phyir/rdebaskyug pa'i byang chub ni pha rol tu phyan pa drug go /gzhan don ni sems can myang 'das rgyu 'bras la 'god pa'i phrin las byed pa po dang las la yod pa rnams so/ /'o na gzhung lam 'bras bu'i yum rnams 'di'i

yum yin na yum mtshan nyid pa yin nam zhe na/ gzhung lam gnyis kyi yum btags pa ba 'bras yum ni yum dngos yin te/ dang po gnyis ni chos thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam pa thob pa min la/ 'bras yum ni de thob pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des dri ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i lan bstan no/ /dang po'i lan ni/ rgyu mtshan de ltar na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sems bskyed chos can/ khyod dang mtshungs ldan gyi 'dun pa ni gzhan don gyi ched du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs nas zhen med sgyu ma ltar 'dod pa'i bdag nyid yin te/ khyod rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi 'dun pa de dang dmigs rnam mtshungs pa gang zhigakhyod gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs shing zhen med sgyu be+e lta bu'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ brgal lan la rgol ba ni/ gal te gzhan don dang byang chub mdo gzhan rnams las gsungs na/ 'dir shes byed kyi khungs su bri bar rigs so zhe na/ lan ni/ gtsug lag gi gzhung ste mdo skabs kyi don gzhan don dang byang chub ston pa brjod bya lhur len pa ni dkon mchog sna bdun sogs las bshad par ma zad/rgyas 'bring bsdus pa thams cad las kyang gsungs mod tshig mang du dogs nas mdo tshig thams cad shes byed kyi khungs nyid du ma bris pa yin gyi brjod mi nus pa'am ma gsungs pa min no/ /slob dpon chos can/

༄༅/ /'dir sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul ston pa'i mdo tshig thams cad ma bris pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshig mang du dogs nas 'dir de thams cad ma bris pa'i phyir/ dbye ba ni/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ zhes sogs kyis bshad pa la/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ byams mgon chos can/ nyid kyis sems bskyed pa dmigs pa rang gi ngo bo dang bcas pa brjod nas bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis sems bskyed pa de'i dbye ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis gsungs pa la dgos pa yod de/ de gsungs pa la brten nas sems bskyed pa'i dbye ba nyer gnyis bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs pa 'chad do/ /tshig don 'byed pa la/ sems bskyed dmigs yul mdo bzhin du bshad pa ma zad dbye ba de yang mdo bzhin du 'chad pa la/ dpe don sbyar ba dang / bsdus te bstan pa gnyis las/dang po ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ sa lta bu yin te/ rang 'bras chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi byed pa'i phyir/ phyin drug gi sgo nas gdul bya la 'di phyi la phan pa dang bde bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ gser bzang po lta bu yin te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du phan bde'i bsam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur

ba yin pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi steng du byang phyogs so bdun la gdul bya 'god pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ yar ngo'i zla ba tshes pa lta bu yin te/ khyod dge ba'i chos mtha' dag 'phel bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang na gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa chung ngu dang 'bring bsam pa dang chen po lhag pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ sa dang gser bzang po dang yar ngo'i zla ba tshes pa lta bu yin te/ rang 'bras dkar po'i chos thams cad kyi gzhi byed pa'i phyir dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du mi 'gyur ba'i sems yin pa'i phyir dang / khyod dge ba'i chos mtha' dag 'phel ba yin pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam sgom gsum gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du bsdus nas bsgom pa'i sbyor ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/me lta bu yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs pa yar ldan du thob pa la gegs byed pa'i rang gi spang bya sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang ma/tshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ gter chen po lta bu yin te/ zang zing gi longs spyod kyis sems can tshims par byed pa'i phyer/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs kyi gnas lta bu yin te/ rang 'bras yon

༄7/ /tan rin po che'i rten byed pa'i phyir/ bzod pa dang brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ rgya mtsho chen po dang rdo rje pha lam lta bu yin te/ mi 'dod pa thog tu babs kyang yid mi 'brugs par bzod pa 'phel ba'i phyir dang / byang chub rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa brtan pas bdud las kyis mi phyed par de 'joms par nus pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin dang mchungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ ri'i rgyal po lta bu yin te/ mtshan mar dmigs pa'i rnam g.yeng gis mi bskyod pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ sman chen po rtsi'i rgyal po mthong na dga' ba lta bu yin te/ sgrib gnyis kyi nad zhi bar byed pa'i phyir/ thabs la mkhas pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu yin te/ gnas skabs thams cad du sems can gyi don mi gtong bar byed pa'i phyir/ 'di tshad med bzhi mi zad pa/ dang po sems bskyed mi zad pa/ gnyis pa nas dgu pa'i bar 'dun pa nas shes rab kyi bar mi zad pa'o/ /smon lam gyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu yin te/ ci ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub pa'i phyir/ 'di mngon shes lnga mi zad pa'o/ /stobs kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ nyi ma

lta bu yin te/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis gdul bya yongs su smin par byed pa'i phyir/ 'di bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi mi zad pa'o/ /ye shes kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ dri za'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan pa lta bu yin te/ khyod las gdul bya 'dun par byed pa'i chos ston pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'di so so yang dag rig pa bzhi mi zad pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa lnga dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/rgya mtsho chen po lta bu yin te/ rton pa bzhis mthu thogs pa med pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i phyir/ 'di rton pa bzhi mi zad pa'o/ /tshogs gnyis dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ rdzas mang po bzhag pa'i bang mdzod lta bu yin te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mang po'i mdzod yin pa'i phyir/ 'di tshogs gnyis mi zad pa'o/ /byang phyogs so bdun dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ lam po che lta bu yin te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs shing rjes su gshegs pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di byang phyogs so bdun mi zad pa'o/ /snying rje dang lhag mthong dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/bzhon pa rta cang shes lta bu yin te/ mtha' gnyis su mi lhung bar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bde blag tu 'gro ba'i phyir/ 'di snying rje dang lhag mthong mi zad pa'o/ /gzungs spobs pa gnyis dang mtshungs ldan gyi

༄༅/ /sems ches can/ bkod ma'i chu lta bu yin te/ thos pa dang mthos pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i sgo nas mi zad par 'byin pa'i phyir/ 'di gzungs spobs gnyis mi zad pa'o/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi'i dga' ston dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ kun dga'i sgra snyan pa lta bu yin te/ thar pa 'dod pa'i gdul bya la chos kyi snyan pa sgrog pa'i phyir/ 'di sdom bzhi mi zad pa'o/ /mnyam rjes yul la 'jug tshul rnam par mi rtog pa'i rnam par gcig pas na bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mthar thug pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems chos can/ chu bo'i rgyun lta bu yin te/ gzhan don lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'di bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mi zad pa'o/ /chos sku bya grub ye shes dang mtshungs par ldan gyi sems chos can/ char sprin lta bu yin te/ thabs mkhas pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston nus pa'i phyir/ 'di thabs mkhas mi zad pa'o/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis ni/ dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa nas 'dir 'pho ba la sogs pa'o/ /rgyud bla ma las/ dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dges rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang

chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis chos can/ sems bskyed pa'i dbye ba rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis bshad pa yin te/ sems bskyed pa'i dpe dang grogs dang chos mthun nyi shu rtsa gnyis bstan pa de ltar na ste de'i phyir ro/ /sa mtshams ni/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis yod pa de la dang po gsum ni gtso cher las dang po pa'i sas bsdus so/ /ji ltar na dang po tshogs lam chung ngu / gnyis pa 'bring / gsum pa chen pos gtso cher bsdus so/ /de'i 'og ma gcig ni sa dang po pa la 'jug pa nges 'byed cha mthun sbyor ba'i lam gyis gtso cher bsdus so/ /de'i 'og ma bcu ni rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa bcus rim pa bzhin gtso cher bsdus te/ de rnams rim pa bzhin mthong lam dang sgom lam chung 'bring dgu la gtso cher spyod pa'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og ma lnga ni khyad par gyi lam dag pa sas gtso cher bsdus so/ /de'i 'og ma sems bskyed pa gsum ni sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus so/ /ji ltar na dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba'i lam dang / gnyis pa dngos gzhi mnyam bzhag dang / gsum pa mjug rjes thob

༄tsho/ /kyis bsdus so/ /mdor na sems bskyed pa'i rab dbye chos can/ las dang po pa'i sa nas sangs rgyas pa'i bar gyis bsdus pa yin te/ tshogs lam chung ngu nas sprul sku'i bar gyis bsdus pa de'i phyir / gnyis pa la spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni/ zhes sogs gsungs pa la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'dir sems bskyed pa bstan pa'i zhar la sems bskyed kyi dbye ba brjod nas/ de'i rjes su gdams ngag bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni sems bskyed kyi don du gnyer bya'i don bsgrub pa'i phyir du gdams ngag tshol bar byed pa'i phyir/ gdams ngag gi ngo bo gang zhe na/ 'doms so/ /gang la na sngar bstan pa de ltar byang chub kyi sems dang po nas gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs bskyed pa rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam ma thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la'o/ /sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam na 'dir bstan gyi gdams ngag slob dpon gzhan la don du gnyer ba med de/der rang byung gi ye shes dngos su bskyed nus pa'i phyir ro/ /dus nam gyi tshe na 'doms pa ji lta ba bzhin du don du gnyer ba'i tshe na'o/ /dgos pa sems bskyed dang sems bskyed des 'phangs pa'i chos chos dkar

po thams cad kyi gzhi byed pa la sogs pa dang / nges 'byed cha mthun la sogs pa'i yon tan de thob rung rnams 'grub pa dang / sngar thob zin pa rnams mi nyams par yongs su bsrung ba'i dbang gis gong nas gong du mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /gang gis na sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i skus so/ /des na theg chen sems bskyed kyi ched du gnyer bya'i don thob zin 'phel ba dang / thob rung 'grub pa'i thabs sam/ de lta bu'i thabs 'doms pa'i ngag ni theg chen gyi gdams ngag yin la/ dbye na bcu'i bdag nyid du shes par bya'o/ /bcu gang zhe na/ phye ste bshad pa dang / bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la bcu las/ sgrub pa la 'doms pa ni/ 'doms so/ /gdul bya byang chub kyi sems dang po dang gnyis pa sogs bskyed pa'i byang sems chen po tshogs lam pa la/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i skus/dus 'doms pa ji lta ba bzhin du don du gnyer bar byed pa'i tshe na/ dgos pa yon tan thob rung 'grub pa dang / thob zin 'phel ba'i phyir dang / khyad par du sgrub pa mthar thug pa bya ba'i phyir du/ yul theg chen gyi sgrub pa la'o/ /tshul yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bas yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi tshul gyis 'jug par bya'o zhes slob pa'i tshul gyis 'doms pas 'jug par bya'o/ /gang la na sngar ji skad bshad

༄༅/ /pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dbye ba nyer gnyis kyi bslab bya nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa la'o/ /gang na tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems chen pa'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ spyod pa po byang sems / spyad bya yum/ spyad 'bras byang chub/ shes bya phung po lnga rnams la/ ma brtags ma dpyad na kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bas/ de rnams ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i ngo na dmigs shing /spyod pa po byang sems sogs brtags shing dpyad na don dam pa'i bden pa las mi 'da' bas de rnams brtags shing dpyad na mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / ched du bya ba dang / sbyor ba dang / rtogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang thun mong ma yin pa sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'da' ba'i ched du/ rtogs pa chos sku thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sbyor ba phar phyin drug rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs te/ de lta bu'i thabs shes kyi sgo nas so/ /ngag don ni/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe zhes pa nas yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas mngon par mi zhen to zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo chos can/ sgrub pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bas yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi tshul gyis sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o zhes slob pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung yin pa'i phyir/ de byed pa po

la yod pa'i gdams ngag /de ltar bslab pa ltar nyams su len pa'i nyams len gyi cha de las la yod pa'i gdams ngag go /tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems chen po chos can/ sgrub pa nyams su len tshul nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin te/ sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'da' ba'i ched du chos sku thob par bya ba'i phyir du sgrub pa thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams su len pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bden pa la 'doms pa la/ sdug bden la 'doms pa ni/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la 'doms so/ /gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ dgos pa spyir sngar bzhin la bye brag tu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la shes byar zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir du/ tshul rang rgyu las nyon gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i gzugs sogs kyi stong nyid yul can yum rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gnyis spros bral de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bor rang bzhin dbyer med par rtogs la shes par gyis shig ces ston pa'i tshul gyis so/ /ngag don ni/ gzugs stong pa nyid la brtson na brtson zhes bya'o zhes sogs kyi mdo chos can/ sdug bden la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ 'bras bur gyur pa'i gzugs sogs rnams shes bya shes byed kyi spros bral du rtogs la shes par gyis shig ces ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung yin pa'i phyir/ las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i snod bcud kyi 'jig rten mtshan

༄༅/ /gzhe / sdug bsngal bden par mtshon/ rang rgyu las nyon gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i zag bcas/ dbye na sdug bsngal gsum/ sa mtshams sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ kun 'byung bden pa la 'doms pa ni/ kun 'byung bden pa la 'doms so/ /gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ bye brag tu kun 'byung la spang byar zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir du'o/ /tshul rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i gzugs sogs ni yin/ lugs la skye 'gag dang spang gnyen dang ldan pa'i chos ma yin par rtogs la spongs shig ces pa'i ston pa'i tshul gyis so/ /ngag don/ gzugs skye ba'i chos can nam 'gag pa'i chos can du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes sogs kyi mdo chos can/ kun 'byung bden pa 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i gzugs sogs ni yin lugs la skye 'gag spang gnyen dang ldan pa'i chos can ma yin par rtogs la spongs shig ces ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung yin pa'i phyir/ rgyur gyur pa'i gzugs sogs chos can/ yin lugs la skye 'gag spang gnyen dang ldan pa'i chos can ma yin te/ yin lugs la stong nyid dang tha mi dad cing dbyer med pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa mtshan gzhi/ kun 'byung bden par mtshon/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i zag bcas/ dbye

ne nyon mongs pa dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i las gnyis/ sa mtshams sa bcu rgyun mtha' bar chad med lam gyi snga logs man na yod/ 'gog bden la 'doms pa ni/ 'gog bden la 'doms so/ /gzhan sngar bzhin la/ bye brag tu 'gog bden la mngon du bya ba'i chos su zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir du'o/ /tshul yin lugs la gzugs su ma grub pa nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du ma grub/ ma rig pa skye ba ma grub pa nas rga shi skye ba ma grub/ des kun nas nyon mongs bye brag dang spyi bkag /ma rig pa 'gag pa ma grub pa nas rga shi 'gag pa ma grub/ rgyun zhugs nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub kyi bar du yang ma grub par rtogs la mngon du gyis shig ces ston pa'i tshul gyis so/ /ngag don/ stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni mi skye mi 'gag ces sogs kyi mdo chos can/ 'gog bden la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin te / 'gog bden de yin lugs gzugs nas byang chub kyi bar gang du yang ma grub par rtogs la mngon du gyis shig ces bstan pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden chos can/ yin lugs gzugs nas byang chub kyi bar gang du yang grub pa min te/ yin lugs skye 'gag spang gnyen nyams 'phel dus gsum dang bral ba'i phyir te/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam pa'i

༄༅/ /rgyud kyi dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid mtshan gzhi/ 'gog bden du mtshon/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi bral 'bras su gyur pa'i rnam byang bden pa/ sa mtshams mthong lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ lam bden la 'doms pa ni/ lam bden la 'doms so/ /gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ bye brag lam bden rgyud la brten byar zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir du'o/ /tshul sbyin sogs dang bdag nyid brtson bya brtson byed yin min spros bral du rtogs la sgrub par bya'o zhes ston pa lam la 'doms pa yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni lam mchog yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nang rnam thar sgo gsum sgom pa po dang / phyi bsgom bya rnam thar sgo gsum bsgom bya sgom byed yin min spros bral du rtogs la bsgrub par bya'o zhes ston pa rigs sgrub la 'doms pa yin te/ rnam thar sgo gsum mngon sum du rtogs na mi rigs pa sgrib pa spong zhing /sems phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon gyi mtha' 'khor ba nas phyi ma'i mtha' myang 'das su nges 'byin yin min spros bral du rtogs la bsgrub par bya'o zhes ston pa nges 'byin la 'doms pa yin te/spros bral rtogs na 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'i phyir ro/ /ldan mi ldan ni yin min no/ /ma yin pa nyid du ni spros bral lo/ /ngag don ni/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la brtson zhes bya ba'am mi brtson zhes bya
