pa'i gzugs sku'i 'od kyis 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por mdzad pa ni nga rgyal mngon gyur pa bcom pa'i rgyu kho na la lam shes dngos su skye'o zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir mdzad pa yin pa de'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu lam shes de chos can/ dngos su skye ba'i yul so sor nges pa yin te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa kho na'i rgyud la dngos su skye ba yin pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ byang sems chen por ma zad khams gsum la sems 'dod chags dang bral ba nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang / zhi bgrod phyogs gcig pa'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can slob pa rnams dang / de las gcig shos phyi rol pa'i rnal 'byor pas kyang mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du gnas skabs rgyu lam shes bsgom par bya ba yin pas khyab pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/ skye bo sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chab kyi mthar thug par 'gro ba can yin te/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir ro/ /de mi 'thad de/ theg pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag mthar thug la ltos te nges don yin pa'i phyir zer na/ rtags ma grub ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa gsum du rnam par bzhag pa ni mthar thug la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can yin gyi nges don mtshan nyid pa ma yin no zhes mdo las don mthun du 'byung bas so/ /de la dgongs gzhi gnas skabs

༄tsho/ /nyan rang du rigs nges pa yod pa la dgongs/ dgos pa rigs can gsum drang ba'i don du/ dngos la gnod byed nyan rang gi rgyud la spangs rtogs mthar thug pa med pas gnod do/ /des na theg pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag ni mthar thug la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can yin no/ /ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang phyi rol pa'i rnal 'byor pas kyang 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du rgyu lam shes bsgom par bya ba yin pas khyab pa yin te/ sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug par 'gro ba can yin pa'i phyir te/ theg pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag ni mthar thug la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can yin gyi nges don mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa rgyu lam shes chos can/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa rnam pa thams cad du spangs pa ma yin pa de khyod kyi rang bzhin yin te/ khyod 'khor ba ji srid par sems can gyi don byed par zhugs pa'i slob lam yin pas so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin cing sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rjes bslangs te/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa gcig yin la/ de nyon mongs btags pa ba yin te/

'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rang rgyud ldan gyi skyes bu khams gsum du sbyor bar mtshungs pas so/ /dgos pa byang sems chen pos sems can mi 'dor bar shes/ dngos la gnod byed sems nye bar nyon mongs par byed pa ma yin pas so/ /de ltar blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pas der gzigs mdzod/ lnga pa ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa spangs pa ma yin pa'i rang bzhin can gyi lam shes chos can/ gzhan don byed pa'i las can yin te/ rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed cing thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas sems can sngar 'khor du ma bsdus pa 'khor du sdud/sngar ma smin pa smin par byed/ sngar ma grol bar grol bar byed pa yin pas so/ /shes bya chos can/ lam shes kyi rang bzhin bstan nas de'i 'og tu lam shes kyi byed las bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang bzhin can gyi lam shes las de'i byed las 'byung ba'i phyir/ mdor na/ lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ lam shes dngos su skye ba'i yul rten gyi gang zag lam shes kyi rang bzhin dang lam shes kyi byed las gang rung du gyur pa'i chos/ gnyis pa la nyan thos kyi lam dang / rang sangs rgyas kye lam dang / byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gsum/ dang po la shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang lam shes/ rgyu

༄༅/ /nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar lam shes kyi rten la sogs pa brjod nas nyan thos kyi lam dang de shes pa'i lam shes bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam shes skye ba'i rten las lam shes 'byung ba'i phyir/ chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su nyan thos kyi lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad rdzogs par bya dgos pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su gang zag byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos rnams kyi lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ 'phags pa'i bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /des na rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi lam yon tan yar ldan du bskyed cing rdzogs par byed pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /mtshan gzhi ni byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes lta bu'o/ /shes bya nyan thos lam gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan thos kyi byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyur pa/ dbye na nyan

thos kyi tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam dang lnga/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams gang zhe na/ mdo las rnam pa nyi shu rtsa drug gsungs pa de la/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa dang go rim bzhin du sbyar na/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la rnam pa bzhi ste/ skye zhing 'jig pas na mi rtag pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i zag pa dang bcas shing 'phags lam gyi mi mthun phyogs su gyur pas na sdug bsngal ba dang / don gzhan gyi bdage gis stong pas na stong pa'i mtshan nyid bdag med pa dang / ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag med pas na bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid zhi ba ste/ mdor na mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gnyis ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa dang ming don gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir/ 'dir sher phyin gyi mdo nas gsungs pa'i bdag med dang zhi ba gnyis rnam grangs kyi rnam pa yin te/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i stong pa la 'dir bdag med pa'i ming gis bstan/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i bdag med la 'dir zhi ba'i ming gis bstan pas don gcig ming tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ ngag don/ sdug bsngal bden pa chos can/ shes bya yin te/ mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med zhi ba yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod mi rtag sogs su bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod der bstan pas khyod la rtag bde sogs su 'dzin pa zlog pa'i phyir/ chos can/ mi

༄༅/ /rtag pa yin te/ skye zhing 'jig pa'i phyir/ des rigs 'gre'o/ /kun 'byung bden pa la rnam pa bzhi ste/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rgyu'i ngo bo ni nad lta bu'i rnam pa yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa'i kun 'byung ba dang rab skye dang / rkyen gyi ngo bo ni 'bras dang zug rngu dang sdig pa lta bu'i rnam pa yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun skyed byed yin pa'i phyir dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal rab tu drag tu skyed byed yin pa'i phyir dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal brgyud mar 'byung ba'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa chos can/ spang bya yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rab skye rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ nad dang / 'bras dang / zug rngu dang / sdig pa lta bu'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam du bden pa mngon sam du mthong bas sdug kun la yid 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir mthong lam gyi sbyor ba nges 'byed cha mthun la zhugs/ sgom lam du sdug kun gnyis la 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ sgom lam gyi sbyor ba mthong lam la zhugs/ mi slob lam du sdug kun gnyis 'gog par bya ba'i phyir/ mi slob lam gyi sbyor ba sgom lam la zhugs pa yin no zhes chos mngon pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i phyir/ sher phyin gyi mdo las sdug kun gnyis so so'i yid 'byung ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo pha

rol gnyen po'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa dang / gnyen pos 'jig pa'i chos can gyi rnam pa gnyis dang / sdug kun gnyis so so'i 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo/ rang gi ngo bo skad cig tsam yang gnas pa med pas g.yo ba dang / 'jig rgyu don gzhan la ltos med du 'jig pas rab tu 'jig pa'i rnam pa gnyis dang / sdug kun gnyis so so'i 'gog par bya ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo 'di phyi la gnod pa'i gnas su gyur pas na 'jigs pa dang / rgyud la nye ba tsam gyis sdug bsngal myong bar byed pas na nad 'go ba dang / phan bde'i nor 'phrog par byed pas na 'tshe ba'i rnam pa gsum ste/ rnam pa bdun po rnams gsungs so / /ngag don/ shes bya chos can/ sher phyin gyi mdo las pha rol dang 'jigs pa'i chos can dang / g.yo ba dang / rab tu 'jig pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'tsho ba'i rnam pa rnams gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sdug kun gnyis la yid 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba dang / 'gog par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa yin no zhes chos mngon pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i phyir/sngag kun gnyis chos can/ yid 'byung bar bya ba yin te/ pha rol gnyen po'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa dang / gnyen pos 'jig pa'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma gnyis rigs 'gre /'gog bden

༄༅/ /la rnam pa bdun te ma rig pa 'gog pa'i ngo bo/ yul can nyon mongs pas dben pas na yul bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal nye bar zhi bas na zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / bde zhing gtsang bas gya nom pa'i rnam pa'i bdag nyid sdug bsngal dang mi gtsang bas dben pa dang / gtan du phan pa'i gnas su nges par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid/ ji ltar nges par 'byung bar ni/ bdag dang bdag gi ba'i ngo bos stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas kyi mtshan ma med pa dang / khams gsum la smon pa med pa dang / gang nges par 'byung ba ni/ slar 'khor bar mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i rnam pa rnams so/ /'gog bden chos can / mngon du bya ba yin te/ 'gog pa dang / zhi ba dang / gya nom pa dang / nges 'byung gi rnam pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ yang na/ 'gog bden gyi chos bdag med sogs bdun chos cag 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ lam bden la rnam pa bzhi ste/ thar pa'i grong khyer du phyin par byed pas na lam dang / mi rigs pa nyon mongs kyi gnyen po byed pas na rig pa dang / sems phyin ci ma log par sgrub pas na sgrub pa dang / rtag pa'i gnas su mngon zhen med par 'gro bas na nges 'byin gyi rnam pa rnams so/ /lam bden chos can/ bsten bya yin te/ lam rig

pa sgrub pa nges 'byin yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i lam brjod nas nges 'byed cha mthun bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ bden bzhi mngon sam du shes pa ni rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun thob pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ grol sde gnyis ltar na/'phags pa nyan thos kyi lam las byang sems chen po'i nges 'byed cha mthun dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par ston to/ /ji ltar na/ byang sems chen po'i sbyor lam drod dang / rtse mo dang /bzod pa dang / chos mchog ni rim pa bzhin du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas phung po lnga'i stong nyid kyi rang bzhin rnam dag rnams dbyer med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas dang / mi dmigs par brtags pa'i sgo nas dang /rtag sogs su dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya bkag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcu las brtsams nas thams cad la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya ma yin pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas gzugs sogs la dmigs pas nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /slob dpon ltar na sbyor lam drod la gnas pa'i nyan thos chos can/ gzugs sogs kyi stong nyid rnams don dam par phan

༄༅/ /tshun tha dad med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas nges 'byed cha mthun drod skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par khyod kyi stong nyid rnams phan tshun tha dad med de/ khyod don dam par rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog la gnas pa'i nyan thos chos can/ gzugs sogs bden par ma dmigs par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / gzugs sogs rtag sogs su dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya bkag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / mdo las rgyas par bstan pa rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcu las brtsams nas/ chos thams cad la bden par mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas go rim bzhin du nges 'byed cha mthun rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/ gzugs sogs chos can/ bden par ma dmigs pa yin te/ rtags snga ma drod bzhin no/ /chos can/ rtags sogs su dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya bkag pa yin te/ rtags snga ma de bzhin du'o/ /ji ltar bkag na/ gzugs rtag pa yang ma yin/ mi rtag pa yang ma yin/ bde ba yang ma

yin / sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis bkag go zhas bya chos can/ rab dga' la sogs pa'i chos rnams de kho nar gnas bya ma yin te/ gang gi phyir na sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ chos rnams de kho nar gnas byar ma gzigs pa'i phyir zhes bya ba tshad ma'i skyes bus ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi 'thad pas grub bo/ /mdor na/nyan thos kyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu tshogs lam rdzogs rjes kyi nyan thos so skye'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa/ dbye na/ drod rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ rim pa bzhin/gang zhig /mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi mi skye ba'i snga ltas su gyur pa/ gang zhig /mi mthun phyogs kyis g.yo ba'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ gang zhig gi mi mthun phyogs kyis mi g.yo ba'i nang nas chung ngu / gang zhig /'jig rten pa'i rtogs pa rnams kyi gong nas bzod pa las mchog tu gyur pa/ gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la khyad zhugs par bstan pa dang khyad par can lam dngos dang / rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi mthug thog tu rang sangs

༄༅/ /rgyas kyi lam dngos 'chad rigs so zhe na/ theg pa gsum rim gyis bgrod par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi mjug thog tu rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dngos brjod par rigs mod/ de lta na yang re zhig rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyi thog mar rang sangs rgyas kyi lam nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa nyid du sgrub byed rang sangs rgyas kyi lam bgrod tshul dang chos ston tshul bstan pa 'di chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ nyan thos kyi lam rnams las rang sangs rgyas de dag gi lam ji ltar khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan gang gis na rang sangs rgyas de dag gi lam nyan thos kyi lam las gzhan pas snyam pa'i dogs pa bsu nas de bsal ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la/ shugs bstan nyan thos kyi lam dman pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dngos bstan rang sangs rgyas kyi lam khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/nyan thos kyi lung las nyan thos 'dod khams pa srid pa tha ma pa rnams ni rang gis byang chub thob pa slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la nges par ltos dgos la/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa rnams ni rang nyid chos nyan pa ngag tu brjod pa la ltos dgos par ma zad rang gi gdul bya gzhan dag kyang dge bcu sogs la 'jug par byed pa'i ched du chos ston pa yang ngag tu brjod pa dang bcas

pa la nges par ltos dgos so zhes 'byung bas na/ de gnyis kyi rtogs pa ni rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa las dman no/ /ngag don/ nyan thos 'dod khams pa srid pa tha ma pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtogs par rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa las dman te/ khyod kyis rang gis byang chub thob pa slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la nges par ltos dgos pa'i phyir/ des rigs gcig kyang 'gre/ gnyis pa la lam 'gro tshul dang / chos bstan tshul gyi sgo nas khyad zhugs par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring srid pa tha ma pa rnams ni sngon tshogs lam gyi dus su sde snod gsum gyi don la thos pa sbyangs te mkhas par byas pa dang / sogs pa slob dpon gzhan la ma ltos par rang gis thob pa'i shes rab kyis lam bgrod par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam mngon par 'dus byas pa'i mthus slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la ltos mi dgos par bdag nyid kyis thob pa'i lam gyis rang byung gi byang chub thob par 'gyur ba de yin pa'i phyir/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring srid pa tha ma pa de dag la yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas dang byang sems gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la ltos mi dgos par rang byung gi byang chub 'thob bo zhes bya ba ni/ bse

༄༅/ /ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam las zab pa khyad zhugs pa gcig tu mngon par brjod pa yin no/ /des sngon 'bras bu ma thob pa dang / thob pa'i tshogs dang spyod pa gnyis la yang regs 'gre'o/ /ngag don/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring srid pa tha ma pa chos can/ khyod kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa yin te/ khyod slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la ltos mi dgos par bdag nyid kyis thob pa'i lam gyis rang byung gi byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la dngos dang rtsod pa spang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/kyang gi sgras bstan te/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas de dag ni rang gis lam gyis thob pa'i ye shes dang / sogs pa smon lam gyi mthus sgra med lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pas gdul bya gzhan dge ba bcu dang sbyin sogs la 'jug par byed pa de'i phyir/ des sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la brten nas de'i gdul byas de dag gi ye shes mi rtogs pa nyid ni bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam las zab pa khyad zhugs pa gnyis pa yin pa mngon par brjod do/ /ngag don/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa yin te/ khyod kyis rang gi

gdul bya la ye shes dang smon lam gyi mthus sgra med lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pas gdul bya dge bcu sogs la 'jug par byed pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod kyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la brten nas khyod kyi gdul byas khyod kyi ye shes mi rtogs pa yin te/ khyod kyis rang gi gdul bya la sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'chad pa pos nyan pa po la sgrar brjod pa'i chos bstan pa'i sgo nas nyan pa po rngams kyis 'chad pa po'i shes pa'i rtsal rtogs par byed na 'chad pa pos nyan pa po la sgrar brjod pa'i chos bstan dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la rtsod pa ni/ sgra med par chos ston pa 'gal lo zhe na/lan ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yod de / ji ltar sga med par chos ston snyam pa'i dogs pa bsus nas de bsal ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ slob ma gang dang gang zhig bden bzhi sogs don gang dang gang la rnam pa mi rtag sogs ji lta ji ltar nyade par 'dod pa de dang de'i rnam par shes pa la bden bzhi la sogs pa'i don de dang de rang sangs rgyas kyi ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra med kyang smon lam dang ye shes kyi mthus lus kyi sgo nas bden bzhi la

༄༅/ /sogs pa'i chos bstan pas ji ltar shes par 'dod pa'i rnam pa de dang de kho na ltar snang bar 'gyur bas sgra med par chos ston pa yod pas 'gal ba'i skyon med do/ /dper na byang chub sems dpa' gcig gis 'di ltar bdag sangs rgyas nas brjod pa med par chos ston par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de sangs rgyas pa na smon lam gyi mthus sgra med par chos ston pa de bas na chos ston tshul sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ rang sangs rgyas nyid kyi gnas skabs na yang de bzhin no/ /ngag don/ rang sangs rgyas chos can/ sgra med par chos ston pa yod de/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra med kyang lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pas rang gis gdul byas ji ltar nyan par 'dod pa de kho na ltar de'i rnam par shes pa la snang bas so/ /chos can/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra med de/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ma brtags ma dpyad par yang tshig tu mi smra/ brtags shing dpyad nas kyang tshig tu mi smra bas so/ /chos can/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ma brtags ma dpyad par tshig tu mi smra ba yin te/khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe tshig tu smra na brtags dpyad bya dgos pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe brtags shing dpyad nas tshig tu mi smra ba la rgyu mtshan yod de/ yid kyi brjod pa rtog dpyod ni rnam

g.yeng yin la/ de yang ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyud zhabrug byed yin par rtogs nas khyod chos ston pa'i tshe brtags shing dpyad nas tshig tu mi smra ba'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod kyis sgra med par chos ston pa mi 'gal te/chos ston pa'i sgra'i dgos pa ni 'chad pa pos chos brjod pa ltar brjod par bya ba'i chos rtogs pa'i rtogs pa nyan pa po'i rnam par shes pa la shin tu bskrun cing bskyed pa 'di yin la/ de khyod kyis lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la yang yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzung don rtog pa spang phyir dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar rang sangs rgyas kyi lam nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa brjod nas de'i rjes su rnal ma rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dngos brjod pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam ni nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa kho na yin pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ khyad par gsum gyis theg chen gyi lam las dman zhing nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa dang ldan pa'i chos bse ru lta bus mtshon pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lam rtogs par byang sems chen pos lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir shes par bya'o/ /ji ltar na/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi dmigs

༄༅/ /par rtogs pa'i sgo nas yon tan yar ldan du bskyed cing rdzogs par byed pa'i sgo nas so/ /'o na de byang sems kyi rnam pa thams cad du bskyed cing shes par bya ba yin nam zhe na/ byang sems kyis de rnam pa thams cad du bskyed cing shes par bya ba ma yin te/ des rang byang chub mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir/ des na/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin te/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang sangs rgyas kyi lam yon tan yar ldan du bskyed cing rdzogs par byed pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par gsum po gang zhe na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can mthong lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ gzung ba phyi rol gyi don bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong nus kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ gzung ba'i yul can gyi rtog pa ci rigs pa spangs pa yin te/ phyi rol gyi don bden 'dzin gyi gnyen por sngar bshad pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug dang / gzugs sogs kyi dngos po'i gnas lugs je lta ba bzhin rten 'brel bsgoms pa'i rtogs pa yin pas so/ /chos can/ theg chen gyi lam las dman pa yin te/ rang lam du 'dzin pa shes pa bden

'dzin gyi rtog pa spong mi nus pa'i phyir te/ 'dzin rtog gi gnyen por phung po lnga'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du rten 'brel ma bsgoms pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen gyi lam las dman pa yin te/ rten chos rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas bsdus pa'i rtogs pa'i rten gzhi theg 'bring slob pa'i gang zag de khyod kyi lam pa gang zag gi rten yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ rang sangs rgyas kyi 'phags pa'i lam bstan nas rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun thob na bshad ma thag pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi 'phags pa'i lam skye bas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ sbyor lam drod la gnas pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring ba chos can/ gzugs sogs kun rdzob du brda las byung ba ming du btags pa tsam yin pa dang don dam par chos nyid stong pa nyid yin pa mi 'gal bar ston pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas nges 'byed cha mthun drod skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/ sbyor lam rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog la gnas pa'i theg 'bring pa chos can/

༄༅/ /gzugs sogs don dam par 'phel 'grib sogs med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / gzugs sogs nang phyi sogs stong pa nyid kyi sgo nas bdag gir mi 'dzin pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / gzugs sogs skye 'gag sogs med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas nges 'byed cha mthun rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/ gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par 'phel 'grib sogs med de/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir/ chos can/ don dam par nang phyi la sogs pa stong pa nyid kyi sgo nas bdag gir gzung bya ma yin te/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir/ chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag sogs med de/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byang sems kyi lam la mthong sgom gnyis las/ dang po mthong lam la/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ brgal lan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyi mjug thog tu byang chub sems dpa'i lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg pa gsum rim gyis bgrod par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/

tshig don 'byed pa ni/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su khyad par gsum ldan gyi mthong lam bzod shes skad cig ma bzhi ni mthong lam phan yon chen po'o zhes bshad pas te brjod do/ /dgos pa skabs dang por bstan pa'i chos bcu po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'i yin gyi byang chub sems dpa'i ma yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir du byams pas brjod do/ /khyad par gsum ni/ byang chub sems dpas bsgom par bya ba sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yul dang yul can du 'brel ba dang ldan pa tshe 'di'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa/ skye ba gzhan gyi yon tan skye ba snga phyi du ma dran pa'o/ /de la mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ dbye na byang sems dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi mthong lam dang gsum/ mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin/zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi byang sems 'phags pa dang / nyan thos 'phags pa dang / theg 'bring 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ byang sems kyi mthong lam la dbye na rtsa ba'i dbye ba/ chos bzod chos shes/rjes brjod rjes shes te skad cig ma bzhi/ yan lag ge dbye ba sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi po re re la chos bzod chos shes rjes bzod rjes shes bzhi bzhir phye bas bcu drug go /nyan rang gi mthong

༄tsho/ /lam yang dbye ba de bzhin no/ /ngag don/ phan yon chen po dang bcas pa'i mthong lam chos can/ khyod skabs gnyis pa 'dir bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod skabs gnyis pa 'dir bstan pas skabs dang po'i chos bcu po de sangs rgyas kho na'i yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ chos can/ skad cig ma bcu drug yod de/ rtsa dbye bzod shes skad cig ma bzhi/ yan lag gi dbye ba bden bzhi re re la bzod shes skad cig ma bzhi bzhir phye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad lnga chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug po rnam pa ji lta bur bsgom par bya snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ rnam pa sgom tshul/ don dam par de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas gnyis rten dang brten pa yul dang yul can gyi rnam grangs kyis gnas par khas len par mi rigs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa skye ba yin no/ /mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ khyod kyis mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod de

dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas sgom pa yin te/ khyod kyis de don dam par de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas gnyis yul dang yul can gyi rnam grangs kyis gnas par khas len par mi rigs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te sgom pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma kun la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas gnyis chos can/ don dam par yul dang yul can gyi rnam grangs kyis khas len par mi rigs te/ don dam par yul dang yul can du med pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs don dam par chen po mtha' dbus dang bral bar rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes skye ba yin no/ /gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par mtha' dbus dang bral ba yin te/ don dam par chos dbyings kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs de dag la don dam par 'jal byed tshad ma med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa skye ba yin no/ /gzugs sogs de dag chos can/ don dam par 'jal byed tshad ma med de/ rtags snga ma de bzhin du'o/ /nam mkha' la tshad med pa bzhin gzugs sogs de dag la don dam par gzugs can dang gzugs can ma yin pa'i tshad gnyis med par rtogs pa'i rnam

༄tsho/ /pa'i sgo nas man rigs 'gre'o/ /gzugs sogs de dag chos can/ don dam par gzugs can dang gzugab/ can ma yin pa'i tshad gnyis med de/ rtags snga ma bzhin du'o/ /de la gzugs can ni gzugs kyi phung po yin la/ de'i tshad ni rdul phra rab la brten pa'i dbyibs yin/ gzugs can ma yin pa ni ming bzhi'i phung po yin la/ de'i tshad ni skad cig la bye brag tu smra ba 'dod do/ /mdor na de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /gzugs sogs rtag chad dang sngon dang phyi mtha' med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' med de/ don dam par ngo bo nyid med pas so/ /mthong lam kun 'byung la chos shes kyi yum la gnas pa'i byang sems ni chos dbyings kyi ngo bos gzugs sogs dang de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis dbyer med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ snga ma de bzhin du mthong lam kun 'byung la rjes bzod kyi yum la gnas pa'i byang sems ni chos dbyings kyi ngo bos chos thams cad la blang dor 'phel 'grib sogs med par sgom pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ ngo bo nyid med par mos pa sngon du 'gro ba'i byang sems sogs tshad med bzhi sgom pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mdor na/ de lta bu'i kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam

pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo gnyug ma rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ chos dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dge ba'i 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa thob pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam 'gog pa chos shes la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ chos dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dge ba'i 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa 'thob pa yin te/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i phyir/ yum du gnyen po rnam byang thams cad gong ma rjes mthun pa ma 'brel/ 'og ma yon tan yar ldan du tshang bar bsdus pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/theg chen gyi mthong lam 'gog pa la rjes bzod kyi yum chos can/ gnyen po rnam byang gi rigs thams cad tshang bar bsdus pa yin te/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ mi la sogs pa'i nyam nga ba phyi'i 'tshe ba dang / nad dang 'dod chags la sogs pa nang gi 'tshe ba nye bar zhi ba'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ theg chen gyi mthong lam 'gog pa la rjeb shes chos can/phyi nang gi 'tshe ba ci rigs pa zhi ba yin te/ gnyen po rnam byang gi rigs thams cad tshang bar bsdus pa de nyid kyis so/ /mdor na de lta bu ni 'gog bden gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /gzugs sogs

༄༅/ /dang mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon par zhen pa zhi ba'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam lam la chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ gzugs sogs dang myang 'das la zhen pa ci rigs pa zhi ba yin te/ de'i gnyen por chos thams cad gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med par bsgoms pas so/ /'das pa dang da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzad pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam lam la chos shes la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsrung bskyab sba ba mdzad de/ spros bral rtogs pa'i shes rab dang gzhan don gyi thabs mkhas la zhugs pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ bsrung bskyab sba ba gsum ni bsrung ba chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po yin no/ /gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i bsam pas bdag nyid rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa dge ba bcu la gnas te sems can gzhan yang de la 'god bsngags mthun pas dga' bar byed pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam lam la rjes bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yin te/ bdag nyid rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu dge ba bcu la gnas nas sems can gzhan yang de nyid la 'god bsngags mthun pas dga' bar byed pa'i phyir/ mthong lam lam la rjes shes la

gnas pa'i byang sems spyin sogs mi zad par 'dod pa'i bsam pas sbyin sogs dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chab tu bsngo ba'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam la rjes shes skye zhing 'phel bas de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod do/ /'di bzhin gong ma rnams la'ang mdzod/ mthong lam lam la rjes shes la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pa la dgos pa yod de/ de ltar bsngos pas dge ba'i rtsa ba zad mi shes pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ de lta bu ni lam bden gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /mjug bsdu ba ni/ gong du bstan pa de lta bu'i theg chen gyi bzod shes rnams ni lam shes kyi skabs su bstan pa'i skad cig ma yin te/ phan yon chen po dang bcas pa'i mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa brgal lan la/ rgol ba ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan la bshad pa byed pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta kha cig ni lam shes kyi mthong lam rgyas bshad kyi skabs 'dir bden dang bden la bzod pa zhes sogs kyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i don mtshon cing brjod byar lhur len pa de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag ces pa la sogs

༄༅/ /pa'i gzhung gis mthong lam gyi rnam pa'i don ma bshad par mthong lam gyi skad cig ma bcu drug nye bar mtshon pa nyi tshe bstan par zad de/ de'i rnam pa zhes ma smos par/ lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi skabs su bshad pa dang / sngar ma bshad pa/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su 'chad pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun dang / sogs pa gzhi shes mthong lam gyi don ston byed kyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams kyis kyang de rnams kyi skad cig ma'i don tsam bstan pa sngar gyi de bzhin du blta bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /lan la/ dam bca' snga ma rigs pas dgag /dam bca' gnyis la lung rigs gnyis gas dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces pa la sogs pa'i gzhung gis rnam pa ma bstan par 'dod pa las gzhan des rnam pa bstan par 'dod pa slob dpon seng ge bzang po la sogs pa dag na re/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces sogs kyi gzhung de dag chos can/ khyod kyis mnyam gzhag tu bsgom pa'i rim pa dang / sogs pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i dus su yid la bya ba'i rim pa gang yang ma bstan par thal/ khyod kyis rnam pa'i don cung zad kyang ma bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos

can / khyod kyis mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ khyod kyis mnyam bzhag gi dus su sgom pa'i rim pa dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i dus su yid la bya ba'i rim pa gang yang ma bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi gzhung de dag gi rnam pa ma bstan na sngar gyi rigs pas kyang gnod la/ skyon gzhan lung gi gnod pa yang yod do/ /ji ltar na / dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i don yang ji ltar drang zhing 'chad de/ rnam pa dang zhes pa dang / rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /zhes pa dang 'gal lo zhes zer ro/ /skabs don/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ khyod kyis byang sems chen po'i sbyor lam des nyan rang gi sbyor lam las rnam pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par bstan par min par thal/ khyod kyis rnam pa ma bstan pa'i phyir/ rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ sems can la dmigs pa'i rjes thob kyi rnam pa gtso bor bstan pa min par thal/ rtags snga ma bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sgom lam la byed pa dang / byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kun nas dul dang thams cad la/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas

༄༅/ /gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ don la skye ba'i rim pa ltar byas na mthong lam gyi mjug thog tu sgom lam/ sgom lam gyi mjug thog tu de'i byed pa brjod par bya ba yin te/ de las de 'byung ba'i phyir/ de ltar na yang theg chen sgom lam de'i byed pa chos can/ khyod re zhig theg chen sgom lam gyi dang por bstan pa la rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa yod de/ theg chen sgom lam ston pa'i mdo tshig bas khyod ston pa'i mdo tshig gi brjod bya cung nyung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / theg chen sgom lam gyi gdul bya 'bras bu khyod la mos nas theg chen sgom lam la gzhol ba nyid du gzhug pa'i phyir du khyod de'i dang por bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ de'i 'bras bu yin pa/ de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / bral 'bras bzhi/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu gcig /skyes bu byed 'bras gcig ste rnam pa drug yin no/ /de rnams la bral 'bras bzhi ni/ theg chen sgom lam bsgoms pas rnam pa thams cad du sems rang dbang nyid du byed pas rang rgyud kun nas dul ba dang / rang rgyud dul bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa skye bo 'dud 'os thams cad la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud pa dang / theg chen sgom lam bsgoms pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa zil gyis gnon cing de las

rgyal ba dang / theg chen sgom lam bsgoms pas pha rol bdud la sogs pas byas pa'i gnod pa sgrub pa'i yul ma yin pas bdud sogs kyi gnod pas brdzi ba med pa dang bzhi/ de la dang po gsum nang gi 'tshe ba zhi ba/ bzhi pa phyi'i 'tshe ba zhi ba'o/ /rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgoms dros rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba dang / skyes bu byed 'bras ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgoms pa'i rten gyi yul sa phyogs kyang mchod pa'i rten nyid du byed pa'o/ /sa mtshams gtsor cher sa gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ ngag don/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgoms pas rnam pa thams cad du sems la rang dbang nyid du byed pa chos can/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa yin te/ de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ des 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshams sbyar/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa'i 'og tu theg chen gyi sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ byed pa ston pa'i mdo tshig bas sgom lam ston pa'i mdo tshig brjod bya mang ba'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su chos nyid la rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs/ de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo theg chen gyi zag bcas dang

༄༅/ /zag med sgom lam gnyis so/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan theg chen gyi sgom lam gzhir byas pa la zag pa kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa snang ba dang de snang ba med pa gnyis yod pa'i bye brag gis so/ /dbye don de gnyis la gzhi mthun med do/ /ngag don/ theg chen sgom lam chos can/ zag bcas dang zag med sgom lam gnyis su 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod la kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa snang ba dang / de snang ba med pa gnyis yod pa'i bye brag gis de gnyis su phye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la zag bcas dang / zag med sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ dgos pa'i sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam la gnyis yod pa de'i phyir theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa snang ba/ de dbye gzhi/dbye ngo mos pa dang / bsngo ba dang / rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gsum mo/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gzhir byas pa la/ dge ba sogs pa dang /mi zad par byed pa dang / 'phel bar byed pa la gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam la dngos dang / phan yon gnyis las/ dang

po ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mos bsngo yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi nang nas dang por mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ dge ba mi zad par byed pa dang / 'phel bar byed pa la dge ba sog pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ mos pa'i rgyu ni lung rigs rnam dag yin la/ yul ni gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin no/ /ngo bo ni/ yum la dang ba'i 'dun pa grogs shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gcig yin no/ /dbye ba ni/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas yum la 'dun pa de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo la/ rtsa ba dang yan lag dang nying lag gi dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zag bcas sgom lam la gsum du dbye bar ma zad mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi ngo bo de la rang don dang / gnyis don dang / gzhan don mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang rnam pa gsum du shes par bya'o/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gzhir byas pa la sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub cing gzhan don

༄༅/ /ched du bya ba sgrub pa dang / sbyor bas gzhan don bar chad dang bcas par sgrub pa dang / gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa dang gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /dgos pa de gsum bsgoms pas ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin don gsum dang bstod bkur bsngags pa sogs 'thob bo/ /de gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gang zhig /sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub pa dang /gang zhig /gzhan don bar chad dang bcas par sgrub pa/ gang zhig /gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'o/ /sa mtshams ni dang po sa gnyis pa nas bzhi pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa sa lnga pa nas bdun pa'i bar na yod/ gsum pa sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ 'o na mos pa gsum sgom pa'i dang por don gsum mngon du byed par thal/ de gsum gyis yum la mos pa ji ltar bsgoms bzhin don gsum 'thob pa'i phyir zhe na/ rang dang gnyis ka dang gzhan don la dmigs pa mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gsum chos can/ khyod kyis yum la mos pa ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin don gsum 'thob na khyod sgom pa'i dang por don gsum mngon du byed mi dgos par thal/ khyod kyis yum la mos pa ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin dge ba'i chos don gsum gyi rten yin cing 'thob na yang khyod sgom pa'i dang por don gsum mngon du mi

byed pa'i phyir te/ khyod sgom lam gyi dbang du byas pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rab kyi mthar thug pa med par slob pa'i dus su don gsum mngon du byas pa ni su la yang yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ yan lag gi dbye ba ni/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam la gsum du phye bar ma zad/ mos pa gsum po de yang ni chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen por phye ba'i bye brag gis re re zhing rnam pa gsum gsum du 'dod / nying lag gi dbye ba ni/ mos pa gsum la gsum gsum du phye bar ma zad mos pa dgu po de yang sor sor chung ngu'i chung ngu / 'bring / chen po/ 'bring gi chung ngu / 'bring / chen po/ chen po'i chung ngu / 'bring / chen por dbye bas re re zhing rnam pa gsum gsum yin pa de ltar na dgu tshan gsum gyis mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam la rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun du 'dod do/ /gnyis pa phan yon ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam bstan nas de'i phan yon bstod bkur bsngags pa bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ de bsgoms pa las de 'byung ba'i phyir/ dgos pa ci phyir bstan na/ mos pa de bsgoms pa'i byang chub sems dpa' spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ gong du

ra༅༅/ /bstan pa de ltar yum la mos pa las sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang byang sems 'phags pas bstod pa la sogs pa mdzad do zhes bstan pa'i phyir du bstod pa la sogs pa bstan no/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ 'dod do/ /gang la na/ ji ltar mos pa bsgoms pa bzhin don gsum 'thob pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid kyi yum la sbyor bas rang don sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i mos pa yid la byed pa dang po rang don mos pa dang / sbyor bas gnyis don sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i mos pa yid la byed pa gnyis pa gnyis don mos pa dang / sbyor bas gzhan don kho na sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i mos pa yid la byed pa gsum pa gzhan don mos pa ste mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi gnas skabs dgu tshan gsum po rnams la'o/ /ji ltar na/ so sor dgu tshan rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas go rim bzhin du rang don mos pa la bstod pa dang /gnyis don mos pa la bkur ba dang / gzhan don mos pa la bsngags pa byas par 'dod do/ /dgos pa de rnams sgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gong nas gong du mngon par dga' bar byed pa'i phyir du'o/ /gang gis na/ sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang / sogs pa byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyis so/ /rgyu mtshan des na/ 'dir bstan gyi bstod pa la sogs nga/ 'di dag ni don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin

rtogs nas mdzad pa'i mtshan nyid can yin gyi/ gcam bu'i ngo bo ni ma yin no/ /mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi phan yon bstod pa'i mtshan nyid/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam bsgoms pa'i yon tan ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas 'dud pa'i cha/ dbye na bstod bkur bsngags pa gsum/ de gsum gyi khyad par ni bstod pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po yin no/ /ngo bo ni/ yid kyi bstod pa yid dad pa/ ngag gi bstod pa ni yid gus pas bslang ste ngag tu yon tan dang bsngags pa brjod pa/ lus kyi bstod pa ni/ yid gus pas bslang ste phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'o/ /'dir yid kyi bstod pa gtso che'o/ /ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bstan gyi bstod pa la sogs pa 'di don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas mdzad pa yin gyi gcam bu'i ngo bo ma yin te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i skus yum la mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam rnams la yon tan yod pa dang mthun par bstod bkur bsngags pa mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsngo ba ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can zhes bya ba la sogs par gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mos pa bstan nas gnyis pa bsngo ba yid la byed pa'i sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong du

༄༅/ /bstan pa de ltar yum la mos pa las dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba 'byung bas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar byed do/ /gang na rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad do/ /dgos pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub thob par mi zad par byed pa'i phyir du'o/ /gang gis na/ theg pa gsum gyis gdul bar bya ba'i sems can la theg pa gsum gyi lam ston pa'i rgyu'i ngo bo byed pa dang ldan pa bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam rnams kyis so/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyi sgo nas so/ /de na theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sgyur ba de bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa bcu gnyis so/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ mngon zhen bcu gnyis kyi gnyen por yul bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bcu gnyis su phye'o/ /bcu gnyis po gang zhe na/sngar bshad pa'i mos pa khyad par can zhes ming du btags pa'i bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /bla med byang chub la mi dmigs pa'i tshul

gyis dmigs te rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chab tu bsgyur ba/ mi dmigs pa zhes ming du btags pa'i man 'dra/ gang zhig /zag med kyi phung po lnga la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis man 'dra/ zag med kyi phung po lnga ni tshul khrims dang / shes rab dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po'o/ /phyin ci ma log pa zhes ming du btags pa man 'dra/ gang zhig /sngo bar byed pa'i sems la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis man 'dra/ dben pa zhes ming du btags pa'i man 'dra/ gang zhig /bdag gzhan dang ldan pa'i dngos po la mi byudamigs pa man 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin dran pa zhes ming du btags pa'i man 'dra/ gang zhig /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dge ba la mi dmigs man 'dra/ thabs la mkhas pa dang bcas pa'i zhes ming du btags pa man 'dra/ gang zhig /sbyin sogs drug la mi dmigs man 'dra/ mtshan ma med pa zhes ming du man 'dra/ gang zhig /sngon po la sogs pa'i mtshan ma la mi dmigs man 'dra/ sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba zhes ming du man 'dra/ gang zhig /lam thams cad la mi dmigs man 'dra/ khams gsum par ma gtogs par zhes ming du man 'dra/ gang zhig /'dod pa

༄༅/ /la sogs pa khams gsum la mi dmigs man 'dra/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po zhes ming du man 'dra/ gang zhig /dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam sogs dang / rgyun du zhugs pa la sogs pa dang /bla med byang chub la gnas pa la mi dmigs man 'dra/ sogs dang pos bsam gtan bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ mngon shes lnga'o/ /sogs gnyis pas phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong / dgra bcom pa'o/ /chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po zhes ming du btags pa'i bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gsum po chos can/ bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bdag nyid yin te/ stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis dge ba bcu sogs 'thob pa'i bsod nams yod na dang / rgyun zhugs sogs 'thob pa'i dang / stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad bla med byang chub la gnas pa la sems can de snyed kyis mchod pa'i bsod nams yod na/ de bas khyod bsgoms pa'i bsod nams lhag pa'i phyir/ so sor sbyor mdzod/ ngag don/ sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi thabs shes khyad can gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur ba'i rtogs pa chos can/ mos pa khyad par can zhes ming du btags pa'i bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam yin te/ theg

chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /bla med byang chub la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs te rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur ba yin pa'i phyir/chos can des gzhan thams cad la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'i rjes thob na yod/ gsum pa yi rang ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ bsngo ba bstan nas gsum pa rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa'i sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong du bstan pa de ltar legs par bsngos pa las byung ba'i bsod nams yi rang gis mngon par spel bar bya ba yin pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ byang sems chen pos dbul pos gter rnyed pa ltar rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la dmigs nas rjes su yi rang bar byed pa yin no/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ kun rdzob tu rnam mkhyen yid la byed pa'i thabs mkhas dang don dam par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi sgo nas so/ /des na sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang yid la byed pa'i rtogs pa ni/ gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo

༄༅/ /nas rang gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang sgom pa'i phyir/ rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir brjod do/ /sa mtshams gong dang 'dra/gsum pa ni/ mos bsngo yi rang gsum rgyas par bshad pa de la bsdus pa'i don ni mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam chos can/ khyod sgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod bsgoms pas bsod nams rgya chen po mngon par 'du byed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar na/ gser gyi 'byung khungs bzang po nas gser gyi gar bu 'byung ba bzhin du'o/ /bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam chos can/ chos 'dra/ khyod bsgoms pas mos pas 'dus byas pa'i bsod nams te rdzogs pa'i byang chab kyi rgyur byed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar na/ gser gyi gar bu de gser mgar mkhas pas bzo byas te mi la sogs pa'i rgyan du byed pa bzhin du'o / /rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam chos can/ chos 'dra/ khyod bsgoms pas blo mnyam na rang gzhan gyi bsod nams byas pa mnyam po 'thob pa'i phyir/ ji ltar na/ rgyan btags pas rang gzhan la mdzes pa bzhin du'o zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ zag bcas sgom lam

gyi 'og tu zag med sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ mos bsngo yi rang gsum sgom pa rnam par mi rtog pas zin dgos pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mnyam bzhag ni theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye na sgrub pa dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis so/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan zag med sgom lam la bar chad med lam dang / rnam grol lam gnyis yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /gnyis pa la sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo gnyis mchog nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ zag med sgom lam la gnyis yod pa de'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ gnyis kyi nang nas dang por rnam mkhyen mngon par sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sgrub pa sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ bar chad med lam ni rang 'bras rnam grol lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su gzugs sogs kyi rang bzhin phyin ci ma log par mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mnyam bzhag bar chad med lam ni sgrub pa sgom lam de'i ngo bo yin no/ /ngag don/ sa gnyis pa'i mnyam bzhag bar chad med lam

༄༅/ /chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su gzugs sogs kyi rang bzhin phyin ci ma log par mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgoms par byed pa'i mnyam bzhag bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam ni zag bcas sgom lam las mchog yin te/ rnam par mi rtog pas ma zin par gzhan mos bsngo yi rang yid la byed pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'thob pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ chos kun la mtshan mar 'du mi byed de/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/de rnam pa'o/ /byed las la gnas skabs kyi byed las ni/ gong du bstan pa de lta bu'i ngo bo nyid dang mchog nyid dang rnam pa dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam gyi rang sgom byed rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la chos rnams rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa bskyed pa ni gtod par byed pa yin no/ /ngag don sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ khyod bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod kyis rang sgom byed rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ mthar thug gi byed las ni/ chos can/ don chen po yin te/ khyod kyis rang sgom byed rnal 'byor pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par byed pa'i phyir/ sa

mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'i mnyam bzhag bar chad med lam na yod do/ /gnyis pa la mtshams sbyar/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen bshad/ 'bras bu rnam dag sgom lam dngos dang gsum/dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam bstan nas de'i 'og tu chos gang zhig gzung bas rnam dag sgom lam 'thob pa rnam dag sgom lam 'di'i mthun rkyen dang / chos gang zhig bor bas rnam dag 'thob pa rnam dag sgom lam 'di'i 'gal rkyen gang yin snyam pa'i the tshom bsal ba'i sgo nas gnyis pa rnam dag sgom lam bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de bstan pas rnam dag sgom lam gyi mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen legs par shes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'o na rkyen gnyis po gang zhe na/ sa gnyis pa man chad du sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku bsten nas bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes par byed pa dang / rjes thob tu sbyin sogs phar phyin drug ci rigs pa rdzogs par byed pa dang / mnyam bzhag tu zhi gnas la mnyam par 'jog pa'i thabs la mkhas pa gang yin ni chos can/ rang 'bras sgom lam gyi mthun rkyen yin te/ rang 'bras rnam dag sgom lam 'di sgom pa la mos pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ de la phan btags stobs kyis de'i rjes su 'gro ldog bya sa yin pa'i phyir/ bdud kyis zil gyis gnon te gnode pa byas pa dang / chos zab mo

༄༅/ /rang bzhin spros bral la ma mos shing sdang ba dang / phung po sogs la bden par zhen zhing 'dzin pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i grogs pos yongs su zin te 'grogs pa ni chos can/ rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i 'gal rkyen yin te/ rang 'bras chos spong gi las kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ de la phan btags stobs kyis de'i rjes su 'gro ldog bya sa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la spyir bstan/ khyad par du bstan/shin tu ba dang cig snardzos su bstan/ shin tu ba bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar rnam dag sgom lam lam 'thob pa dang mi 'thob pa'i rgyu bshad nas skabs su bab pa'i rnam dag 'phags bzhi'i spyir thun mong du bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi 'gal rkyen spangs mthun rkyen tshang ba las rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dge sbyong gi tshul bar chad med lam gyi 'bras bu rnam grol gyi lam de chos can/khyod rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam dag de dang / khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid khyod kyi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang byas dag pa'i

rnam dag gnyis dbyer med pa yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ de lta bu'i dag pa de gnyis rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas tha dad ma yin zhing / khyad par gyi chos mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas so sor gcad du med pas so/ /chos can/ de ltar med de/ de lta bu'i rnam dag de gnyis dag gzhi chos nyid gcig gi steng du dag bya gzugs la bdag sogs su zhen pa'i dri ma gcig dag byed bar chad med lam gcig gis dag par byas pa'i rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'bras bu dag pas gzugs sogs dag par brjod do/ /rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mnyam bzhag rnam grol lam/ dbye na sa lhag ma dgu'i mnyam bzhag rnam grol lam dgu /sa mtshams yang de na yod/ gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ glo bur rnam dag 'phags bzhi'i thun mong du brjod nas de'i rjes su khyad par so sor phye nas bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/khyad par gyi sgo nas spyi rtogs dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ nyan thos kyi rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu mtshan gzhi/ slob ma nyan thos kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal

༄༅/ /gyi spang bya 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i theg pa chung ngu'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /theg 'bring mthong lam pa'i rnam grol lam mtshan gzhi/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya nyon mongs pa dang shes sgrib gzung rtogs spangs pa'i theg pa 'bring po'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi rnam grol lam mtshan gzhi/ rgyal sras byang sems kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya theg pa gsum gyi lam gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs sgrib pa gsum spangs pa'i theg chen slob pa'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /chos dbyings thabs dang bcas pa bsgoms pa las byung ba'i rnam dag shin tu ba chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag yin te/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags bcas pa rnam pa thams cad du spangs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtshan gzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnam pa kun spangs pa'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /de'i phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag ni rnam dag shin tu ba yin no zhes dngos su bstan pas dang po gsum rnam dag shin tu ba min te/ sgrib pa phyogs re las ma spangs pa'i phyir zhes shugs la bstan to/ /

gsum pa ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yo da de/khyod la brten nas lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su byang sems kyi rnam dag smos pa'i zhar la sangs rgyas dang nyan rang gi rnam dag shin tu ba dang cig shos su bshad pa de ji lta bu yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag de rnam dag shin tu ba yin te/ khams gsum sa dag la brten pa'i theg chen gyi sgom spang chen po'i chen po la sogs pa'i dri ma dgu'i gnyen por chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam dag ni/ rang gi spang bya sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad du rnam par dag pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/nyan rang gi rnam dag ni/ cig shos shin tu ba ma yin pa'i rnam dag yin te/ khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i nyan rang gi sgom spang chen po'i chen po la sogs pa'i dri ma dgu'i gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i nyan rang gi sgom lam bar chad med lam dag ni/ cig shos rang gi spang bya'i dri ma phyogs re tsam dag pa'i rgya yin gyi sgrib pa'i bag chags spang mi nus pa'i phyir/ khams gsum sa dgu ni/ 'dod khams sa

ra༅༅/ /gcig /gzugs khams bsam gtan sa bzhi/ gzugs med khams snyoms 'jug sa bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de la klan ka spangs pa ni/ /zhes bya ba la rbesags pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de la klan ka spangs pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag ji ltar shin tu ba yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag ni rnam dag shin tu ba yin te/ dpes klan ka spangs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam shin tu ba de rang gi spang bya khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sgom lam shin tu ba de chos can/ de'i gnyen po yin te/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas 'jal byed shes pa dang gzhal bya shes bya gnyis rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs pa mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi bar chad med lam mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ dpes klan ka spangs pa'i sgo nas bstan na/ klan ka ni gang / dpe ni ji lta bu zhe na/ gong du gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pas spang bya chen po'i chen po la sogs pa spong byas pa de la/ kha cig na re/ de mi 'thad de/

gnyen po ni chen po'i chen po la sogs pa yin cing / mi mthun phyogs ni chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa rigs so zhes bya ba'i klan ka rgol lo/ /spong byed lan ni/ don dam par ni 'dod de/ don dam par phan gnod gang yang ma grub pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob tu rtags ma grub ste spang bya rags pa sel ba la gnyen po stobs chung ngus chog cing / spang bya phra zhing phra ba sel ba la gnyen po stobs chen dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na gos la chags pa'i dri ma rags pa sel ba la btso blag mkhan gyis 'bad pa chung ngus chog la/ gos la chags pa'i dri ma shin tu phra mo bsal ba la btso blag mkhan che thang du 'bad dgos pa bzhin no/ /des na de lta tshobu'i dpes de lta bu'i klan ka spangs pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ mdor na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ rgyu lam shes gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs gnyis pa'i 'grel pa don gsal ba'i rgyan ces bya ba re zhig rdzogs so// //de ltar skabs gnyis pas rgyu'i bdag nyid kyi lam shes rdzogs par bstan nas/ da ni skabs gsum pa gzhi shes kyi yan lag rgyas par 'chad pa la/ rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas mjug bsdu/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/

༄tsho/ /shes bya chos can/ rgyu lam shes bstan nas de'i rjes su thams cad shes pa nyid bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med par lam legs par shes pa med pas so/ /gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ phyi nang chos ji snyed pa bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gang zhig /spangs rtogs nyi tshe bar gyur pa/ sa mtshams theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud kho na la yod/ gnyis pa la srid zhi la gnas mi gnas kyi khyad par/ 'bras yum la nye ring gi khyad par/ spang bya dang gnyen po'i khyad par/ de gnyis kyi gnas lugs sgom tshul gyi khyad par/ bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu'i khyad par/sgom lam dngos su mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la/ dngos su byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyis 'khor 'das la mtshan 'dzin spangs bar bstan/ shugs la nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyis 'khor 'das la mtshan 'dzin ma spangs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la nye bar 'dod pa'i byang sems kyi yum gzhi shes chos can/ chos kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis tshu rol gyi mtha' 'khor ba rtag pa'i mtshan nyid dang / gzhan don du 'khor bar dngos su 'jug nus pa'i snying rjes pha rol gyi mtha' myang 'das chad pa'i mtshan nyid dang / de gnyis kyi bar theg chen gyi lam la yang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i tshul

gyis mi gnas pa yin te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba ni rgyun mi 'chad pas rgyun gyi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid dang / myang 'das ni nyan thos pa kha cig lhag med kyi myang 'das thob pa na phung po la rgyun chad par 'dod pas de la chad pa'i mtshan nyid ces bstan to/ /des na byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin te/ phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i mkhyen pa gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas 'khor 'das bar gsum la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pas so/ /de'i mtshan nyid de yin no/ /sa mtshams byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ gnyis pa ni/ kun shes 'chad pa'i skabs su nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyis 'khor 'das la mtshan 'dzin spangs pa las bzlog ste ma spangs par bstan pas na nyan rang gis bdag med rtogs pa tsam gyi yum gzhi shes chos can/ 'khor 'das la mtshan mar 'dzin pa ma spangs pa yin te/ gzhan don du 'khor bar dngos su 'jug nus pa'i snying rje dang 'khor 'das la blang dor gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po 'khor 'das rang bzhin ma dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bral

༄༅/ /ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis dngos po 'khor ba dang dngos po med pa myang 'das la mtshan mar dmigs pa ma spangs pa'i phyir te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum gyi bsdus pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du ma shes pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir gnyen po gzhi shes la ltos te 'bras yum dang ring bar gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rang sde kha cig na re/ klu sgrub kyi lugs rtsa sher las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang yin pa de nyid kyi rang bzhin stong par thub pa khyod ni bzhed ces 'byung ba'i phyir/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes pa ni gzhi rten 'brel rang bzhin med par rtogs pa kho na yin la de yang nyan rang byang sems thams cad la yod pa ma yin nam/ des na ji ltar na nyan rang la yang dag pa'i yum ring ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' la yang dag pa'i yum cig shos nye bar 'gyur zhe na/ de lta bu'i dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir tshigs bcad gcig smos so/ /ngag don/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nashā ji ltar na nyan rang la yang dag pa'i yum ring ba dang byang chub sems dpa' la nye bar 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal ba'i

phyir / lan gyi sgo nas tshig don 'byed pa la/ nyan rang la ring ba'i rgyu mtshan dang byang sems la nye ba'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med par rtogs pa tsam thams cad la yod pa'i phyir zer na khyab pa ma grub/ theg chen gyi phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin khyad par can gyis gzung ba'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis rten 'brel rang bzhin med par rtogs pa thams cad la yod pa'i phyir zer na/ rtags ma grub ste/'dzin rtog gi gnyen por chos kyi gnas lugs mi shes pa'i nyan rang de dag chos can/ byang sems chen po la ltos te khyod la 'bras bu yum ring ba yin te/ khyod kyi rgyud la thabs shes khyad par gyi sgo nas dus gsum rang bzhin ma dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa med pa'i phyir/ chos can/ de med de/ khyod mthun rkyen phyi'i yongs 'dzin theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / nang gi yongs 'dzin rnam mkhyen yid byed la so gas pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba'i phyir dang / 'gal rkyen tshor ba la sogs pa'i dngos po mtshan mar rtog rma 'dzin rtog cung zad kyang ma spangs pas so/ /dper na skye bo mang po'i dbus su sna ma mkhan gyis 'jim dum sogs la rta glang sogs su sprul pa'i dngos po rta glang sogs snang ba la de'i ngo bo mi shes pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis rta glang sogs su mngon par zhen pa nyid kyi de rnams la rta glang sogs kyi

༄༅/ /ngo bo med par mi shes pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pa de dag ni chos can/ nyan rang la ltos te khyod la 'bras yum yang dag nye ba yin te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa yin te/ khyod dus gsum ring mo zhig nas theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag par mgu bar byas pa las byung ba'i man ngag phyin ci ma log pa can bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab bskyed pa'i thabs la mkhas pas tshor ba sogs la mngon par zhen pa'i 'byul pa 'dzin rtog gi mtshan ma ci rigs pa spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa yongs su shes pa de nyid mnyam pa nyid du yongs su shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can dang ldan pa ma yin pa/ sa mtshams theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ ring ba ma yin pa nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can zung 'brel yin pa/ sa

mtshams byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ gsum pa la/ gzhi lam la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen/ de dag gi mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ spang bya ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gong du bstan pa de ltar nyan rang gi yum gzhi shes ni gnyen po gzhi shes la ltos te 'bras yum la ring bar gyur to/ /de'i sgrub byed mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pa'i phyir zhes ston par byed do/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes ni byang sems kyi gzhi shes la ltos te 'bras yum la ring ba yin te/ gzugs sogs phung po lnga la gzhan mu stegs pas kun nas sgro btags pa'i bdag dang sems can la sogs pas stong pa nyid du bden par lta ba'i 'du shes dang / zag bcas dang zag med dang de gnyis ma'i ngo bo dus gsum du rtogs pa'i chos rnams la tha dad du bden par blta ba'i 'du shes dang / sbyin sogs phar phyin drug dang / byang phyogs so bdun rnams la sgrub cing bden par lta ba'i 'du shes ni/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pa'i phyir/ de la so so skye bo'i chos rnams ni zag bcas dang / mi slob pa'i chos rnams ni zag med dang /

༄༅/ /slob pa'i chos rnams ni de gnyis ga'i ngo bo zhes bstan to/ /kha cig na re/ de lta ba'i 'du shes gsum mi mthun phyogs yin pa mi 'thad de/ de gsum rim pa bzhin gzugs sogs mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs su 'dzin pa dang / dus gsum gyi chos rnams gcig tu 'dzin pa dang / ser sna la sogs pa'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir zer na/ yang gi khongs nas so/ /ma khyab ste/ gzugs sogs mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs kyis stong pa nyid du bden par blta ba'i 'du shes chos can/ khyod rang gi spang bya gzugs sogs mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs su 'dzin pa de dag gi gnyen po yin na yang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ khyod de'i gnyen po yin na yang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ de'i spang bya yin te/ khyod gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs la phyin ci log tu zhugs/ gnyen po gzhi shes de gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs la yang dag par zhugs shing / des khyod 'joms nus pas so/ /chos can/ gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa yin te/ gzugs sogs de mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs kyis stong par bden par ma grub pa la de des stong par bden par dmigs pa nyid kyis so/ /des gzhan gnyis

kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyin la sogs pa ngar 'dzin med/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas byang sems chen po rnams kyi gnyen po gzhi shes de mtshan 'dzin las bzlog ste de'i gnyen por yin pa rtogs pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ gnyen po gzhi shes chos can/ rnam pa thams cad du gzhi lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po yin te/ gzhi lam gyi gnas lugs la yang dag par zhugs pa'i phyir dang / gzhi lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i chags pa'i tshogs rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'gog par byed pa'i ye shes yin pas so/ /de'i byed las ni/ 'khor gsum rnam dag gi sgo nas sbyin sogs la ngar 'dzin pa'i yul bdag med par rtogs pa la rang gnas nas / gdul bya gzhan rmongs pa la gdams ngag ston/ bag med pa gnyen po len du 'jug /zhus pa gzengs bstod/ legs par zhum pa la mthun pas dga' bar byed pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs bdag med par rtogs pa de la sbyor bar byed do/ /ngag don ni/ chos can/ gzhan don byed pa'i las can yin te/ sbyin sogs bdag med par rtogs pa la rang gnas nas gdul bya gzhan yang de la sbyor bar byed pa'i

༄༅/ /phyir / gnyis pa la spang bya dang / gnyen po gnyis/ dang po la/ chags pa'i rtags kyis mi mthun phyogs su sgrub/ zab pa'i rtags kyis mi mthun phyogs su sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang / dge ba gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i 'du shes chos can/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i chags pa yin pa'i phyir/ de mthar 'dzin can gyis chags par rtogs dka' bas phra mo zhes bstan to/ /de mi 'thad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ma dad pa dang / dge ba rang gi tshe 'di'i ched tsam du bsngo ba'i 'du shes kyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir zer na/ rang 'bras de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyu yin pa nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la ma dad pa la sogs pa de dag gi gnyen po yin mod/ de lta na yang rnam pa thams cad du gnyen po ma yin pas skyon med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad phyed chos can/ don yod de/ yang ji ltar chags pa phra mo mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin

snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs gnas su bden par dmigs pa'i 'du shes yang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/de bzhin gshegs pa de de kho nar skyabs gnas yin min gyi spros bral zab pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ de bzhin gshegs pa de de kho nar skyabs gnas yin min gyi spros bral de zab pa yin te/ gang gi phyir na/chos kyi lam ste rigs rnams rang bzhin gyis rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /gzhi lam 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi chags pa 'joms par mi nus pa/ sa mtshams theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ gnyis pa la/ spong byed gnyen po dang / zab pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / rtogs dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas 'o na mtshan 'dzin te chags pa de ji ltar spong snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i mnyam bzhag bar chad med lam de chos can/ rang gi spang bya mtshan 'dzin gyi chags pa spong ba

༄༅/ /yin te/ gzugs la sogs pa shes pa dang shes bya'i chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du shes pa'i theg chen bar chad med lam yin pas so/ /mdor na/ ——gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /chos thams cad rang bzhin ma dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas rang gi spang bya mtshan 'dzin gyi chags pa stong byed kyi theg chen gyi bar chad med lam/sa mtshams byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag bar chad med lam na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas yang ji ltar chos rnams kyi rang bzhin de zab pa yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin spros bral de chos can/ mthar 'dzin can gyi blo ngor zab pa yin te/ de'i blos rtogs par dka' ba'i don yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ des rtogs par dka' ba yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ yang gcod du mig gi rnam par shes pas mthong ba dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pas thos pa dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus kyis rnam par shes pas nges pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pas rnam par shes pa dang / thams cad kyi mngon par shes pas bkag pa ste/ yongs gcod

du rnam par shes pa thams cad kyis dmigs pa bsal bas so/ /gsum pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas yang chos rnams kyi rang bzhin de ji ltar rtogs par dka' ba yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin spros bral de ni chos can/ mthar 'dzin can gyi blos rtogs par dka' ba yin te/ mthar 'dzin can gyi bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ mthar 'dzin can gyi skyes bu de chos can/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin spros bral de khyod kyi bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ khyod kyis gzugs nas sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i rnam pa'i bar gyi rang bzhin mi shes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag gis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs rgyas par brjod nas de'i rjes su de gnyis kyi mjug bsdu gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyas par bshad pa don bsdu ba'i sgo nas shes dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ thams cad

༄༅/ /shes pa gnyis 'chad pa'i skabs su sngar de ltar ji skad bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gang gis na/ byang sems chen pos so/ /gang na/ nyan rang gi mkhyen pa mi mthun phyogs dang byang sems sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa gnyen po'i phyogs kyi rab tu dbye ba ma lus pa skabs gsum pa'i skabs 'dir shes par bya'o/ /ngag don/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems chen pos thams cad shes pa rnyed 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i dbye ba ma lus pa shes dgos te/ byang sems chen po shes par bya ba'i phyir du byams pa mgon pos skabs gsum pa 'dir spang gnyen gyi dbye ba rgyas par (stan pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la dngos dang / mnyam nyid gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/gong du bstan pa de ltar mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i dbye ba brjod nas de'i rjes su 'di gnyis kyi gnas lugs shes nas mi dmigs par sgom pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ spang gnyen gyis gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsgoms pas gtan la dbab dgos pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas spang

gnyen gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don de dag bsgom pa'i sbyor ba gang yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi sbyor ba/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi sbyor ba dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor zhing sgom mo/ /gang gis na/ byang sems chen pos so/ /gang la dmigs nas na/ yul bcu po de dang de la dmigs nas so/ /ji ltar na/ rnam mkhyen yul byed pas zhen spyod mngon gyur ba spangs pa'i sgo nasaso/ /des na rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa la zhen spyod mngon gyur ba spangs nas mi dmigs par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni spyod pa bkag pa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa bcu'o/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yul bcu yod pas so/ /phye ba'i sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod / bcu po gang zhe na/ gzhi'i ngo bo la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas gzugs sogs chos thams cad kyi ngo bo la zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spangs nas mi dmigs par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ gzhi'i khyad par la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas gzugs sogs kyi khyad par mi rtag stong nyid sogs la zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spa ngas nas sogs
