༄༅/ /'dra / mtshan nyid dang spangs gnyen la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi gzugs sogs dang / chags pa dang bcas pa dang / chags pa med pa la zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spangs nas sogs 'dra/ de la rdzogs pa dang ma rdzogs pa'i gzugs sogs ni byis pa rnams kyis gzugs sogs su ma grub pa la gzugs sogs su btags pa'i kun btags te/btags pa ltar ngo bor med cing mtshan nyid kyis stong pas yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs pa'i phyir de la ma rdzogs pa'i gzugs sogs zhes bstan no/ /gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid yongs grub de mngon sum du rtogs na sgrib pa spong zhing yon tan gyi tshogs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de la rdzogs pa'i gzugs sogs zhes bstan to/ /mi 'gyur ba dang byed pa po med pa la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ yum rang bzhin spros bral ni bstan ma bstan gyi 'phel 'grib mi byed pas gzhan du mi 'gyur ba yin la/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas yum rang bzhin spros bral gzhan du mi 'gyur ba la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid ni bsngags pa brjod ma brjod kyis sems chags pa dang khong khro bar mi byed pas byed pa po med pa yin la/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed thes chos rnams kyi chos nyid byed pa po med pa la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ bya dka' ba

rnam pa gsum la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas ched du bya ba dang / sbyor ba dang / byed pa bya dka' ba nyid la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ de rnams gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du go cha bgos pa ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi nang nas rnam mkhyen gyi bdag nyid kyi ched du bya ba bya dka' ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du lam gsum rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i phyir sgom pa ni lam shes kyi bdag nyid kyi sbyor ba bya dka' ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rtsol ba byed pa ni gzhi shes kyi bdag nyid byed pa bya dka' ba ste rnam pa gsum mo/ /ngag don/ byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ ched du bya ba bya dka' ba spyod pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba 'i ched du go cha bgos pa'i phyir/ chos can/ sbyor ba bya dka' ba spyod pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du lam gsum rang bzhin ma dmigs par sgom pa'i phyir/ chos can/ byed pa bya dka' ba spyod pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rtsol bar byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la khyab pa yod de/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di de bzhin gshegs pa rnam/sa kyis 'dam bu'i tshal la

༄༅/ /sogs pa ltar yongs su gang bar gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bskal ba'am bskal pa bas lhag par chos bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa re res kyang sems can grangs dang tshad dang dpag tu ma mchis pa mya ngan las 'das kyang / sems can gyi khams la bri ba'am gang ba med pa'i phyir/ mdo ji bzhin no/ /'bras bu yod pa la spyod pa bkag pa ni/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ spyod pa bkag pa'i gzhi shesasbyor ba chos can/ 'bras bu mi stong pa yin te/ khyod bsgoms pas skal ba ji lti ba bzhin du 'bras bu byang chub gsum 'thob pas so /gzhan la rag las pa med pa la spyod pa bkag pa'i ni/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas srung byed gzhan gyi rkyen gyis mi 'gro ba la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ spyod (pa bkag pa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba chos can/ srung byed gzhan la rag las pa med de/ khyod la gnas na gnas pa po de nyid khyod kyis bsrung bskyab sba bar byed pa'i phyir/ shes byed snang ba bdun la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed nga sa dngos po rnams rang bzhin ma dmigs par shes par byed pa snang ba bdun la zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spangs nas ma dmigs par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ shes byed bdun po gang zhe na/ chos thams cad rang

bzhin gyis stong na bza' btung la so gas pa'i dngos po'i tha snyad thams cad mi 'thad par thal lo zhe na/ don dam par cir yang ma grub pas mi 'dod pa sgrub pa med la/ kun rdzob tu ma khyab ste/ bza' btung la sogs pa chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa rmi lam nang gi bza' btung la sogs pa lta bu yin te/ gnyid dang 'dra ba'i bag chags yongs su 'gyur ba snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ kha dog la sogs pa'i sgo nas gzugs la sogs dmigs pa de chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma'i rta glang la sogs pa lta bu yin te/ sgyu ma'i sngags rdzas dang 'dra ba'i 'khrul ba'i rgyu rkyen mnyam du tshogs pa las byung ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ sems sems byung rnams dmigs yul la dmigs nas 'byung ba de chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa smig rgyu la chur snang ba lta bu yin te/smig rgyu chur 'gal ba ltar bden par 'gal ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs rnams chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa brag cha lta bu yin te/ brag cha sgra gzhan gyi rkyen la rag pa ltar brjod 'dod la sogs pa'i rgyu rkyen la rag las pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu 'bras 'bras 'dra bar 'byung ba chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa gzugs brnyan lta bu yin te/

༄༅/ /rang rgyu bag chags mthun pa las 'dra bar snang ba tsam yin gyi rdzas dngos su ma 'phos pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po rnams rang gi rgyu rkyen la brten pa chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa dri za'i grong khyer lta bu yin te/ rten bden pa ba med par 'byung ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ skyes bu rnams 'gro 'ong sogs byed pa de chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa sprul pa lta bu yin te/ don dam par byed pa po min bzhin du snang ba de yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na byang sems kyi spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa bcu po rjes su 'gro ba nyan rang gi sbyor ba shugs la 'phen pa'i sgo nas bstan to / /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bstan pas shugs kyis nyan thos slob pa dang theg 'bring slob pa rnams ji skad bshad pa gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pa'i sgo nas sgom pa las bzlog ste rang don du myang 'das yid la byed pas phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa la dmigs nas sbyor bar byed pa yin pas na nyan thos sbyor lam pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ rang don du myang 'das yid la byed pas phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par rtogs nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams

sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sbyor ba'i 'og tu mnyam pa nyid bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ mnyam pa nyid kyi sgo nas sbyor ba bsgom dgos pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba sgom pa'i gnas skabs su shes pa dang shes bya la rlom pa bsal nas mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo dngos po dang / mtshan ma dang / spros pa dang / rtogs pa la mnyam pa nyid bzhi yin no/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan spang bya rlom pa bzhi yod pas de'i gnyen po bzhir phye'o/ /bzhi po gang zhe na/ gzugs la sogs pa dngos po dang /sngon po la sogs pa mtshan ma dang / gcig gnyis la sogs pa spros pa dbye ba dang / nges 'byed cha mthun la sogs pa rtogs pa rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa ni yul mnyam pa nyid yin la/ spyod pa bkag pa'i stor ba bsgom pa'i skabs su gzugs la sogs pa dngos po dang / sngon po la sogs pa mtshan ma dang / gcig gnyis la sogs pa spros pa dang / nges 'byed cha mthun sogs rtogs pa la rlom pa bsal nas mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi ni yul can spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba de'i mnyam pa nyid dngos po dang / mtshan ma dang / spros pa dang / rtogs pa mnyam pa nyid yin no/ /rlom pa ni

༄༅/ /mngon zhen no/ /sbyor lam la gnas pa'i byang sems chen po'i rgyud kyi gzugs la sogs pa'i don dngos po la rlom pa bsal nas ma dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid yin te/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba sgom pa'i skabs su shes pa dang shes bya la rlom pa bsal nas mi dmigs pa mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yi/na pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la ngo bo mdor bstan/ rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/mnyam pa nyid bstan nas de'i 'og tu mthong lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid so sor rtogs nas mthong lam sgom dgos pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi po re re la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang / chos shes pa'i ye shes dang / rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang / rjes su shes pa'i ye shes te skad cig ma bcu drug po 'di chos can / thams cad shes pa nyid kyi skabs su bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi

rtag min/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min/ /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug gang yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la/ dngos bstan theg chen gyi mthong lam/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi mthong lam gnyis/ dang po la/ rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa dang / mjug bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bcu drug po re re la yul dang yul can gnyis gnyis yod pas/ sdug bsngal la chos bzod la yul ni/ gzugs sogs kyi skabs stobs kyis bden bzhi mtshon pas/ sdug bden don dam par rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin pa'i rnam pa de sdug bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bden chos can/ don dam par rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin te/ khyod don dam par de dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ yul can ni sdug bden gyi chos rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin pa'i rnam pa mngon sum du gtso bor gsal la nges par 'dren nus su rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam mthong lam skad cig dang po de mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa yin la/ mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod chos can/ sdug

༄༅/ /bden de don dam par rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin par rtogs pa yin te/ de don dam par de dang bral bar rtogs pa'i phyir te/ de gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'di bzhin du 'og ma rnams su yang sbyor mdzod/ sdug bden gyi chos rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba de sdug bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bden chos can/ don dam par rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba yin te/ don dam par sdug bsngal yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ sdug bden gyi chos rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ sdug bden chos can/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin te/ don dam par bdag gi bas stong mi stong dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ sdug bden gyi chos don dam par skye 'gag kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang 'phel 'grib sogs ma yin pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa man 'dra/ sdug bden chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag sogs ma yin te/ don dam par ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par skye 'gag dang bral ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba de kun 'byung bden pa'i

rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ kun 'byung bden pa chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag dang bral ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin te/ don dam par rgyu yin min gyis stong pa 'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir / kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam pa nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i chags pa thams cad dang bral ba de kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par rtsa nyon nye nyon thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ don dam par kun 'byung yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par yongs su 'dzin pa las grol ba de kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ don dam pa yongs su 'dzin pa las grol ba yin te/ don dam par rab tu skye mi skye dang bral ba'i phyir/ man 'dra/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par rang gi ngo bo brjod du med pa de kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par rang gi ngo bo brjod du med de/ don dam par rkyen yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par 'gog bden 'di'i don tshig tu brjod pas rgyud gzhan la sbyin du med pa de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ 'gog bden chos can/ don dam par khyod kyi don tshig tu brjod pa'i sgo nas rgyud gzhan la sbyin du med de/

༄༅/ /gang gi phyir/ don dam par 'gog pa yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par dmigs pa med pa de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ don dam par dmigs pa med de/ don dam par zhi ma zhi dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis las 'das shing rang gzhin gyi rnam par dag pa de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par mtha' gnyis las 'das shing rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin te/ don dam par gya nom yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par nad thams cad mi skye ba de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par nad thams cad mi skye ba yin te/ don dam par nges 'byung yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ lam bden gyi chos ngan song chad pa de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ lam bden chos can/ don dam par ngan song chad pa yin te/ don dam par lam bden yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ lam bden gyi chos don dam par 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i don gyi thabs la rnam par mi rtog pa de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ lam bden chos can/ don dam par 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i don gyi thabs la

rnam par mi rtog pa yin te/ don dam par rigs pa yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ lam bden gyi don dam par chos thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang ma 'brel ba de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/chos can/ don dam par chos thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang ma 'brel ba yin te/ don dam par sgrub pa yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ lam bden gyi chos don dam par brjod bya'i dngos po shes bya dang rjod byed sgra gnyis po la so sor snang ba'i shes pa skye ba med pa de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par ming don gnyis la so sor snang ba'i shes pa skye ba med de/ don dam par nges 'byin yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas bden bzhi rtag mi rtag la sogs pa'i spros bral gyi rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas theg chen gyi mthong spang du gyur pa'i rtag mi rtag la sogs pa'i sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral ba de lta bu'i rnam pa can gyi mthong lam bzod shes skad cig ma bcu drug po de dag nyid kun shes pa nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam yin te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam ma skyes gong gi byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos mthong lam pa rnams kyis gong du bstan pa de

༄0/ /las zlog pa rang don myang 'das yid la byed pas bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug tu sgom pa sgom pa'i sgo nas so/ /nyan thos kyi mthong spang du gyur pa'i rtag pa la sogs pa gang zag gi bangag tu sgro 'dogs pa'i nyon mongs pa bcu drug spangs pa'i rnam pa can gyi mthong lam bzod shes skad cig ma bcu drug po ni kun shes 'chad pa'i skabs su shugs la bstan pa'i nyan thos kyi mthong lam yin te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam ma skyes gong gi nyan thos 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig bcu drug dang sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bcu drug so sor sbyor mdzod/ drug pa ni/ byams pa mgon pos gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs gsum pa 'dir byang sems chen po rnams la sgom lam rtsa tshig gis zin par dngos su ma bstan to/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/ theg chen gyi sgom lam skabs gnyis par rgyas par bstan zin pa la dgongs / nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas mngon du mi byed pa la dgongs nas so/ /'o na nyan thos kyi mthong lam ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas shes par bya ba yin pas so/ /ngag don/ byams pa mgon po chos can/ nyid kyis skabs gsum pa 'dir byang sems chen po rnams la sgom lam rtsa tshig gis dngos su zin par ma bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyid

kyis theg chen gyi sgom lam skabs gnyis par rgyas par bstan zin pa la dgongs/ nyan thos kyi byang chub sems dpas mngon du mi byed pa la dgongs nas 'dir de ltar ma bstan pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyid kyis skabs gsum pa 'dir nyan thos kyi mthong lam dngos su bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyan thos kyi lam byang chub sems dpas shes bya yin pa la dgongs nas 'dir de ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang / zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sngar bstan pa de ltar mkhyen gsum rgyas par bstan nas de'i rjes su mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyas par bshad pa don bsdu ba'i sgo nas shes dgos pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum chos can/ khyod la mjug bsdu bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyis mngon par rtogs pa'i don mtha' dag sdud par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltang bstan pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ rab 'byor/ mtha' gnyis rnam dag /spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u gsum gyi brjod bya rnam pa gsum po rdzogs par bstan pa yin no/ /gang gis na/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs dang po gsum gyi gzhung gis so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di dang / yang bstan pa'i lam shesapa

༄༅/ /nyid 'di dang / yang bstan pa'i thams cad shes pa nyid 'di ste/ mkhyen gsum rdzogs par bstan pa de ltar na ste de'i phyir ro/ /ngag don ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs dang po gsum gyi gzhung tshig chos can/ rab 'byor dang mtha' gnyis rnam dag dang spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u gsum gyi brjod bya rnam pa gsum rdzogs par bstan pa yin te/ mkhyen pa gsum rdzogs par bstan pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen dang lam shes la nye tshig sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bshad ma thag pa thams cad shes pa nyid dang nye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de'i tshul te de dang 'dra bar bstan to/ /bzhi pa ni/ mdor na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ thams cad shes pa nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs gsum pa'i 'grel pa don gsal ba'i snying po gsal byed re zhig rdzogs so/ /de ltar skabs gsum pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad shes pa nyid kyi bdag nyid rdzogs par bstan nas/ da ni rgyu sbyor ba ston pa la bzhi las/ dang po rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la/ rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/mtshon byed kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bshad par bzhed do/ /gang na/ yul mkhyen gsum bshad nas de'i rjes su rnam rdzogs spyor ba'o/ /gang

gi sgo nas na/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang / /zhes sogs kyi bsdus don lus rnam bzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/ mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du gzhi lam rnam pa thams cad shes pa'i don bsdus nas sgom par byed pas so/ /des na mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shese pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du de nyid bsdus nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /ngag don/ shes bya chos can/ yul mkhyen gsum bshad nas de'i rjes su rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems chen po rnams mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du gzhi lam rnam pa thams cad shes pa nyid bsdus nas sgom par byed pas so/ /byang sems tshogs lam pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du de nyid bsdus nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /des na rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ de

༄tsho/ /thob par byed pa'i sbyor ba la 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa yin no/ /yang gi don ni gzhi lam rnam pa thos bsam gyis shes par bya ba'i phyir du yul du byed par ma zad/ shes pa dbang du bya ba'i phyir yang bsgom zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rnam kun sbyor ba tsam gyi sgom rim dang / khyad par can gyi sgom rim gnyis/ dang po la/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ sgom pa po gang zag /sgom stor ba/ thob bya yon tan/ dor bya skyon/ blang bya mtshan nyid/ rgyu thar pa cha mthun dang bdun/ dang po la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba de yang rnam pa dang la sogs pa sbyor ba dang yon tan dang skyon dang mtshan nyid dang thar pa cha mthun dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs dang srid zhi mnyam nyid dang zhing dag pa dang thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba'i dbye bas rnam pa bcu gcig yin pas de rnams kyi nang nas dang por rnam pa bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam pa gtan la phab nas sbyor ba sgom dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la ngo bo dang / dbye ba mdor bstan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi ni chos can bden pa bzhi yin la de'i bye brag mi mthun phyogs bden bzhi rtag

sogs su 'dzin pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs bden bzhi mi rtag pa la sogs par dmigs pa'i shes pa rnams shes pa'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid du rnam par bzhag go /ngag don/ bden bzhi chos can/ gzhi yin te/rang gi khyad par gyi chos kyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ chos can yin te/ rang gi khyad par gyi chos du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi'i chos mi rtag sogs bcu drug mtshan gzhi/ rnam par mtshon/ khyad par gyi chos yin pa mtshan nyid do/ /byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes mtshan gzhi/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i shes rnam du mtshon/ gzhi bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs par dmigs pa'i shes pa mtshan nyid do/ /bden bzhi rtag pa la sogs par 'dzin pa'i shes pa chos can/ rang gi gnyen po bden bzhi mi rtag pa la sogs par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ de'i spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi mi rtag pa la sogs par dmigs pa'i bar chad med lam du gyur pa'i ye shes chos can/ rang gi spang bya bden bzhi rtag pa la sogs par 'dzin pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs yin te/ de 'joms nus pa'i phyir/ chos can/khyod de'i gnyen pa'i phyogs/ de khyod kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pa 'thad de/ de ltar yin pa de rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam de dag kyang sdud byed

༄༅/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam pa gsum yod pa'i bye brag gis des bsdus pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam de ni rnam pa gsum kho nar bzhed do/ /ngag don/ gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam de ni chos can/ gzhi shes dang / lam shes dang / rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus pa'i shes rnam rnam pa gsum kho nar nges te/ sdud byed mkhyen pa gsum kho nar nges pa'i phyir/ kyang gi don ni/gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam gyi ngo bo mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas phye bar ma zad/ de'i dbye ba de dag kyang mkhyen pa gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsum du bzhag go ces pa'o/ /'o na mkhyen gsum gyis bsdus pa'i rnam pa gsum po gang yin zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/shes bya chos can/ rnam pa rnams mkhyen gsum gyis spyir te thun mong du bstan nas/ de'i rjes su khyad par du so sor phye nas bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum so so'i rnam pa rnams so sor shes dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la bsdus te bstan pa dang / phye ste bshad pa gnyes/ dang po ni/ yum 'di ne med pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pa nas rab 'byor chos kyi dbyings gnas pa nyid do zhes pa'i bar

gyi mdo tshig chos can/ khyod kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas par bshad de/ khyod kyis med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste mi g.yo ba'i rnam pa'i bar nyer bdun po de ni bden pa dang po gsum po re re la bzhi bzhi dang /lam bden la bco lngar bshad pa'i phyir/ de rnams gang zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po bdun pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis ni/ gong du rnam pa gsum du phye ba de la de'i nang nas thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dbang du byas nas/ mdo las rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun gsungs pa'i dang po bcu gnyis dang / bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis rang bzhin dang rang bzhin can du go rim bzhin du sbyar te ston pa la/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos rtag pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i rnam pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid de rang bzhin yin te/ 'dus byas rnams skad cig re re la skye 'jig byed pa'i phyir / sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos rtag pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i rnam pa de chos can/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma rnams rigs 'gre'o/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos de kho nar ma skye ba'i rnam pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te/ zag bcas rnams de kho nar skye 'jig dang bral ba'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ sdug

༄༅/ /bsngal bden pa'i chos don gzhan gyi bdag gis dben pa'i rnam pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos stong pa'i rang bzhin yin te/ stong pa ni dben pa'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag gis mi brdzi ba'i rnam pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos bdag med pa'i rang bzhin yin te/ chos thams cad ni ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag gis mi brdze ba'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sogs pa kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par rang 'bras phung po lnga skye ba'i gnas med pa dang don dam par nam mkha' ltar skye 'gag med pa'i rnam pa de kun 'byung bden pa'i chos rgyu dang / kun 'byung ba'i rang bzhin yin te/ rgyu dang kun 'byung ba'i chos rnams ni de kho nar gnas dang skye 'gag dang bral ba'i nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par yid kyi brjod pa rtog dpyod med pa dang /don dam par yang srid 'byung ba'i rkyen ming bzhi'i phung po med pa'i rnam pa de kun 'byung bden pa'i chos rab skye dang rkyen gyi rang bzhin yin te/ rab skye dang rkyen gyi chos rnams ni de kho nar brjod pa dang ming dang bral ba'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir/ ming bzhi'i phung po rkyen gyi rnam par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gtso bor tshor ba nyams su myong ba ni yang srid 'byung ba'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir te/ tshor ba las sred pa/ sred pa las

srid pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'gog bden gyi chos 'gro ba ste song nas thob byar med pa dang / sngon po la sogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas blos mi 'phrog cing gzung du med pa dang / don dam par dri ma mi zad pa dang /don dam par rtag pa'i gnas su skye ba med pa'i rnam pa de 'gog bden gyi chos 'gog pa dang / zhi ba dang / gya nom dang / nges 'byung gi rang bzhin yin te/ 'gog bden gyi chos rnams ni de kho nar 'gro ba dang / 'phrog pa dang / zad pa dang / skye ba dang bral ba'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden gyi chos song nas thob byar med pa dang / sngon po la sogs pa'i sgo nas blos gzung du med pa'i rnam pa de chos can / 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga la/ bstan/ bshad/ bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni/ lam bden gyi rnam pa dbye gzhi / dbye ngo lam rnam pa gsum mo/ /gsum po gang zhe na/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por zag pa med pa'i lam gcig dang / shes sgrib kyi gnyen por sgom lam zag bcas dang mthong lam zag med dang gnyis bstan pa yin pas so/ /gzhi shes kye rnam pa ston pa na shes sgrib kyi gnyen po ston pa mi 'thad de/ nyan thos la shes sgrib kyi gnyen po med pa'i phyir zer na/ skyon med de/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyis nya'

༄༅/ /thos kyi mngon rtogs bsdus par ma zad rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs kyang bsdus pa'i phyir rang sangs rgyas de dag gi shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen po nyid du/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sgom lam zag bcas mthong lam zag med gnyis bstan pa yin pas so/ /de la lam dang po nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring pa'i rgyud la gtso che/ byang sems kyi rgyud la'ang yod/ lam gnyis pa dang gsum pa theg 'bring pa'i rgyud la gtso che/ byang sems kyi rgyud la'ang yod de/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni nyan thos dang byang chab sems dpa'i bye brag gis go rim bzhin du/ zag pa med pa dang zag pa dang bcas pa dag kyang yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zag bcas zag med kyi khyad par ni/ rjes thob la kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa snang bas zag bcas/ mnyam bzhag la de mi snang bas zag med du bzhag go /nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po la gnyis mi 'byed par shes sgrib kyi gnyen po la zag bcas zag med gnyis su 'byed pa ni/ nyon sgrib bas shes sgrib spang dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /ngag don ni/lam bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ gsum yod de/ zag bcas gcig dang zag med gnyis yod pas so/ /shes bya chos can/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ston pa na shes sgrib kyi gnyen po bstan pa la skyon med de/

thams cad shes pa nyid kyis rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum las/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po lam zag med ni/ lam bden gyi rnam pa la lam gsum yod pa de'i nang nas / lam dang po'i rnam pa ston pa la/ lam bden gyi chos de kho nar myang 'das su 'khrid par byed pa po med pa dang / de kho nar stong nyid shes pa po med pa dang / sems phyin ci log nas ma log par 'pho ba med pa dang / de kho nar nyon mongs pa dang 'dul ba med pa'i rnam pa de rnams/ go rim bzhin du lam bden gyi chos lam dang / sogs pa rigs pa dang / sgrub pa dang / nges 'byin gyi mtshan nyid de rang bzhin yin te/ lam bden gyi chos rnams ni de kho nar byed pa dang / shes pa dang / 'pho ba dang / 'dul ba dang bral ba'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems chen po rnams de kho nar byed po med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas lam bden gyi chos lam la sogs pa la dmigs te bsgom mo/ /dgos pa nyon sgrib ma lus pa spang ba'i phyir du'o/ /ji ltar na gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas cir yang rnam par mi rtog par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis so/ /nyan thos slob pa rnams kyis rnam pa de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te nyon mongs ma lus par spang ba'i phyir/ rang don du myang 'das yid la byed pas cir yang

༄༅/ /rnam par mi rtog par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /gnyis pa shes sgrib kyi gnyen po lam zag bcas la rnam pa lnga ste/ byang sems chen po rnams ni rmi lam ltar rang bzhin gyis ngo bo nyid med pa dang / sgra brnyan ltar rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa dang / mig g.yor ltar rang bzhin ma 'gags pa dang / smig rgyu ltar gzod ma nas zhi ba dang / sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa ste rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas/ chos can thams cad la dmigs te/ dgos pa shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bag chags dang bcas pa'i gnyen por/ tshul gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas/ cir yang rnam pa mi rtog par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring ba rnams ni rnam pa de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por / rang don du myang 'das yid la byed pas cir yang mi rtog par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /ngag don/ sa dang po'i bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi spang bya shes sgrib kyi gnyen po yin te / gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yed la byed pas rme lam ltar rang bzhen gyi ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te cir yang mi rtog par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis sgom

pa'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ des rigs 'gre'o/ /gsum pa shes snyib kyi gnyen po lam zag med rnam pa drug ste/ byang sems chen po rnams ni de kho nar nyon mongs pa med pa dang rnam par byang ba med pa dang / gos pa med pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / de kho nar gzugs nathe byang chub kyi bar brlom byar med pa dang / chos dbyings mi g.yo bar rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dge ba la sogs pa'i chos can thams cad la dmigs te/ dgos pa rim pa bzhin du shes sgrib nyon mongs pa bden 'dzin gyi rtogs pa dang / shes sgrib rnam byang dang / nyon mongs pa'i bag chags dang / gzugs la sogs pa'i spros pa dang /rang gi rtogs pa dang / chos dbyings nyams par bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i gnyen por/ tshul gzhan don du man 'dra/ ngag don ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi spang bya shes sgrib kyi rnam byang bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i gnyen po yin te/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas de kho nar rnam byang med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te man 'dra'o/ /des gzhan rnams kyang 'gre'o/ /'di'i gnyen po drug ni/ spang bya drug po gnyen po re res spang bya re re spong bas na/ 'di'i spang gnyen so sor nges pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ shesabya

༄༅/ /chos can/ lam bden la rnam pa bco lnga yod de/ lam dang po la rnam pa bzhi/ gnyis pa la lnga/ gsum pa la drug yod pa de ltar na ste de'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ spyir gcig tu bsdoms nas bgrangs na thams cad shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun yod de/ gzhi shes la bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga yod pa'i phyir / gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa la/ gsum las/ mdor bstan ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bshad nas de'i 'og tu lam shes kyi rnam pa bshad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi'i gnas lugs shes nas lam nyams su len dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ yum 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyi rol tu phyin pa'o nas/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo chos can/ lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas par bstan pa yin te/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar so drug po de dag rgyu kun 'byung bden pa la brgyad dang / lam gyi bden pa la bdun dang / sdug bsngal bden pa la lnga dang /

'gog bden la bcu drug tu bsgrags pa'i phyir/ yang bsgrags pas te khong du chud par bya'o/ /gang na/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar rnam pa so/ drug po de dag rgyu kun 'byung bden pa la brgyad/ lam bden la bdun dang / sdug bsngal bden pa la lnga dang / 'gog bden la bcu drug tu gdul bya rjes 'jug rnams kyis so/ /gzhan nas bstan pa'i bden bzhi'i go rim dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan gyi bden bzhi'i go rim de go rim skyon can du 'gyur ro zhe na/ byams mgon chos can/ 'dir bstan gyi bden bzhi'i go rim de gzhan nas bstan pa'i bden bzhi'i go rim dang mi mthun na go rim skyon can yin mi dgos te/ 'dir bden pa bzhi po de don gyi rim pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir te/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs la brten nas kun 'byung bden pa rgyu/sdug bsngal bden pa 'bras bu/ cig 31sa rnam byang gi phyogs la brten nas lam bden rgyu/ 'gog bden 'bras bu yin par bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi las/ spang bya kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa la phye ste bshad/ bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la bzhe las/ rgyu'i rnam pa ni/ byang sem sa chen po rnams yin lugs la 'dod chags dang bral ba dang mi gnas pa dang / zhi bar rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo

༄༅/ /nas kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa rgyu la dmigs te sgom mo/ /dgos pa rgyu'i chos rang don du 'dod yon lnga don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang / 'dod yon lnga la mngon par zhen pa'i 'dod chags dang /yang srid la mngon par dga' ba'i sred pa'i gnyen por tshul gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas cir yang mi rtog par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis so/ /ngag don/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi spang bya 'dod yon lnga don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa'i gnyen po yin te/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas yin lugs la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ rang don du 'dod yon lnga don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa chos can/ rgyu yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ des rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung ba'i rnam pa ni/ byang sems chen po rnams yin lugs la 'dod chags dang zhe snang dang gti mug med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa kun 'byung la dmigs te sgom mo/ /dgos pa kun 'byung ba'i chos 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi gnyen por/ tshul 'dra/ ngag don/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi spang bya 'dod chags bden 'dzin

gyi gnyen po yin te/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas yin lugs la 'dod chags med pa'i rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ dug gsum chos can/ kun 'byung yin te / rang 'bras sdug bsngal ma lus par skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rab skye dang / bzhi pa rkyen gyi rnam pa ni/ byang sems chen po rnams yin lugs la kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa rab skye dang / yin lugs la sems can med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa rkyen la dmigs te sgom mo/ /dgos pa rab skye'i chos kun tu rtog pa dang rkyen gyi chos sems can du mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por ro/ /tshul 'dra/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi bar chad med lam chos can/ rang gi spang bya kun tu rtog pa dang sems can du mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen po yin te/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas yin lugs la kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs med pa dang / yin lugs la sems can med pa'i rnam pa mngon sum du rtog pa'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa chos can/ rab skye yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal drag tu skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ sems can du mngon par zhen pa'i 'jig lta chos

༄༅/ /can / rkyen yin te/ rang 'bras nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ rgyu kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa brgyad yod pa yin te/ rgyu'i rnam pa 'dun pa la sogs pa gsum/ kun 'byung ba'i rnam pa 'dod chags la sogs pa gsum/ rab skye'i rnam pa kun tu rtog pa gcig /rkyen gyi rnam pa gcig yod pa de ltar na ste de'i phyir/ chos can/ kun 'byung bden pa'i yul can/ lam shes kyi rnam pa brgyad yod pa yin te/ rang don du 'dod yon lnga don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa la sogs pa'i gnyen por gyur pa gsum/ dug gsum gyi gnyen por gyur pa gsum dang / yang dag pa ma yin pa rtog pa'i gnyen por gyur pa gcig dang / sems can du mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por gyur pa gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam bden gyi rnam pa la phye ste bshad/ bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/dang po ni/ theg chen gyi lam bden gyi chos lam ni/ sems can tshad med pa thams cad la byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs 'byed par byed do/ /ji ltar 'byed na/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis so/ /des na theg chen mthong lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ theg chen gye lam yin te/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i sgo nas sems can tshad med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod

pa'i go skabs 'byed pa'i rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi lam bden gyi chos rigs pa'i ngo bo ni/ chos thams cad yin lugs la chos dbyings su tha mi dad par rtogs pa'i ye shes yin no/ /de ji ltar rigs pa yin zhe na/ chos thams cad yin lugs la chos dbyings su tha mi dad par rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi ye shes chos can/ rigs pa yin te/ mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa'i sgo nas chos dbyings ma lus par rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi lam bden gyi chos sgrub pa'i ngo bo ni cir yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yin no/ /de ji ltar sgrub pa yin zhe na/ cir yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chos can / sgrub pa yin te/ dngos 'dzin can gyi blos gzhal du med pa'i chos dbyings rtogs par byed pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi lam bden gyi chos nges 'byin gyi ngo bo ni dman mchog gi rtogs pa gang la yang nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa'i ye shes yin no/ /'di la 'thad pa mdo las ma gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gdul bya nye ba na gnas pa'i bsam pa la dgongs nas so/ khrigugs la thob pas sbyor na /de ji ltar nges 'byirne yin na/ dman ra/chog gi rtogs pa gang la yang nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa'i theg chen slob pa'i ye shes chos can/ nges 'byin yin te/ mngon zhen med par rdzogs pa'i byang chab tu

༄༅/ /bgrod par byed pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bdun yod pa yin te/ lam la gnyis dang / rigs pa la gnyis dang / sgrub pa la gnyis dang / nges 'byin la gcig yod pa de'i phyir ro/ /byang sems chen po rnams tshad med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa bdun gyi sgo nas lam bden gyi chos lam rigs pa sgrub pa nges 'byin la dmigs te sgom mo/ /dgos pa lam la sogs pa la bden zhen gyi sgrub pa'i gnyen por ro/ /tshul 'dra'o/ /gsum pa sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa ni/ byang sems chen po rnams rang gi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal bden pa la dmigs/ spyi'i mtshan nyid lnga pa yang dag par mtshan nyid gang yang med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med la dmigs te sgom mo/ /dgos pa sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang de'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs la bden zhen gyi sgrib pa'i gnyen por ro/ /tshul 'dra'o/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa bzhi chos can/ rang gi mtshan nyid du bzhag pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang zag gi bdag med yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis der bzhag pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal bde' pa'i chos

yang dag par na mtshan nyid gang yang med pa'i rnam pa chos can/ spyi'i mtshan nyid du bzhag pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ kun la khyab pa'i chos kyi bdag med yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis der bzhag pa'i phyir/ chos can/sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ shes bya chos can/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa lnga yod pa yin te/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa bzhi/ spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa gcig yod pa de'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa 'gog bden gyi rnam pa la gnyis las/ dang po phye ste bshad pa la/ dngos po 'gog pa dang / btags pa 'asog pa dang /byed pa po 'gog pa dang / yul du 'byul pa 'gog pa dang / ngo bo nyid 'gog pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ byang sems chen po rnams ni mig sogs nang gi dngos po drug dang / gzugs sogs phyi'i dngos po drug dang / phyi nang gnyis ga'i skye mched kyi dngos po rnams la bden zhen dgag pa'i phyir du/ nang dang phyi dang gnyis ka stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas/ nang dang / phyi dang / phyi nang gnyis ga'i dngos po rnams la dmigs te sgom mo/ /tshul 'dra'o/ /byang sems mthong lam pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ mig sogs nang gi dngos po la bden zhen ci rigs pa spangs pa yin te/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid

༄༅/ /la byed pas nang stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs nas sgom pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ des rigs 'gre'o/ /mdor na/ mig sogs rang bzhin gyis stong pa rang bzhin rnam dag de rnams la zhen pa spangs pa glo bur rnam dag ste/ de lta bu'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong nyid gsum ni 'gog bden gyi chos 'gog pa'i rnam pa'i ngo po yin te/ mngon zhen ci rigs pa 'gog pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ byang sems chen po rnams ni mthar 'dzin can gyis btags pa'i bdag stong nyid la mngon zhen dgag pa'i phyir du/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid la dmigs te sgom mo/ /de bzhin du mthar 'dzin can gyis btags pa'i bdag snod kyi 'jig rten dang / don dam pa myang 'das dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / rtag chad kyi mtha' dang / thog mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba dang / rtogs pa'i chos dor ba med pa la mngon zhen dgag pa'i phyir du chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang /mtha' las 'das pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas snod kyi 'jig rten sogs la dmigs te sgom mo/ /tshul 'dra/ theg chen mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi ye

shes chos can/ btags pa'i bdag chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid mngon zhen ci rigs pa spangs pa yin te/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs nas sgom pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid de de kho nar rang gi ngo bos stong pa nyid yin te/ btags pa'i bdag chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid la mngon zhen dgag bya yin pas so/ /des snga phyi rigs 'gre'o/ /mdor na/ stong nyid sogs rang bzhin gyis stong pa rang bzhin rnam dag /de rnams la mngon zhen spangs pa glo bur rnam dag ste/de lta bu'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong nyid brgyad chos can/ zhi ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo yin te/ mngon zhen ci rigs pa zhi ba'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ byang sems chen po rnams ni dngos smra ba gzhan gyis kun nas btags pa'i stong nyid byed pa por mngon par zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir du rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas stong pa nyid la dmigs te sgom mo/ /tshul 'dra'o/ /mdor na stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa rang bzhin rnam dag /stong nyid la zhen pa spangs pa glo bur rnam dag ste de lta bu'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid chos can/ gya nom pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo yin

༄༅/ /te / sdug bsngal dang mi gtsang ba ci rigs pas dben nga 'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ byang sems chen po rnams ni gzugs sogs chos thams cad btags pa tsam dang / gzugs su rung ba sogs mtshan nyid du dang / 'das ma 'ongs sogs dus su zhabrul pa la mngon zhen dgag pa'i phyir du/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas gzugs sogs chos thams cad dang gzugs su rung ba sogs dang 'das ma 'ongs sogs la dmigs te sgom mo/ /tshul 'dra/ mdor na/ gzugs sogs rang bzhin gyis stong pa rang bzhin rnam dag de rnams la zhen pa spangs pa glo bur rnam dag ste de lta bu'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong nyid gsum chos can/ nges par 'byung ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo yin te/ rtag pa'i gnas su gdon mi za bar 'byung ba'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ byang sems chen po rnams ni zhen pa bco lnga bsal ba'i nges 'byung gi ngo bo nyid la mngon zhen dgag pa'i phyir du dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas zhen pa bco lnga bsal ba'i nges 'byung ge ngo bo la dmigs te sgom mo/ /tshul 'dra'o/ /mdor na/ nges 'byung rang bzhin gyis stong pa rang bzhin rnam dag /nges

'byung gi ngo bo la zhen pa spangs pa glo bur rnam dag ste/ de lta bu'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid chos can/ gang nges 'byung gi rnam pa yin te/ zhen pa bco lnga bsal ba'i nges 'byung gi ngo bo la zhen pa'i dri ma dag pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ kho na'i don ni gang nges 'byung dang ji ltar nges 'byung gnyis kyi nang nas gang nges 'byung kho na zhen pa bco lnga bsal ba'i nges 'byung gi ngo po la zhen pa'i dri mas dag go /gang nges 'byung ni 'byung sa/ ji ltar nges 'byung ni 'byung byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bcu drug yod pa yin te/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa gsum/ zhi ba'i rnam pa brgyad/ gya nom gyi rnam pa bzhi/ nges 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi yod pa de'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ spyir gcig tu bsdoms nas bgrangs na lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug yod pa yin te/ kun 'byung bden pa'i yul can gyi lam shes kyi rnam pa brgyad/ lam bden gyi bdun/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i lnga/ 'gog bden gyi lam shes kyi rnam pa bcu drug yod pa'i phyir ro/ gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la gsum las/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/

༄༅/ /lam shes kyi rnam pa bstan nas/ de'i 'og tu rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bstan pa la rgya mtshan yod de/ lam gyi gnas lugs shes nas rnam mkhyen gyi ched du 'bad dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni / sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa nas bzung ste sangs rgyas nyid skye rnam pa'i mthar thug pa rnams ni bzhed pa yin no/ /gang gis na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i skus so/ /ji ltar na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa nas sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin 'phags pa'i lam yan lag gi bar sum cu rtsa bdun ni slob ma nyan thos la yod pa dang mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi ye shes kyi phar phyin gyi bar sum cu rtsa bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' dang mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs nas sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar sum cu rtsa dgu rnams ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan lam gyi bden pa rnam pa gsum ste/ thams cad shes pa dang / lam shes dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de/ gzhi

shes dang lam shes rjes mthun pa/ rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa ste mkhyen pa gsum du phye bas sam/ mkhyen gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lam yin pa'i sgo nas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rtogs pa yon tan yar ldan du rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir ro/ /ngag don/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi dran pa nyer bzhag nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa'i bar rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu po de rnams chos can/ khyod la nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' la yod pa dang mthun pa dang / sangs rgyas nyid kyi thun mongs ma yin pa'i rnam pa gsum du 'byed pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/khyod mkhyen gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lam yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis der phye ba'i phyir ro/ /shes bya chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu po rnams mkhyen gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lam yin te/ rnam mkhyen gyis 'phags pa thams cad kyi rtogs pa yon tan yar ldan du rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir/ rgyas bshad la gsum las/ dang po gzhi shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la mkhyen pa gsum du phye ba de la de'i nang nas dang po gzhi shes kyi rnam pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ thams cad shes pa'i rnam pa la lus kyi

༄0/ /sgo nas bdun/ yan lag gi sgo nas sum cu rtsa bdun yod de/ dngos po la rtog pa'i lam la bzhi/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam la bzhi ting nge 'dzin stong ba'i lam la bzhi/ mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i lam la lnga/ mngon par rtogs par dang 'brel ba'i lam la lnga/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam la bdun/ rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam la brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ de rnams gang zhe na/ gnyis pa la bdun las/ dngos po la rtog pa'i lam la rtags dgod/ chos can ngos bzung ba dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshogs lam chung ngu la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi chos can/ dngos po la rtog pa'i lam yin te/ rang yul lus la sogs pa'i gnas lugs la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas btags pa'i las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs gang zhig /tshogs lam 'bring ma thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/byang sems chen po rnams ni lus dang tshor ba dang sems dang sems byung chos rnams la dmigs nas/ rnam pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas btags te sgom mo/ /ji ltar na lus rang gi mtshan nyid mi gtsang /tshor bar rang gi mtshan nyid sdug bsngal/ sems rang gi mtshan nyid mi rtag /chos rang gi mtshan nyid bdag med/ spyi'i mtshan nyid yang dag par na rang bzhin gang yang ma grub par mnyam pa nyid du yongs su

btags te sgom mo/ /dgos pa bden pa bzhi'i gnas lugs la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /des na rang yul du gyur pa'i lus la sogs pa'i gnas lugs la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas brtags pa'i shes rab dang dran pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / lus dang / tshor dang / sems dang / chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ yang byang sems chen po rnams ni dran pa nyer bzhag yul lus la sogs pa dang bcas pa la mngon zhen gyi sgrib pa'i gnyen por rang bzhin mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dran pa nyer bzhag yul lus la sogs pa dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas cir yang mi rtog par rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /des 'og ma rnams kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam la gsum las/ dang po mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ dran pa nyer bzhag bstan nas de'i 'og tu rtsol ba las byung ba 'i lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ spangs gnyen gyi gnas lugs la zhugs la spang bya spong zhing gnyen po skyed pa'i brtson 'grus 'byung bas so/ /gnyis pa rtags dgod pa ni/ tshogs lam 'bring la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi

༄tsho/ /rgyud kyi yang dag spong ba bzhi chos can/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam yin te/ mi mthun phyogs spong zhing gnyen po bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs gang zhig /tshogs lam chen po ma thob pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i tshul dang / ngo bo ngos gzung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshogs lam 'bring la gnas pa'i byang sems ni rang gzhan gyi dge mi dge la dmigs nas/ mi dge ba mtha' dag spong zhing dge ba mtha' dag spel ba'i phyir du brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /ji ltar na mi dge ba skyes pa yang dag par spong / phyis 'byung mi skyed/ dge ba skyes pa yang dag par spel/ phyis 'byung bskyed pa'i rgyu'i brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /dgos pa ni de ltar brtsams pas rang rgyud kyi mi dge ba mtha' dag spangs/ dge ba mtha' dag spel ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyu dran pa nyer bzhag las byung zhing mi mthun phyogs spong / gnyen po bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de yang dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / mi dge ba skyes pa spong / phyis 'byung mi skyed/ dge ba skyes pa spel/ phyis 'byung skyed pa'i yang dag spong ba bzhi/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam 'bring nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam

la gsum las mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam bstan nas de'i 'og tu ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus brtsams pas sems las su rung ba nyid du byed pas so/ /gnyis pa rtogs dgod pa ni/ tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i sems pa'i rgyud kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi chos can/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam yin te/ tshogs lam 'bring las byung zhing grogs 'dun pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems las su rung bar byed pa'i las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bdag rkyen spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad brten pa las byung ba'i sems gnas pa las su rung ba'i mngon rtogs ni/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye na/ 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i/ brtson 'grus dang / sems dang / dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ sa mtshams tshogs lam chen po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ de la 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'dun pa'i dbang gis brtson 'grus sgom pa la dga' mgur 'jug pa na sems rtse gcig pa la reg pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ brtson 'grus

༄༅/ /rtsom pa na rtag par sbyor bas sems rtse gcig pa la reg pa'o/ /sems kyi ting nge 'dzin ni sngon ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i bag chags la brten nas sems rtse gcig la reg pa'o/ /dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dmigs pa rab tu 'byed tshopa na sems rtse gcig pa la reg pa'o/ /spang bya nyes pa ni lnga ste le lo dang / gdams ngag brjed pa dang / bying rgod dang / bying rgod zhi bar byed pa'i dus na gnyen po 'du mi byed pa'i nyes pa dang / bying rgod zhi ba na gnyen po 'du byed pa'i nyes pa'o/ /de rnams spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad de/ le lo'i gnyen por 'dun pa dang / rtsol ba dang / dad pa dang / shin tu sbyangs pa dang bzhi bsgom/ gdams ngag brjed pa'i gnyen por dmigs rnams mi brjed pa'i dran pa bsgom/ bying rgod kyi gnyen por shes bzhin bsgom/ bying rgod zhi bar byed pa'i dus na gnyen ngo 'du mi byed pa'i gnyen por gnyen po 'du byed pa'i sems pa bsgom/ bying rgod zhi ba na gnyen po 'du byed pa'i nyes pa'i gnyen por sems rnal du 'jug pa'i btang snyoms sgom mo/ /mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i don thams cad 'grub par byed pas na rdzu 'phrul/ de'i gnas yin pa'i phyir rkang pa'o/ /bzhi pa bden pa mngon rtogs la sbyor ba'i lam la gsum las/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ ting nge 'dzin

yongs su stong ba'i lam bstan nas de'i 'og tu bden pa mngon rtogs la sbyor ba'i lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshogs lam du sems yongs su sbyang ba byas pa la rang 'bras drod dang rtse mo'i sbyor ba 'byung bas so / /gnyis pa rtagos dgod pa ni/ sbyor lam drod la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i dbang po lnga chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i lam yin te/ 'phags lam 'grub pa la dbang byed pa'i drod rtse gang rung gi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa chos can ngos gzung ba ni/ rang 'bras 'phags lam bskyed pa la bdag por gyur pa'i mngon rtogs de rnam byang gi dbang po'i mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi dbang po dang lnga'o/ /sa mtshams sbyor lam drod nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ lnga pa bden pa mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba'i lam la gsum las/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i lam bstan nas/ de'i 'og tu mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel ba'i lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de / sbyor lam drod dang rtse mo las rang 'bras bzod mchog 'byung bas so/ /gnyis pa rtags dgod pa ni/ sbyor lam bzod pa la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi stobs lnga chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa la

༄༅/ /'brel ba'i lam yin te/ bden pa myur du mngon sum du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir du ma dad pa la sogs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i bzod mchog gang rung gi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa chos can ngos gzung ba ni/ rang gi nyer len dbang po las byung zhing mi mthun phyogs srab cing 'joms nus pa'i mngon rtogs ni stobs kyi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang /dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi stobs dang rnam pa lnga'o/ /sa mtshams bzod pa nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ drug pa bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i lam la sngar bzhin gsum las/dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel ba'i lam bstan nas de'i 'og tu mngon par rtogs pa'i lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyu drod rtse bzod mchog las 'bras bu mthong lam 'byung bas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi byang chub yan lag chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam yin te/ de kho na nyid mngon sum gyis gsar du rtogs pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa ni byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang /

chos rab tu rnam 'byed dang / brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyangs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / btang snyoms byang chub kyi yan lag dang rnam pa bdun no/ /sa mtshams mthong lam nas yod / bdun pa rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam la sngar bzhin gsum las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam bstan nas de'i 'og tu rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ bden pa mthong ba yongs su shes pa'i mthong lam las rang 'bras sgom lam 'byung bas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi 'phags lam yan lag chos can/ rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam yin te/ mthong lam gyi rjes su rang gi spang bya nyon sgrib spong ba'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan ni 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / yang dag pa'i lta ba 'phags pa'i lam yan lag nas/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'phags pa'i lam yan lag gi bar rnam pa brgyad do/ /de la yang dag pa'i lta ba dang /rtog pa dang / rtsol ba gsum ni rim pa bzhin shes rab kyi las de kho na'i don rtogs par byed pa dang / de kho na'i don rtogs nas gzhan la gsal bar byed pa dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos sgrub par

༄tsho/ /byed pa rdzogs par byed pas de gsum shes rab kyi phung por bzhag go /yang dag pa'i ngag dang las kyi mtha' gnyis ni rtsa ba'i tshul khrims te/ tshul khrims ni chos kyi longs spyod kyi gzhi yin pas yang dag pa'i chos kyi longs spyod kyi dbang du byas nas dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni/ log pas 'tsho bar byed pa'i chos rnams la mi brten par chos gos la sogs pa'i 'tsho ba'i gzhi yin pas/ yang dag pa'i zang zing gi longs spyod kyi dbang du byas nas de gsum tshul khrims kyi phung por bzhag go /yang dag pa'i dran pas ting nge 'dzin gyi rten gyi bya ba byed/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo yin pas de gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phung por bzhag go /sa mtshams sgom lam nas/ mjug bsdu ba ni/ mdor na dngos po la rtog pa'i lam la bzhi/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam la bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam la bzhi/ mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i lam la lnga/ mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel ba'i lam la lnga/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam la bdun/ rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam la brgyad yod pa de'i phyir / slob ma nyan thos rnams la thams cad shes pa nyid kyi lam gyi rten can gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bdun yod pa yin la/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa so bdun ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud

la yod do/ /lam shes kyi rnam pa la drug las/ dang po gnyen pa'i lam ni/ yul sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos don gzhan gyi bdag gis stong pa dang / ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag med pa'i rnam pa ni yul rnasnyo thar ba'i sgo dang po stong pa nyid/ de gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni yul can rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang po stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ des bdag tu lta ba dang des byas pa bdag gir lta ba'i gnyen po ste/ des 'joms nus pas de la gnyen po'i lam zhes pa bstan to/ /mtshan ma med pa'i ngo bo 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bzhi dang / mtshan ma'i rtog pa sel byed lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi ste brgyad ni yul rnam par thar pa'i sgo gnyis pa mtshan ma med pa/ de brgyad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni yul yul can rnam par thar pa'i sgo gnyis pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ des bdag dang bdag gir lta ba / de'i rgyu'i rnam rtog 'joms nus pas gnyen po'i lam zhes bstan to/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi ste drug ni yul rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum pa smon pa med pa/ de drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni yul can rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum pa smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ des khams gsum la blang byar smon pa'i rnam rtog

༄tsho/ /'joms nus pas gnyen po'i lam zhes bstan to/ /ngag don/ theg chen mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi stong pa bdag med kyi rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ gnyen po'i lam yin te/ rang gi spang bya bdag dang bdag gir lta ba'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yin te/ stong pa dang bdag med pa'i rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ des rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa sprul pa'i lam la gsum las/ dang po gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ sa mtshams dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lta'o/ /gang zag tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i sems dpas/ sems bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas/ yul phyi rol snod bcud kyi gzugs rnams la/tshul che chung bzang ngan mdzes mi mdzes sna tshogs su sprul nas so/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ nang rang lus la gzugs can du 'du shes pa'i sgo nas/ dgos pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen por ro/ /des na bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten te gzugs snang ma dor ba'i sgo nas rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las

grol ba'i rnam grol lam ni gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang lus la gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par ma bzhig pa'i phyir gzugs can/ phyi rol gyi gzugs la dmigs pa'i phyir gzugs la lta ba/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las grol bas rnam par thar pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen po nas yod/ nyan shes kyi phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed dang dgra bcom rgyan can gyi rgyud la yod/ gnyis pa gzugs med gzugs la blta ba'i rnam thar la yang sngar bzhin gsum las/ dang po ni/ lta'o/ /gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/gang gi sgo nas na/ nang lus la gzugs can ma yin pa ming du 'du shes pa'i sgo nas so/ /des na tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten te/ ming du snang ba ma dor ba'i sgo nas rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin sprul pa la shegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol lam mtshan gzhi/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar du mtshon / bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten te ming du snang ba ma dor ba'i sgo nas rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol

༄tsho/ /lam mtshan nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni rang lus la gzugs kyi 'du shes bzhig pa'i phyir gzugs med/ gzhan rnams sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dra'o/ /gsum pa sdug pa'i rnam thar la yang sngar bzhin gsum las/ dang po ni/ rnam thar dang po gnyis la brtan pa thob pa'i sems dpas sdug pa'i rnam thar de dang por shes rab kyi lus kyis mngon sum du byas nas/ bar du rnam thar dang po gnyis kyi rtogs pa ci rigs pa rdzogs par byas te/ mthar rgyun du gnas te sgom mo/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ phan tshun ltos pa dang / rjes su 'brel ba dang / ro gcig pa'i 'du shes gsum gyi sgo nas so/ /de la phan tshun ltos pa'i 'du shes ni rnal 'byor pas blo yul du zangs dang / dngul dang / gser gyi bum pa gsum sprul nas/ dngul bum de zangs bum la ltos te sdug /gser bum la ltos te mi sdug par rtogs pa'i 'du shes so/ /rjes su 'brel ba'i 'du shes ni/ dngul bum gyi steng du zangs bum la ltos te sdug pa/ gser bum la ltos te mi sdug pa la bdag gcig tu 'brel/ de bzhin du sdug pa la'ang mi sdug pa bdag gcig tu 'brel bar rtogs pa'i 'du shes so/ /de nas gzugs thams cad bsres nas sdug pa ro gcig pa'i rnam par mos pa byed pa'i 'du shes ni ro gcig pa'i 'du shes so/ /dgos pa rang yul du gyur

pa'i gzugs rnams la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir du/ sems bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas so/ /gang gi gnyen por na/ gzugs sdug pa sprul pa la dga' ba dang /mi sdug pa sprul pa la mi dga' ba'i nyon mongs pa'i ming can gyi shes sgrib kyi gnyen por sgom mo/ /'o na bsgom bya sdug pa'i rnam par thar pa de gang zhe na/ lta'o/ /gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ gang la dmigs nas na/ phyi rol snod bcud kyi gzugs rnams la dmigs nas so/ /tshul ji ltar na/ sdug pa ro gcig tu sprul nas so/ /des na tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten te 'du shes gsum gang rung gi sgo nas rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs rnams sdug pa ro gcig tu sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol lam de mtshan gzhi/ sdug pa'i rnam thar du mtshon/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems pa la brten te 'du shes gsum gang rung gi sgo nas rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs rnams sdug pa ro gcig tu sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol lam mtshan nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang yul du gyur pa'i gzugs rnams sdug pa ro gcig tu sprul pas na sdug pa/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las grol bas na

༄༅/ /rnam par thar pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rnam thar dang po gnyis la brtan pa thob pa'i rgyud la yod/ kha cig na re/ gong ma gnyis la mi smos par 'di la lus kyis mngon sum du byas nas zhes sogs smon pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin ce na/ gnas pa des 'phags pa rnams shes cher gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na/ gzhan don nges par 'byung ba'i dbang du byas pa'i rnam par thar pa rnam pa gsum ni/ byang sems chen po rnams gzhan don du sprul pa sna tshogs byed pa'i rgyu byed pas sprul pa'i lam zhes bstan to/ /gsum pa mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam la ni/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa las grol ba'i gzugs med pa'i skye mched kyi rnam byang bzhi ni/ thar pa myang 'das dang / gzugs med zhi ba'i ro myang las grol bar mtshungs pas thar pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i lam zhes bstan to/ /de bzhi'i ngo bo ni/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la gnas pa dang / rnam shes dang / ci yang med pa dang / 'du shes med min skye mched la gnas pa yang dag par 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ni rim pa ba'in du nam mkha' dang / rnam shes mtha' yas dang / cir yang med pa dang / 'du shes med min skye mched kyi rnam par thar pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /ngag don/ byang sems mthong lam

me'i rgyud kyi nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la gnas pa yang dag par 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa chos can/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam par thar pa yin te/nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la gnas pa yang dag par 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ thar pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i lam yin te/ myang 'das dang gzugs med zhi ba'i ro myang las grol bar mtshungs pa'i rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar ni dgag bya sems sems byung rags pa zhi ba'i lam yin pas zhi bar gnas pa'i lam yin la/de'i ngo bo ni/ dgag gzhi'i steng du dgag bya 'du shes dang tshor ba rags pa bkag pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi rnam grol lam/ mdor na/ gzhan don gyi ched du bya ba can gyi rnam pa thar pa lnga ni/ de la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe de la lus sems bde bar gnas pas mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pas mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam zhes bstan to/ /bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug rnam pa dgu'o/ /de la bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug bzhi ni rang gi rten chos mthong sgom lam gyi rten byed pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bstan

༄༅/ /to / /gzugs med snyoms 'jug bzhi ni rang gi rten chos sgom lam gyi rten byed pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bstan/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni de la dang por snyoms par 'jug pa dang langs nas mngon du byed paṃ gnyis ka 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems kyis byed pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bstan to/ /ngag don ni/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug bzhi chos can/'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang gi rten chos mthong sgom gyi rten byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis der bstan pa'i phyir/ des rigs 'gre'o/ /de la bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ yan lag rtog dpyod gang rung gis khyad par du byas pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' bde dang nang rab tu dang bas khyad par du byas pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ yan lag dran shes bzhin dang bde bas khyad par du byas pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/

nyid / yan lag dran pa dang btang snyoms yongs su dag par byas pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa'o/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhi la/ nam mkha' dang rnam shes mtha' yas kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig /nam mkha' dang rnam shes mtha' yas pa'i mos pa sngon du btang nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa / so sor phrol/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /ci yang med pa'i mos pa sngon du btang nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa/ 'du shes med min skye mched kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /'du shes rags pa med cing 'du shes zhi ba med pa ma yin pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa'o/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ dgag gzhi'i steng du dgag bya 'du shes dang tshor ba rags pa ci rigs pa bkag pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa/ lnga pa spong ba'i lam ni/ spong ba'i lam la nyon mongs pa dang mi ldan pa'i ngo bo bden bzhi'i yul can gyi bar chad med lam bzhi'o/ /bzhir 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yul bden pa bzhis bsdus pas so/ /ngag don/ mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa chos can/

༄༅/ /spong ba'i lam yin te/ bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ni/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam la pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'o/ /ngag don sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu chos can / sangs rgyas kyi lam yin te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ gnyen po'i lam la gsum/ sprul pa'i lam lagasum/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam la lnga/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam la dgu/ spong ba'i lam la bzhi/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam la bcu yod pa de'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lam shes pa nyid kyi lam gyi rten can gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bzhi yod pa/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bzhi ni sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod do/ /gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la bstan bshad bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam pa so dgu ni chos can/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gci ga pu yin te/ spangs rtogs shin tu phul du byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la yon tan gyi dbye ba dang / de rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa dang / de rnams la mnga' skyur ba'i rnam pa dang / ched du bya ba'i rnam pa dang bzhi/ dang po la bzhi las/ stobs ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam de

la yon tan gyi dbye ba bzhi yod pa'i nang nas dang po stobs 'chad pa la/ mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag bcom pa'i rtogs pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi stobs yin pas dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa bcu'o/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yul bcu yod pas so/ /bcu po gang zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes ni bsam gtan la brten nas gnas dang gnas ma yin pa chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin pas gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin no/ /de la nyes par spyod pa rnams rnam par smin pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i gnas dang yid du 'ong ba'i gnas ma yin/ legs par spyod pa rnams rnam par smin pa yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i gnas ma yin pa ste/ dper na ser sna ni dbul ba'i gnas dang longs spyod che ba'i gnas ma yin/ sbyin pa ni longs spyod che ba'i gnas dang dbul ba'i gnas ma yin pa de lta bu'o/ /gnas ni rgyu'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni bsam gtan la brten nas dge mi dge'i rnam par smin pa bde sdug dang / sems can gyi mos pa sna tshogs dang / dag ma dag ma dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams du ma dang / sems can dbang po mchog rno ba dang mchog ma yin pa 'bring dang / tha ma dang / bde 'gro dang / ngan 'gro thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam

༄7/ /dang / spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / gnyen po rnam par byang ba dang / rang gzhan gyi sngon gyi skye gnas du ma rjes su dran pa dang / sems can gyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba dang / sgrib gnyis kyi zag pa zad pa chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin pas/ las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / mos pa sna tshogs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams du ma dang / dbang po mchog dang mchog ma —yen pa dang /thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / 'chi 'pho dang skye ba dang / zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin no/ /gnyis pa mi 'jigs pa ni/ don gnyis mthar phyin par che ba 'jog pa yang dag par 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab tu mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de gang na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni shes bya thams cad sangs rgyas par che ba 'jog pa dang / rang rgyud kyi zag pa thams cad zad par che ba 'jog pa yang dag par 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pas rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs dang / spangs pa phun tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa gnyis

dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / shes sgrib thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la bar chad byed pa nyid du ston pa dang / thams cad shes pa nyid kyi lam nyan rang byang chub dang / lam shes pa nyid kyi lam rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba nyid du ston par che ba 'jog pa yang dag par 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pas/ bar du gcod pa'i chos dang / nges par 'byung ba'i lam dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa gnyis te bzhi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chos can/ rtogs pa phun tshogs su dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa yin te/ shes bya chos thams cad sangs rgyas par zhal gyis 'ches pa la chos dang mthun pa'i rgol ba med pa'i ston pa yin pas so/ /des rigs 'gre'o/ /gsum pa so sor yang dag rig pa ni/ bsam gtan la brten nas rten dang brten pa dang bshad bya dang 'chad byed chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i ye shes ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi so sor yang dag rig pa yin pas dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de gang na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ bsam gtan la brten nas chos rnams kyi ming gi

༄༅/ /rnam grangs rnams ji snyed pa dang / chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ji snyed pa dang / yul so so'i skad dang / chos rnams kyi rab tu dbye ba chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ye shes yin pas go rim bzhin du/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / don dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa yin no/ /de la chos ni rten rgyu'o/ /don ni brten pa 'bras bu'o/ /bzhi pa sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la bzhi las/ dang po spyod pa ma 'dres pa ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa rnams la sku gsung thugs la 'khrul pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa mnga' yang / rje'ogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni sku gsung thugs kyi gnas ngan len bag chags dang bcas ma lus par spangs pas sku la zuXgral pa mi mnga'/ gsung la ca co mi mnga'/ thugs la dran pa nyams pa dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa dang / blang dor tha dad kyi 'du shes dang / so sor ma brtags par sems can gyi don yal bar 'dor ba'i btang snyoms mi mnga' bas spyod pa ma 'dres pa ni rnam pa drug go /gnyis pa rtogs pa ma 'dres pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni spangs rtogs mthar phyin pas 'dun pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba la

ma thob pa'i nyams pa mi mnga' bas rtogs pa ma 'dres pa rnam pa drug go /gsum pa phrin las ma 'dres pa ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa rnams ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi las res 'ga' lung ma bstan la 'jug pa mnga' yang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las rnams ye shes kyi kun nas bslang zhing ye shes dang lhan cig spyod pas phrin las ma 'dres pa rnam pa gsum mo/ /bzhi pa ye shes ma 'dres pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni dus gsum gyi chos thams cad la ye shes chags thogs med par 'jug pas na 'das pa'i chos rnams la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes ma 'ongs pa dang da lta byung ba'i chos rnams la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes te ye shes ma 'dres pa rnam pa gsum mo/ /ngag don/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyi ye shes de nyan rang byang sems rnams dang thun mong min te/ khyod dus gsum gyi chos thams cad la ye shes chags thogs med par 'jug pa de yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i chos rnams la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes rnam pa gsum yod de/ khyod dus gsum gyi chos thams cad la ye shes chags thogs med par 'jug pa de yin pa'i phyir/ de la nyon sgrib spangs bas ma chags/ shes sgrib spangs pas ma thogs pa'o/ /mdor na/ rdzogs

༄༅/ /pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug /rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug /phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum yod pa de'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos nyan rang byang sems rnams dang ma 'dres pa bco brgyad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bshad cing 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis na sman pa lta bu'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis so/ /gang na sman lta bu'i spros bral de bzhin nyid do / /gang la na nad pa lta bu'i gdul bya rigs can gsum la'o/ /dgos pa nad lta bu'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /ji ltar na/ sman pas nad pa la sman gtong ba ltar drang don nges don sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /des na sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i de bzhin nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag gis dag par mngon du gyur pa'i mnyam bzhag de de bzhin nyid rkye rnam pa yin te/ yul rang bzhin gyis skye ba dang bral ba la/ yul can mnyam bzhag kyang de'i ngang du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mnyam bzhug gi ye shes chos can/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi gnas lugs ji ltar yin pa bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas la
